row.name: Beecarbonize
row.detailed_description: Your enemy: carbon emissions. Research cutting-edge technologies, enact policies, protect ecosystems, and modernize industry to avert climate catastrophe. Create your own path to victory, manage your resources well, and you might survive! Will you favor industrial reforms, nature conservation or people initiatives? There are many ways to solve climate change and reduce pollution. But saving the planet is not an easy task. The more carbon emissions you produce the more extreme events you will have to deal with. You have to balance the power-generating industry, social reforms, ecological policies and scientific endeavors. Will you transition from fossil fuels as fast as possible? Or will you focus on carbon capture technologies first? Experiment with new strategies and don’t be afraid to start again. Game cards represent inventions, laws, social advancements, or industries – each designed on the basis of real-world climate science. In addition, partially randomized world events occur, forcing you to adapt your strategy. Gradually unlock new cards in the game encyclopedia and chart your path towards a new future. The world of Beecarbonize reacts to your actions. More emissions mean more floods or heatwaves, investing in nuclear power raises the risk of a nuclear incident, and so on. Learn more with each run and you might overcome environmental catastrophes, social unrest, and even avert the end of life on earth. We are introducing Hardcore mode, the ultimate challenge in Beecarbonize for experienced players. In Hardcore mode you will face the harsh reality of climate change. Can you defy the odds and save the planet even in this extreme scenario? Beecarbonize is a strategic challenge that lets you experience phenomena shaping our everyday lives hands-on. Just how many seasons can you last?
row.short_description: Do you have what it takes to save the planet? Beecarbonize is an environmental card strategy game with climate change as your opponent.
row.reviews: “I really, genuinely, enjoy this game and will continue to do new runs until I win and eliminate all the emissions.” 9/10 – Pocket Tactics “A wonderful showcase of just how many amazing solutions to the crisis are already out there.” Play Anthropocene “Inconspicuous bomb!” 8/10 – Zing

row.name: Team Rise
row.detailed_description: Team Rise is a free game that lets you discover the joys of a challenging multiplayer game. You can attempt to overcome the various difficulties with others, or alone. Be prepared to fall down a lot and go crazy! Share with your friends your climbing records, your achievements, the secrets you've found and explore all the maps with them! If you fall a lot, don't give up and get your friends to help you. Team Rise offers several maps to test your player control skills. You'll also have several movement modes to help you finish the maps in single-player, but in multiplayer, you'll have the most complex movement mode so that you're all on an equal footing, don't hesitate to finish the maps with the hardest difficulty level.
row.short_description: Discover the fun of team climbing! Explore all the secrets, shortcuts and traps! Share this adventure as a team, or do it alone.

row.name: Dark Riddle
row.detailed_description: Neighbors can sometimes create problems more serious than noise at the wrong time of the day. In this game you have to face an unusual neighbor, whose home is full of chilling secrets. Get into his house unnoticed, bypassing all the traps and video cameras, and get to the truth that can shock you! The main character in this interactive thriller is yourself, thanks to a realistic camera from the first person perspective. Moving to a new home, you discover some oddities in the behavior of your unsociable neighbor from the house across the street. He never leaves his home, from which strange and unsettling sounds can be heard, like cries. And one dark night a neighbor drags out of his house a bag with something that resembles a human body. It becomes clear that something suspicious is going on. You can not stay away - you need to get into the neighbor's house and find out what's happening inside! However, this will not be so easy to do! Each corner of his yard is adorned with a movable video camera, and all doors and windows are securely locked. And the neighbor himself is a rather dangerous person who will stop at nothing, just to hide all his dark deeds. If he discovers you, you are unlikely to be able to leave his house alive! Stay unnoticed, use your own ingenuity and uncover a terrible secret! Features: Advanced camera system from the first person perspective, allowing you to move around freely and look without any delay! Finding and using useful items. Find a flashlight, pimples, keys, gas cans and much more - all this will come in handy in the neighbor's house! Characters & Quests A living and detailed world with characters and quests! Skins A large number of skins for neighbor and houses! Traps & Weapons A variety of traps and weapons - all this will help you in the game against your neighbor. Use them wisely! Locations Various locations that immerse you in the atmosphere of the game! In a critical situation, you can try to escape and take shelter in your own home - the horrendous neighbor will not be able to get through to catch you! Your goal is the basement of the neighbor’s house. The key to unraveling all the terrible secrets is somewhere there! A stunning soundtrack, the sinister melodies - all of it perfectly convey the atmosphere of a mystical thriller! Will you be able to get to the bottom of the truth, or will you become another victim of an ominous neighbor?
row.short_description: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.

row.name: Bellus Battle
row.detailed_description: Bellus Battle is a fast-paced couch free for all game that takes place in an arena, the aim is to be the last one standing. Players are able to pick up weapons with different attributes. The game has a round based scoring system. The last player standing wins the round, after this you will move on to the next map and this cycle continues until someone has accumulated enough points to win the game! Find a variety of weapons on different levels to eliminate your friends from the battlefield! There are plenty of hats available that you and your friends can choose from to show off your style. Everything from knights to hamburgers!
row.short_description: Enter the world of Bellus, a world where cute animals run wild in a epic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Rail guns, Zeus lightning bolts, Bombs, Portal Guns, and much more. This is BELLUS BATTLE. Be the last one standing!

row.name: Yubu: The Shoeventure
row.detailed_description: 'Yubu: The Shoeventure' is a 3D platformer with a twist - It let's you build your own playstyle with equipable movesets! Yubu, a brave young Footarian, embarks on a mission to dismantle the Reseller's dominion over the Maibli Isles, using an unexpected weapon: shoes! In this epic quest, your mission is clear aid Yubu in his battle against the Reseller, a foe seeking to disrupt harmony in the shoeless society of Footaria. With your help, Yubu will navigate challenging platforms, uncover hidden secrets, and unleash his extraordinary shoe-based abilities. Make Yubu's journey your own with customizable movesets and special moves. Equip different shoe enhancements to alter his abilities. Whether you prefer enhancing agility, boosting jumping power, or a balanced approach, the choice is in your hands. Mix and match these abilities to overcome obstacles and enemies in creative ways. With each decision, Yubu's skills adapt to your playstyle, making every run through the game unique. Your strategy will determine the outcome of each challenge. Special Moves for Special Moments Boost Yubu's agility and power with special move shoe parts. Propel upwards with a burst of water, soar through the skies, or perform high-speed slides into enhanced jumps. Control the way your shoe hit Discover shoe parts that do more than complement footwear. Some parts scattered around Maibli Isles can cause explosions upon impact, trap enemies in ice, or release devastating lightning strikes. Tactical Throwing Mechanics Master the art of the throw with shoe parts that offer unique throwing patterns. Whether targeting the nearest enemy, a circle pattern, or bouncing off enemies. Innovative Movement Options Personalize Yubu with different shoe parts that affect Yubu's basic movements! Customize your shoe, combine four different attributes and find what suits you!
row.short_description: 'Yubu: The Shoeventure' is a 3D platformer with a twist - It let's you build your own playstyle with equipable movesets!

row.name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Another great hack typing game About the Game The Prologue serves as the opening chapter of the complete version, you will be able to play the first gigs in chapter 1 of the game. Immerse yourself in a captivating digital world where every keystroke holds the power to unravel the deepest secrets. Begin your journey in the safety of your hidden apartment, equipped with an arsenal of realistic streamlined commands such as Nmap, Harvester, Airocrack, Hping, Burp and more. As you delve deeper into the game, navigate through an intricate web of intrigue, discovering hidden truths and unraveling a conspiracy that spans the country. Stay one step ahead of your adversaries as you exploit vulnerabilities, troll online pages, and manipulate the Internet. Streamlined Realistic Hacking Experience streamlined gameplay with realistic commands and hacking tools, providing an immersive hacking simulation. Uncover the Truth Engage in a compelling narrative-driven experience, tracking down leads, and exposing a secret organization's dark intentions. Target Manipulation Hack and troll public figures on social media, disrupting their online presence and revealing their secrets. Progression and Unlockables Earn money and increase your rank within the hacking community to unlock new software, tools, and hacking methods. Dynamic Gameplay Adapt your strategies as you face evolving challenges, race against time, and outsmart advanced security systems. Player Agency Choose your path and decide the fate of the information you discover, shaping the outcome of the game's gripping storyline.
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of a skilled Anonymous hacker and embark on a mission to unveil the truth hidden behind a sinister organization's plans to monitor civilian data and enforce mass surveillance.

row.name: War Has Never Been So Much Fun Playtest
Burger Kombat
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Burger Kombat Kitchen! In this virtual kitchen, there is no logic – ingredients randomly appear on your table every couple hours . All you can do is hope that your culinary skills will be enough to figure out what can be prepared from them! Combine various ingredients to create new burgers and amaze everyone with your mastery of cooking from the most absurd and incompatible products. The rarer the product, the cooler the burger. Collect the rarest ingredients to make the most expensive burgers out of them. In the Burger Kombat's kitchen, the main indicator of a chef's mastery is the ability to make burgers that people would want to pay any amount of money for! And remember the main thing – this game will not teach you how to cook delicious burgers, it will teach you how to cook EXPENSIVE burgers .
row.short_description: Assemble your most expensive burger from whatever you can find in the kitchen.

row.name: 梅洛可奇遇
row.detailed_description: 故事梗概 梅洛可是个十二岁小女孩，和自己的爸爸生活在城市里。在小学毕业的这个夏天，梅洛可突然遇到了尤特，自己小时候一起的玩伴。 尤特带来了一封信，一封妈妈写给自己的信，邀请梅洛可来到一个全新的世界——一个充满了“灵”的世界。 梅洛可来到充满“灵”的神秘小岛，和尤特一起，寻找起这个世界的真相，以及妈妈的下落...... 在探索小岛的旅途中，梅洛可发现了一个名为“黄金树”的传说，并发现这个传说和自己的妈妈有关。 同时，隐藏在传说背后的阴谋，也正在逐渐揭开...... 游戏类型 这是一款2D剧情向解谜游戏。 在本游戏中，您将扮演小女孩梅洛可，在灵的世界里冒险、搜集、解谜，揭开这个神秘的世界真正的面目。 游戏风格 轻度交互，轻松自然。 本作品里有大量的小细节与小彩蛋。 建议玩家游玩时佩戴耳机。 简单操作说明 方向键 - 操控角色行走 回车键 - 进行对话/交互 ESC - 打开菜单栏 存档
row.short_description: 《梅洛可奇遇》是一款2D剧情向探索游戏，在本作中，您将扮演十二岁的小女孩梅洛可，探索这个属于灵的世界，并发掘出真相。
publishers: Shenzhen Baotong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd

row.name: Mannequin
row.detailed_description: Mannequin is a short first person horror game where you navigate through a store filled with suspicious dolls as you step into the shoes of a clothing store worker. However, as you make your way towards the exit, a flickering of lights precedes a complete power outage, plunging the store into darkness and leaving you trapped inside. Try to survive while you make your way through the store and try to find a way out. As you cautiously tread through the store's eerily quiet aisles you'll need to watch your back because each time you avert your gaze, they inch closer, their cold plastic hands reaching out to grasp you. Features: Using your phone as flashlight Murderous dolls are chasing you Chilling Atmosphere A short thrilling experience Nerve-wracking sounds Surprise twist Unexpected environment Controls: WASD to move Mouse to Look F to use flashlight E to interact Shift to sprint ESC to Pause/UnPause
row.short_description: Play as a clothing store worker who is just finishing up her shift and preparing to go home. However, as you make your way towards the exit, the power suddenly goes out, leaving you trapped inside the store.

row.name: MurmALLmaus
row.detailed_description: MurmALLmaus ist ein Point-and-Click-Adventure rund um die Murmelmaus und Ihre verrückte Reise durchs All auf dem Weg zu Ihren Mäusen. Begleite Sie auf Ihrem Weg und Klick dich durch Raumschiffe, Kaufhäuser und Gassen, doch Vorsicht: Es wird Cringe! Cringe-Hecke - wer sind wir? Die Cringe-Hecke sind dutzende Mäuse, die sich zusammengefunden haben, um der Murmelmaus eine Freude zu Bereiten. Im Laufe des ersten Halbjahres 2023 entstand so in hunderten Stunden gemeinsamer Arbeit dieses Spiel zur großen Geburtstagsparty. Mehr als 20 Mäuse haben organisiert, entwickelt, gezeichnet, musiziert und syncronisiert damit der große Tag ein ganz Besonderer werden konnte. MurmALLmaus MurmALLmaus ist ein Fan-Made-Game von Ehrenamtlichen Helfern, die nicht aus dem Bereich der Spieleentwicklung stammen. Den Spieler erwarten sehr verschiedene Zeichenstile, Wortwitze und Insider bekannt aus den Twitch-Streams von Murmelmaus_Gina. Hilfe und Tips findet ihr auf unserem !
row.short_description: Cringe - eine ganze Menge Cringe, das muss man Erwarten wenn man mit der Murmelmaus das Weltall durchstreift. Wenn wir doch nur etwas zu Knabbern dabei hätten ...

row.name: Asteroidc
row.detailed_description: A sci-fi spaceship asteroid game. You are sent by the asteroid haters to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Don't worry if you die, they'll send another one in your place. But, the asteroids are a group organism, the more you destroy the more they will send and the bigger and faster they'll be. Whoever destroys the most will earn it's place on top of the Leaderboard.
row.short_description: You're in control of a spaceship and your mission is to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Compete for the highest place on the Leaderboard.

row.name: DAYS END
row.detailed_description: STORY: Embark on a Heart-Pounding Journey of Survival and Redemption in 'Days End' - a Gripping Horror FPS Experience on Steam! As the deadly Xonobia Virus engulfs the country, leaving behind a trail of infected zombies and death, follow the harrowing tale of Chad, one of the few survivors determined to escape the nightmarish chaos. Joining forces with the ruthless gang, 'Blackbirds,' Chad must navigate through a foggy, horror-filled environment, battling terrifying monsters and challenging zombies with limited ammo at his disposal. Engage in intense action and thrilling gameplay as you explore each abandoned house, uncovering secrets and easter eggs along the way. Utilize an intricate inventory system and crafting mechanics to craft essential items and weapons, enhancing your chances of survival. Will Chad be able to find his lost brother and make a daring escape from the country, or will the darkness consume him? Play 'Days End' now, if you dare, and experience a chilling, adrenaline-fueled adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat! CONTROLS: ⦁ W,A,S,D To Move ⦁ Space To Jump ⦁ Shift To Run ⦁ E To Interact ⦁ Q To Put Away Objects ⦁ 1,2,3 Or Scroll To Switch Between Weapons ⦁ Esc To Pause The Game ⦁ Right Click To Aim, Left Click To Shoot ⦁ Tab To Open Inventory Key Features: Investigate Each House Scary Horror Foggy Environment Inventory System & Crafting Monster Boss Fight Partial Controller Support Challenging Zombies Shooting Secret Easter Eggs
row.short_description: Fight for survival in the horror FPS 'Days End' amid the Xonobia Virus outbreak. Confront terrifying zombies, find weapons, and uncover chilling secrets. Thrills await!
row.notes: Violence, Fear And Gore

row.name: Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets PROLOGUE
row.detailed_description: ADD TO WISHLIST! About the Game Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets PROLOGUE is a short game that serves as an introduction to the story that takes place in the main game. Eddie has been waiting for weeks for the day when he finally goes to the amusement park with his parents. But at one attraction something unexpected will happen... Join Eddie on an adventure and immerse yourself in the terrifying atmosphere that awaits you in this fair of horrors. Survive the traps that have been prepared exclusively for you in this crazy experiment. If you make it to the end, get ready to meet someone very special...
row.short_description: In this prologue you will step into the shoes of little Eddie, a 12 year old boy who goes to the amusement park with his parents until what would be a fun day out turns into a nightmare. Experience the terrifying atmosphere of what awaits you in Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets!
row.notes: This game has gore and bloody scenes.

row.name: Elewar: Fused Survivors
row.detailed_description: Upgrade your spells from basic functionality to a devastating power! Complete over 300 challenges to gain the advantage of over 300 interesting unlocks , with quite a lot of new additions to the game! Choose from over 30 different events which may trigger throughout a run for even more variety and build customizing! Play through multiple realms , each one providing a different type of playstyle to all of the character classes! Craft your own weapon to take with you and overcome the 5 trials of each realm! Will you become the archmage of Elewar or will you be brought down by your opponents? Bulletheaven might quickly become a bullethell if you aren't strong enouph! Every enemy has at least 1 special attack... which you can dodge! There is no simple contact damage, which makes the game very challenging Feature list: 5 elements, 20 different offensive spells and 8 utility spells. Every spell may be upgraded in its rarity separately, which enables a diverse and powerful spell progression in a run. Prophecy Whirls, which give you a choice of a random event, may challenge and reward you depending on the chosen difficulty. 18 character classes with wildly different playstyles, combined with a dual class system. over 300 unlocks with corresponding rewards. Over 140 upgrades. Choose an unlocked blessing before you start a run, making cool combinations out of classes, blessings and starting spells possible! At least 5 realms with different enemies, rules and trials. Crafting system to make your own items, which give you an additional edge in the Trials of Elewar. There are 5 different equipment slots with varying crafting. Several hidden secrets to discover. A roguelike gamemode with a highly different gameplay. And much much more!
row.short_description: Use your elemental powers to defeat terrifying monsters, while slowly becoming a godlike magician. Packed with challenging events, deep ARPG-like systems and a hardcore difficulty! 18+ classes, 25+ spells, 300+ unlocks, 140+ upgrades, over 50 random events and much more!

row.name: Guerra Sangrenta
row.detailed_description: Guerra Sangrenta is a free FPS game.We have many different types of modes for players to choose. Bomb: Classic: Adventure mode: You can find it clearly in the lobby, including many sub modes waiting for your exploration. Now the battle is on, there are various modes and weapons for you to explore! Call your friends and join us,get into the battle field now!
row.short_description: “Guerra Sangrenta” has many attracting game modes, with its unique optimization technique, such as Classic Competition, Casual Game, Adventure mode etc. Join to find all the wild gears and weapons for your taste, run through the storm of shots and shells. Exciting battles await you!

row.name: さよならナイト・キャップ
row.detailed_description: この世界にずっといるか、目を覚ますか。 このゲームについて 目が覚めると、見知らぬゲームセンターにいました。 あなたを知る謎の女の子と行動を共にし、不思議な世界を探検しましょう。 閉じ込められた世界から脱出しましょう。世界の住人の手助けをすることで、脱出のヒントが得られるかも。 このゲームの特長 -すこしミステリアスな女の子 -結構ミステリアスな世界の住人 -没入感の高いクリックアドベンチャーシステム -心が落ち着く音楽
row.short_description: 目が覚めると、見知らぬゲームセンターにいました。 あなたを知る謎の女の子と行動を共にし、不思議な世界を探検しましょう。

row.name: Escape From Castle Matsumoto
row.detailed_description: Medieval Japan. An evil daimyo lord has stolen the treasures of Imperial family and hidden them in his castle in an attempt to seize power. As a young Shinobi apprentice, you have decided to sneak into the castle, recover the treasures and return them to their rightful owners to bring prominence to your clan. However, a member of a competing clan has also discovered daimyo's scheme and is on the same mission as you. Do whatever it takes to be the first to recover stolen items and bring honour to your clan. Please check out the game manual in the sidebar for full explanation of all game mechanics! Gameplay You control one of two shinobis competing to recover stolen treasures and escape the castle. You will need to: thoroughly search the castle to locate and collect all items hinder your opponent's efforts by setting up tricks and obstacles if necessary, challenge your opponent in a direct fight Use all of your shinobi training to accomplish the mission: ninja's tools: locks and smoke bombs powerful spirits you can summon to guard items and passages defensive countermeasures to break tricks set up by your opponent martial arts if a direct confrontation becomes inevitable Play against the CPU or another player, over split-screen or network.
row.short_description: Two shinobis race against each other to recover stolen items and escape a Japanese castle, using their wits and tricks to outsmart the opponent. Retro split-screen duel arcade game using pixel art in 3D.

row.name: Blitz Runner
row.detailed_description: Step into the vibrant world of Blitz Runner, a thrilling, fast-paced game where your speed is your greatest asset. As the newest addition to our collection, Blitz Runner combines the excitement of endless running with the thrill of competition. In Blitz Runner, you'll dash through colorful landscapes, collecting dazzling gems that not only increase your score but also your speed! The more gems you collect, the faster you run, making every game a unique and exhilarating journey. As you level up, you'll have the chance to race against other players on a variety of distinctive tracks. Showcase your speed, skill, and strategy to outpace your rivals and claim victory. Uncover new pets, unlock faster speeds, and ascend the leaderboards. The road to becoming a speed legend starts here. Are you ready to take on the challenge and secure your place amongst the fastest runners in the game?
row.short_description: In Blitz Runner, you'll dash through colorful landscapes, collecting dazzling gems that not only increase your score but also your speed! The more gems you collect, the faster you run, making every game a unique and exhilarating journey.

row.name: Parasite in Love
row.detailed_description: STORY A biological romance horror visual novel Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Will you be able to convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late? Or will his love consume you “until death do us part”? This game was made for the Spooktober VN Jam 2022. CONTENT WARNINGS Body Horror and Tokophobia (Fear of Pregnancy). Player discretion is advised. This game also contains flashing lights, animated effects, and vivid colors which may not be suitable for some players. There is a 'Reduce Motion' option in the game settings should you wish to turn off the animation and transition effects. FEATURES 8.5k words 4 endings 8 CGs atmospheric music hauntingly beautiful art partial voice acting, fully voice acted endings plot-consistent UI changes CREDITS Direction, Art, Writing by NiAsobu Marlowe voiced by Coda Niall voiced by Trickle Background Art by Baguetti Programming by Ooyu Editing by Allie Vera Music, Sound Effects, and Voice Edits by Amidst Voice Direction by MAHO! Cody Casting Direction and Marketing by Elm Logo, UI and Trailer by ingthing
row.short_description: Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Can you convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late?
row.notes: Body Horror and Tokophobia (Fear of Pregnancy). Player discretion is advised.

row.name: All We Need
row.detailed_description: In All We Need, players immerse themselves in a world of horror and suspense. Influenced by North American mythology, the game takes players on a harrowing journey as they follow the protagonist, Jack, who is drawn away from his family by mysterious supernatural forces. As players navigate the haunting landscapes and eerie environments of North American woods, they will encounter psychological challenges, terrifying encounters, and dark secrets rooted in ancient lore.
row.short_description: All We Need is a first-person horror exploration. Uncover supernatural mysteries, face chilling encounters, and navigate haunting landscapes. Unravel the consequences of Jack's fateful decision. Survive the psychological challenges that await. Can you escape the horrors?
row.notes: The main character in the game is depicted smoking a cigarette that grants superpowers. While the smoking is part of the character's abilities, it does not promote or endorse drug use or addiction. The game explores historical events and their consequences. It includes references to European civilizations colonizing North America and violently repressing a rebellion. While the game does not depict the violence in a graphic or explicit manner, it may allude to the historical context and consequences of such actions. The game may contain implied references to domestic violence against children within the storyline or dialogue. These references are not shown graphically, but their existence is implied. They are presented in a respectful manner and are intended to contribute to the narrative and character development.

row.name: Ovine Replica
row.detailed_description: Once an impoverished boy, Ecout Kanovos lands a job as a recruit for the authoritative force of the city of Enonoia: the Master Order Trained Hire. However, Ecout soon realizes that this work exceeds his expectations of delivering any sort of justice. Amidst the chaos of sudden abductions and riots, an otherworldly atmosphere looms just beyond the recesses of the city's society. From a dubious state prison, Ecout frees Otis: a peculiar young man with a beastly visage who promises to return the favor with an ability to grant any wish. Could this power repair Ecout's life before it crumbles along with the city, or will the events that follow mark his undoing? What awaits you in the end is yet to be found. FEATURES An adventure-style visual novel. Multiple endings to a tale of suspense and intrigue shed new light on what could be and what could have been. Choices made will lead to different outcomes in unexpected ways as your true intentions become evident. In an already foreign world, the true mysteries have yet to be solved, and the biggest surprises have yet to be discovered. The precursor to Amorous Ursidae's Ursine Science .
row.short_description: A fantasy visual novel featuring action, horror, and multiple endings to a tale of suspense, intrigue, desperation, and desire. Part I of The Enonoia Saga.
row.notes: Occasional violent and bloody imagery; brief or partially obscured gore; some scenes with romantic, but modest and non-sexual intimacy between adult characters; few rare scenes describing implied sexual acts while no sexually explicit visuals are on screen; and somewhat frequent mild profanity with some brief instances of strong language.

row.name: Monster Coming
row.detailed_description: join us Players who want to experience this game first can contact us through the group at any time, and we will provide you with a serial number. We hope you can let more players see this game through live broadcast! About the Game Hundreds of monsters are attacking you on the same screen, and you can only face it alone. The rich monsters will bring you the most exciting experience! Different bosses have different attack skills, super fast movement speed, wall of beasts coming towards you, and position-locked sprint attacks. The attacks of each boss will be your nightmare! You decide the upgrade route, which contains more than 20 props, and each prop has more than ten branch upgrade routes. Different routes determine different gameplay. No matter what choice you make, it will lead to victory! Is it a summoning stream, a buff burst, or a large area of ​​high attack value crushing. Different genres have different gameplays. It all depends on your preference whether you want to move coquettishly or do violent output! Is it a steel rider? Yue Yuan? Or the lonely-eyed swordsman? Each character has its own exclusive skills! A super long flying sword attack, a delayed explosive bomb, or a broken sword that kills at close range, your choice will determine your start! Earn gold coins, continuously upgrade your talents, and with the blessing of buffs, you can kill ruthlessly and become unstoppable! The moment you start the game, victory is declared!
row.short_description: 'Monster Coming' is a fast-paced survivor roguelite game. Dark cracks suddenly appeared in the sky, and a tide of beasts emerged from them to invade humans. You stand up as one of the braves, face the menacing beast tide, choose your equipment, formulate tactics, and feel unparalleled.

row.name: 召唤之王 (Supreme Summoner)
row.detailed_description: Players will embody a rising lord of a power in this chaotic era, forming their ideal army based on the cards in their possession. Command your troops and generals, utilizing their skills, to face off against friends and foes alike in exciting battles. With nearly 200 cards, six major factions, four Lord classes, and dozens of genre combinations, this game offers a high level of strategy and fun in real-time player matching, either for battles or team play. The gameplay and event features are simple and pure. The turn-based strategy and auto battles can provide players with a relaxing yet competition charm.
row.short_description: ‘Supreme Summoner’ is a turn-based strategy chess game. Taking the imaginative Romance of the Three Kingdoms as its theme, it innovatively blends elements of gods, demons, and mystical creatures, making each faction and character's attributes even more prominent.

row.name: AMBUSH tactics Advanced
row.detailed_description: The finished epic tactics RPG is finally here! Deep below Legacio is the land known as Centralia. Within lies three city-kingdoms which include Gala, where our story begins. Ruby Pyre is a thief who gets caught, but is given an opportunity by the King's nephew to become a General of Gala's Woman Army. Red Cloud, a shadow, failed to save Ruby and vows to stop the royal family. Gala, using its male and female armies, are set off to find an ancient treasure said to contain some strange power. So begins the war of the sexes in a bid to find the 'cores' in this Core War. Elle (pronounced Ellie) Clare, Iris Green, Mike Cullen, and many others will join this story in a quest to bring Centralia back to some peace. Enjoy a thrilling tactics RPG where each decision may end the battle itself! Credit to Victor Sant & GubiD for Engine.
row.short_description: A simple modern medieval tactics RPG.

row.name: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue Playtest
Scratch Man
row.detailed_description: In this 2.5D obstacle dodging game you play as Scratch Man. He is a cat super hero who is on a train home when he encounters his old enemy the Evil Squirrel, who has recently escaped from prison. It is up to you to foil his evil plan and save the (honestly kind of weird) passengers. At one point you will be knocked off the train and must catch up to it. Scratch Man will start automatically flying towards the train and his progress will be represented by a graphic on screen. During this time you must move him up and down to avoid obstacles being thrown. These obstacles spawn either in the middle, top, or bottom of the right side of the screen. If you are hit too many times it is Game Over and you can try again. Features: The passengers of the train have some bizarre things to say, it's worth talking to them. Dramatic action cutscenes featuring Scratch Man and the Evil Squirrel. Fully voice acted. Do dogs get offended if they see you using a lint roller? Created by a group of friends, bursting at the seams with personality. Hard mode has faster obstacles, alternate passenger dialogue, and a secret ending.
row.short_description: In this 2.5D obstacle dodging game Scratch Man is on a train home when he encounters his old enemy the Evil Squirrel, who has recently escaped from prison.

row.name: Shroom & Doom
row.detailed_description: Shroom & Doom is a top-down tower-defense game where you play as a little robot that has crash landed on an alien planet. You must defeat waves of bug-like enemies and use the biomass they drop to build towers made from the local mushrooms. These towers are your only hope at defending yourself from the ever increasing onslaught of vicious enemies Defend yourself against waves of increasing intensity Face off against three unique enemies Use biomass obtained from the local fauna to grow your own defensive towers Play again and again to get farther and beat your highscore This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A top-down tower-defense game where you play as a little robot that has crash landed on an alien planet. Defend yourself against waves of bug-like enemies using towers made from the local mushrooms. Find a way to repair your ship and escape the planet!

row.name: Asurya's Embers
row.detailed_description: Overview Immerse yourself in the spectacular environment of the Himalayan regions as Dawa, the bow-wielding village protector. Asurya’s Embers is a first-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow adventure game where you embark on a journey to save your home from the wrath of a vengeful god. In Asurya’s Embers , explore the Himalayan landscape and mountains, navigating your way while avoiding the intense sunlight and seeking safety in the shadows. Wield the Protector’s Bow and unleash mythical powers passed down through generations to protect your people by slaying mutated, demonic animals. Story A long time ago, this beautiful region was plagued by warfare. In order to protect the people from danger, the village initiated a tradition of electing a village protector. In the game, the player assumes the role of Dawa, the newly appointed protector. The story begins following Dawa’s completion of her meditation training in isolation. As Dawa embarks on her first day in the role, she learns that the natural balance of her world has been upturned by scorching skies and the arrival of mutated animals. Upon consulting with the village elders, she realizes that there is a more significant problem at hand... Features Immerse in a world of historical fantasy in the Himalaya regions, with these exciting game features: Immersive and Gorgeous Himalayan Landscape Embark on a journey in the Himalayan region, featuring beautiful mountain ranges and realistic architecture inspired by South Asian culture. Enjoy the grace and serenity of the in-game landscape. Powerful Bow Play Wield the power of the Protector’s Bow, passed down through generations, equipped with multiple special abilities to aid you in your journey of defeating demonic enemies. Unconventional Light and Shadow Mechanic Experience our unconventional light and shadow mechanic, where you must seek safety in the shadows and risk damage in the sunlight.
row.short_description: Asurya’s Embers is a 1st-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow shooter set in an ancient Himalayan village plagued by an environmental disaster. Find safety in the shadows from the blazing heat waves as Dawa, a bow-wielding hero who protects her village from the vengeful sun god, Asurya.

row.name: Kneedle Knight
row.detailed_description: Kneedle Knight is a third-person, puzzle platformer game developed by students at SMU Guildhall Cohort 32. In Kneedle Knight , the player controls a mouse knight that uses his magical needle to sew fabric which he can merge into, moving back and forth between 3D and 2D. Sir Lukoss the Small was a noble knight sent on a quest to defeat the evil Witch of Fabric. The Witch, using her enchanted fabric, imprisoned and transformed many citizens and knights into malicious fabrications. Sir Lukoss climbed up through her fortress to put an end to her tyranny, only to be hexed by her magic and transformed into a mouse. In the dark dungeon of the Witch’s lair, the mouse finds a magic needle, granting him special powers to sew fabric of his own and merge in and out of the enchanted threadwork. Now Sir Lukoss must use his newfound weapon to sew his path forward and up through the evil stronghold. The mouse knight can use his needle to solve puzzles, overcome challenging obstacles, and defeat the animated candle minions of the Witch. All with the hopes of returning to face the Witch of Fabric yet again to finish his noble quest. Features: Single-player, puzzle platformer game Playtime (main story): 1-2 hours Playtime (100% achievements): 2 hours Steam leaderboard support for level speed running Made in Unreal Engine 5 Original soundtrack
row.short_description: Kneedle Knight is a 3rd-person puzzle platformer game. Conjure fabric with a magic needle as Sir Lukoss the Small and merge in and out of fabric. Solve puzzles, platform across magical objects, and defeat cursed candle minions to return Sir Lukoss to normal and defeat the Witch of Fabric!

row.name: Taking Root - Academic Version
row.detailed_description: An emotional Odyssey Embark on a heartfelt journey in “ Taking Root ”, a game which depicts the emotional experience of escape on an abstract level. Its purpose is to encourage players to empathize with people having experienced such a journey in their lifes. Intervined Fates In this unique experience, you'll step into the shoes of a stone creature and its devoted plant companion. Sharing a deep, symbiotic friendship from birth, they choose to navigate the challenges of finding a new home after their once-pristine homeland transformed into a concrete-laden metropolis. Think outside the Garden As the player, you'll keep watch over this extraordinary pair and guide them on their arduous escape. You'll encounter a multitude of perspective-based puzzles along the way, requiring you to perceive the world differently and think outside the box. These puzzles will test your creativity and problem-solving skills. Immerse Yourself The colors and soundscapes used in each area reflect the emotional state of our endearing protagonists to provide an immersive experience. Will you be able to lead this inseperable duo to a new sanctuary where they can Take Root ? Root for us! This game was created during our studies at the University of Applied Sciences Salzburg as our bachelor's project. Game Design / Art Pascal Patrice Vincent Betsche Sarah Hagleitner Vivienne Estella Depauli Game Design / Programming Benjamin Kunz Cedric Elias Ferstl Helen Hinrichs Music Michael Paul Thelonious Hamel Logo / UI Sophie Marie Hennerbichler
row.short_description: Join a stone creature and its loyal plant companion in an emotional journey to escape their once-pristine home, now suffocated by a concrete metropolis. Solve mind-bending puzzles by shifting perspectives as they flee together and find a new sanctuary to forever take root!

row.name: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD Playtest
Le Bonk - Academic Version
row.detailed_description: Notice: This game requires at least 2 players with controllers to be playable! Keyboard is not supported. Le Bonk is an action-packed game where you assume the role of a mole armed with a hammer and compete against other moles in the Moleanship. Your goal is to knock your opponents off the stage while remaining the last one standing. Immerse yourself in an exciting world that requires quick reflexes and strategic thinking. Throw your hammer at your opponents to unbalance them with a powerful strike. However, be careful not to be pushed to the edge of doom yourself! Use the environment to your advantage by burrowing into the ground to avoid incoming hammers. With your speed, you can swiftly move towards your opponents and deliver a mighty blow. The game features an appealing design that perfectly reflects the gameplay. Each level introduces unique third-party events, making the game even more captivating. Get ready for an thrilling adventure filled with action and tactical challenges. Become the master of Le Bonk and defeat your opponents to stand as the last mole on the hill.
row.short_description: Imagine, you are a mole armed with a hammer, battling creatures coming out of holes by throwing your hammer to knock them off the stage. Dig into the environment to avoid hammers and use speed to dash into opponents for a powerful knockback. Be the last one standing and BONK!

row.name: 火焰征程
row.detailed_description: Groups Discord： CS: huoyanzhengcheng@gmail.com About the Game Game Features Deck Building : Construct your own unique deck freely to create a personalized battle style Strategic Combat : Engage in deep tactical battles and savor the thrill of intellectual challenges Team Collaboration : Connect with like-minded allies and showcase the power of teamwork Fast-Paced Matches : Each battle is quick and engaging, perfect for enjoying combat in your spare time Free Trading : Trade unique cards freely, fully embracing the joy of collection Class Overview Mage : Devoted to studying magical energies, skilled in dealing area damage and controlling enemy troops Priest : A devoted follower who employs powerful healing and defensive spells to protect allies, while invoking the Holy Light to burn enemies Ranger : With keen instincts and agile movements, capable of inflicting direct damage on enemy heroes, while their card control skills pose a significant threat to foes Warrior : The embodiment of strength, courage, and conviction, enhancing the attack capabilities of allies while delivering direct damage to enemies with various skills
row.short_description: A classic turn-based strategy card game that allows players to collect various creature cards and skill cards through quests, upgrades, and trading. Players can select their favorite cards to craft a unique deck for battles, immersing themselves in the excitement of strategic gameplay!

row.name: Labyrinth of Rage
row.detailed_description: A Souls-Like game like nothing seen before Trapped inside a Labyrinth constructed inside a demonic realm , our hero must face the deepest and darkest depths inside these twisted walls. Imbued with the power of magic, combat, and archery. Will you escape the Labyrinth? Fight your way against hordes of monsters while traversing through the twisted hallways. Various Combat Styles Use different styles of combat like one-handed sword & shield, bow & arrows, and magic! With many more combat styles on the way. Level up through Gear! Become stronger by wandering through the labyrinth and acquiring new weapons and armor. Many updates on the way (Early Access) This game is still in it's infancy and will continue to grow, for the time being it is in Early Access right now.
row.short_description: Enter the Labyrinth... at your own demise.

row.name: Rampage Agents
row.detailed_description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that includes hero shooting battle royale and multiplayer cooperative adventure gameplay. Players will take control of increasingly diverse and powerful superhuman agents, form tactical squads with friends, and fight together! 🎮 Battle Royale Mode: Create your tactic squad and utilize your hero skill, weapon and items to ensure your survival. Become the last one standing in the massive map. - KEY FEATURES: 🔥Diverse Tactical Skills. Not just for expert shooters! 🔥Over 100 different items and various weapons. Each weapon has its own unique ability. 🎮 Adventure Mode:(Over 12 hours of content, multiplayer mode requires the purchase of the Multiplayer Adventure Expansion Pack) Fused with Roguelite elements and dynamic tactical options, you can play as different agents with different skill sets in procedurally-generated stages with random loots. Find the right weapon & chip combo and level up the skills to create a unique build among tens of thousands of possible combinations. - KEY FEATURES: 🔥FPS+Roguelite+RPG combined gameplay, construct diverse Build through death cycle for different experience 🔥Many heroes and multiple game plus with different game mechanisms 🔥Dozens of personalized dyes available to customize your skin
row.short_description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!

row.name: SpaceMine
row.detailed_description: SpaceMine is a thrilling third-person tower defence game that puts you in charge of a mining operation on a distant asteroid! You'll be tasked with delivering minerals to your corporate overlords and fending off waves of local fauna before they can disrupt your mining operation. To do this, you can choose from a variety of structures with different strengths and weaknesses to build and upgrade. Of course, this all depends on the difficulty setting you choose, as this will affect the range of systems available to you to complete your mission. Be aware, however, that building, upgrading and repairing structures is not a company expense and must be paid for out of your own pocket! So choose wisely what you build, upgrade or repair and when you pay for it.  Brakken Industries would love to welcome a new Mining Operations Manager, with new positions becoming available every minute, there is always a place in our family.
row.short_description: SpaceMine is a third-person tower defence game where your mission is to defend your mining operation by building towers and barriers to hold off waves of local fauna and collect enough resources to meet the company's quota.

row.name: Mutus Meteora
row.detailed_description: MUTUS METEORA Welcome to the virtual gallery where you can explore the highlands, its architecture, discover works of art, collectibles, interact with a third-person character, and adjust the time of day. This project is an exploration on Secondary Bounce journey, and we are excited to have Shir Pakman as our special guest visual artist and immersed in the music of Javier Jaime. Deeply entwined with the exploration of the subconscious and the unleashing of imagination through provocative imagery. The artworks evoke a dream-like ambiance, showcasing mystical scenes and imaginary landscapes that explore themes like personal transformation, alchemy, and esoteric knowledge seeking. The art encapsulates philosophical and spiritual ideas, striving to create a bridge between art and nature. The sculptures on display, with their organic and abstract shapes, mirror a deep fascination with natural beauty and the allure of various materials. Employing stone, metal, and wood, the creator’s vision is vividly brought to life. We invite you to submerge yourself in this unique experience, where art and technology come together to create a captivating virtual world. Come and discover the lights and shadows of Mutus Meteora. Mutus Meteora is a Ground-breaking fusion of art and gaming, offering an innovative experience where you explore an art gallery as though immersed in Top Down perspective. This project aims to bridge the perceived gap between these two domains, introducing Artists as creators and gamers as users to the world of fine digital art galleries with an engaging, playful twist. Experiencing a digital exhibition slightly different from the usual approach.
row.short_description: Mutus Meteora is a Ground-breaking fusion of art and gaming, offering an innovative experience where you explore an art gallery as though immersed in Top Down perspective. Experiencing a digital exhibition slightly different from the usual approach.

row.name: Timo Boll Beats Table Tennis
row.detailed_description: Timo Boll Beats is a unique rhythm game that takes place in the thrilling world of table tennis! You will have the opportunity to hit the ball like Timo Boll to the rhythm of the music, immersing yourself in a fun and thrilling music experience like never before. One of the exciting aspects of Timo Boll Beats is that you can play to different music styles. Each music style offers its own unique rhythm and tempo, challenging you to stay in sync and hit the ball at the right moment. Whether you prefer fast-paced electronic beats or the smooth jazzy melodies, this game has something for everyone. But there's more to Timo Boll Beats than just entertainment. By immersing yourself in the rhythm of the game, you can improve your focus and concentration, which can greatly benefit your real table tennis game. As you train your reflexes and timing in the virtual world, you'll notice an improvement of your real-life abilities. To truly excel in Timo Boll Beats, you must never miss a beat. By playing long series without making any errors, you can reach new high scores and unlock exciting achievements. As you progress, you even can create combos and collect bonus items, further adding to the excitement and challenge of the game. It's not just about the gameplay. Timo Boll Beats also offers an immersive experience by taking you to multiple unusual table tennis locations. From industrial areas to train stations, you'll embark on a thrilling journey through the urban landscape. Along the way, you'll also meet some cool urban opponents, each with their own playing style and personality. And if you've ever dreamed of playing like Timo Boll, this game is your chance to make moves that only Timo can make. By mastering the rhythm and perfecting your technique, you can emulate the skills of a legendary table tennis player. So, what are you waiting for? Step into the exciting world of Timo Boll Beats and experience the thrill of table tennis. Hit the ball to the rhythm, challenge yourself, and unleash your inner table tennis champion.
row.short_description: Timo Boll Beats is a unique rhythm game that takes place in the thrilling world of table tennis! In this game, you will have the opportunity to hit the ball like Timo Boll to the rhythm of the music, immersing yourself in a fun and thrilling experience like never before.

row.name: 東方菈菈队
row.detailed_description: 游戏类型及难度： 一款东方同人stg(弹幕射击)游戏，东方正作ex级别弹幕难度。 背景故事： 魔女罗菈rola穿越到幻想乡之后发动圣诞节异变,随后博丽灵梦出现大战罗菈rola！ 操作方法： 玩家使用键盘的上下左右键控制移动方向 shift键控制高低速,z键射击,x键放符卡(bomb) BOSS一共四张 非符(nomal attack),五张 符卡(spell card attack)。 出场角色：博丽灵梦(player)and罗菈rola(boss)。 胜利方法：击破所有非符和符卡即可获得游戏胜利。 Staff名单 企划： 雾雨威 程序、弹幕、剧本、立绘动态、背景：SeiweLL 美术：聪明岚 关卡bgm：Tokini11 主菜单bgm：炼狱庭院音乐素材
row.short_description: 一款东方同人STG射击游戏,魔女罗菈Rola穿越到幻想乡发动圣诞节异变,博丽灵梦发现后大战罗菈Rola！开始紧张刺激的弹幕游戏吧！

row.name: Heros and Monsters: Idle Incremental
row.detailed_description: Rated higher in steam than HellDivers 2! Ethically free Idle game! (No Ads/Micro Transactions or options to buy anything) In the once-prosperous kingdom, a land shrouded in mystic enchantments and ancient prophecies, a dire threat looms. The malevolent Mordek, a dark sorcerer of unparalleled power, has unleashed his horde of abominations upon the land, plunging it into chaos and despair. As the darkness encroaches, a glimmer of hope emerges from the towering spires of the royal castle. It is here, amidst the swirling mists of uncertainty, that brave adventurers gather, their hearts ablaze with the fire of determination. They stand ready to embark on a perilous quest that will lead them from the fortress's battlements deep into the heart of the enchanted forest, where Mordek's sinister lair lies hidden within the depths of a cavern veiled in shadows. Yet, this is not merely a battle of steel and magic, but a test of courage and resilience. For in this mystical realm, the laws of nature bend to the will of those who dare to challenge fate. It is a realm where heroes craft their own destiny, forging mighty weapons and armor, and honing their skills to perfection through tireless dedication. In the crucible of adventure, every action taken echoes through the fabric of reality, shaping the very course of destiny. Will you charge headlong into the fray, confronting the minions of darkness with unwavering resolve? Or will you harness the power of patience and strategy, allowing your strength to grow with each passing moment, until you stand as a beacon of hope amidst the encroaching shadows? So gather your courage, brave adventurer, and let your legend be written in the annals of history. For the fate of the Kingdom hangs in the balance, and only by vanquishing Mordek and rebuilding the kingdom can true peace be restored to this mystical land. Ascending is not merely a journey of progression; it is a leap into the unknown, where the very essence of existence bends to the will of the chosen few. Through the veils of time and space, adventurers ascend to new heights of power, gaining access to mystical multipliers that amplify their prowess in ways unfathomable to the uninitiated. With each ascent, the boundaries of possibility are stretched ever further, as heroes harness the boundless energies of the cosmos to fuel their endeavors. Multipliers cascade like streams of stardust, imbuing every action with the potential for greatness, allowing resources to flow like rivers of liquid gold. And in this mystical realm, where honor and valor reign supreme, there are no shortcuts to greatness. There are no hidden costs, no treacherous schemes, no super premium currencies to cloud the purity of the hero's journey. Only through courage, perseverance, and the indomitable spirit of adventure can heroes rise to claim their rightful place among the legends of the Kingdom. Button Assest created by: upklyak on Freepik Music: - Pixabay - subject to and licensed under the Creative Commons Zero (CC0) license ('CC0 Content')
row.short_description: Auto Battler, Incremental, Idle Game

row.name: Stories One
row.detailed_description: Unique Fusion of FPS and MOBA (Pre-Alpha) Join us in the creation of Stories One, where the frenetic action of an FPS meets the strategic depth of a MOBA. In this pre-alpha stage, we invite you to experience and help shape this 5v5 PvP arena. Your aim, your strategy, and your feedback are pivotal to the game's development. Cooperative Team Play Teamwork is the essence of Stories One. Assemble your squad, plan your attack on the two lanes leading to the enemy base, and work together to dismantle their defenses while protecting your own. Arsenal and Special Powers Choose from five unique weapons and special powers to create the perfect loadout for your playstyle. Coordinate with your team, strategize, and use your arsenal effectively to lay waste to enemy defenses and seize victory. Strategic Deck Building and Leveling Up Harness the power of a well-built deck to enhance your character's stats and abilities. Gain levels by destroying enemy turrets, eliminating rival players or their robotic minions, and choose cards from your deck to get the upper hand. The better you perform, the more powerful you become. Reward System and In-Game Shop Every victory brings you points to spend in our in-game shop. Purchase new cards, customize your deck (up to 15 cards), and come up with fresh strategies for each game. Personalized Avatar Customization Dive deeper into the world of Stories One with extensive avatar customization options. Craft a unique identity for your university student as they navigate the challenges of the battlefield. From clothing and accessories to distinct facial features, make your mark and stand out in every match. Your style, your statement. Join us on this exciting journey to build a game that transcends traditional genres, blending strategy, team play, and fast-paced shooter action. Stories One is in its early stages and we're looking for players like you to help shape its future. Together, we can craft a truly remarkable gaming experience. Your story starts here.
row.short_description: Welcome to Stories One: an exciting pre-alpha game blending FPS and MOBA genres. Embark on thrilling 5v5 battles in a 90's retro-futuristic city. Strategically build your deck, level up, and conquer your foes. Join the Stories One arena today!

row.name: Little Man Has a Day
row.detailed_description: Little Man woke up and doesn't know what to do with his day. Play as Little Man and help him through the day by walking around and talking to friends (or foes) in this short and silly game about feeling 'eh'. A narrative driven 2D walking sim! Short! (~15 minutes) Handwritten journal to read! 8 Steam achievements for people who care!
row.short_description: A personal, short and silly handwritten game about a little man feeling a little 'eh'.

row.name: Dot to Dot Sweep
row.detailed_description: Dot to Dot Sweep is an arcade-style color matching game. Collect dots that match your color while avoiding all other dots. The game is inspired by classic arcade games and takes cues from modern games. The simple gameplay mechanics coupled with increasingly difficult levels allows players of all skill levels to enjoy playing. Try to beat your personal best score or, optionally, compete for the top spot on the worldwide leaderboard.
row.short_description: Go for the high score in this arcade-style color matching action game. Maneuver your character through fields of colored dots collecting those that match your color.

row.name: SLUDGE LIFE: The BIG MUD Sessions
row.detailed_description: SLUDGE LIFE: The BIG MUD SESSIONS is a 10 minute standalone first-person / vandalism-centric adventure game that takes place between both SLUDGE LIFEs. BIG MUD is about to record a track that could land him a DEAL, but the CIGGIES ran out and it's making him MAD ANXIOUS. Can you hook him up? Originally released as the DEMO for SLUDGE LIFE 2.
row.short_description: Munch down a bite-sized SLUDGE LIFE experience in this free self-contained interlude.
row.notes: This Game may contain content inappropriate for all ages or inappropriate for viewing at work. This may include: Crude language

row.name: Merge Adventure: Magic Dragons
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Merge Adventure: Magic Dragons Embark on epic adventure to discover merge games, collect and merge dragons on a quest to free the Realm. Using your merge magic powers to match and merge dragons! Clearing the magic puzzles through cursed gardens. Challenge the ancient Gods like Zeus, Thor, Aphrodite to unlock epic creatures, dragons and fables to help you in your adventures. Play free merge games loved by millions of players around the world. ★ Gameplay - Match and merge dragons to discover larger and more powerful wonders. - Manage resources, power, and energy, free the clouds to discover and grow your merge gardens. - Use your power to hatch, tame, and grow dragons and make them harvest for your merge county. ★ Merge - Drag items and dragons anywhere on the map, match 3 or more and merge them into an epic version of themselves! - Numerous combinations are possible and the sky is the limit! ★ Merge & Magic - Merge to earn awesome rewards during your adventure to help you along with your gardens. - Unlock the mighty force of gods, like Zeus, Thor, Aphrodite and others! ★ Solve Magic Puzzles - Complete magic puzzles filled with challenges and rewards you can use to free your kingdom. - Advance on your journey by completing and solving challenges, magic puzzles and merge games. - Build your Realm, clear the clouds and free your kingdom. - Lift the curse and free the land. ★ Collect & Tame Dragons - Discover and collect hundreds of dragons and wonders! - Use merge & magic to expand your kingdom and bring it to life! - Collect coins, minerals, gems and energy and use them wisely to grow your power and your Realm! - Collect dozens of mythical creatures like unicorns, magic dragons and many others, to make them work for you collecting fables! Do you have what it takes? Start your merge adventure today, solve hundred of merge games, magic puzzles, challenges and free the Realm!
row.short_description: Merge dragons and magic to solve hard puzzles by playing merge games

row.name: Pixelpusher
row.detailed_description: Pixelpusher is a free drone-based team combat game that emphasizes positioning and momentum above all else. Control space and manage risk with every move of your drones. Play capture the flag with up to 32 players. Join the discord for play sessions! Features Server-based online multiplayer Offline single player versus bots
row.short_description: Pixelpusher is a drone-based team combat game that emphasizes positioning and momentum above all else. Control space and manage risk with every move of your drones. Play capture the flag with up to 32 players.

row.name: Connected! 2
row.detailed_description: Minimalistic puzzle game. Connect the opposite sides of the same color by rotating the tiles. Each level is randomly generated, but guaranteed to be solvable. How to play You are challenged to bring order into the jumbled mix of lines and curves by connecting the opposite sides of the same color. Clicking a tile in the grid rotates the lines and curves in it. Colors will follow the lines. You may need to find spots to cross the lines or build loops. It's random! Each level is randomly generated, so solving even a small grid can vary wildly between being quite straight-forward to being a real challenge! Only one thing is for sure: there is at least one solution for ALL of the shown levels. That's a promise! Features Multiple grid sizes and numbers of lines to connect Share levels solved or as a challenge with your friends Endless random levels await being solved
row.short_description: Minimalistic puzzle game. Connect the opposite sides of the same color by rotating the tiles. Each level is randomly generated, but guaranteed to be solvable!

Immerse yourself in the immersive world of a comprehensive driving, racing, and chase game presented by Duelator Games.

The gameplay mechanics are spot on for a quick, intense and wildly addictive top-down, dual stick shooter experience that kept our troll army playing it for hours on end. But the overarching theme of the game is morally corrupt and has absolutely no anchor in reality. There is no dissatisfaction with The Regime. All subjects are happy. The developer is being detained in our Special Persuasion Facility and expected to make a public appearance confirming this very soon. We suggest you go back to your daily chores and forget you ever came upon this page. We trust you to not buy this game - but if you do, we will find you. Have a nice day. ======================================================= RESIST AUTHORITY A merciless regime has come to power and abuses the citizenry relentlessly. Enough is enough, fight this oppressive government and show them you mean business! FACES OF THE REVOLUTION Every game starts with a random citizen to kick off your rebellion, your allies come from all walks of life as you work together to topple the government. TOOLS OF DESTRUCTION Fight back with your fists, bricks, and bats or loot the weapons off the government goons you whack. Get everything from pistols, shotguns, and machine guns to sniper rifles and high explosives. Don''t forget to spend the cash you acquire on upgrades to unlock allies, grow stronger, and survive longer.
row.short_description: Imagine yourself living under your favourite oppressive regime. Rebel! Fight waves of SWAT teams. Loot their weapons and money. Buy upgrades. Enlist allies. row.name: Tatari: The Arrival
row.detailed_description: Note: This is a free prologue for the 'Tatari' game and it's limited to the first three areas. Tatari is a first-person adventure game where you take the role of a detective assigned to a disappearance case. As a police detective, you are sent to investigate from the last place the person of interest was seen. From there, you will find yourself experiencing some paranormal behavior that your logical mind can’t seem to get hold of. You will follow the evidence to a village that has been abandoned for many years and holds many of the secrets and details for your case. All the available places are filled with puzzles and locks that your goal is to open and get access to forgotten and hidden information that will bring you closer to finding an end to this case. Be careful, though. Some of the puzzles are more cunning than they seem and may cost you your life. Proceed with caution. Tatari is based upon a traditional Japanese urban legend which you will experience to some extent.
row.short_description: Take the role of a detective from Tokyo who tries to solve the mysterious case of the disappearance of a young camper. You will try to follow the trail of evidence to guide you through an enigmatic and paranormal case connected with a Japanese urban legend. Can you help until the end?

row.detailed_description: In Idle Weaponshop, you are handed your very own weapon shop to manage. Design and sell weapons, build up your local community, hire employees, and send adventurers off into danger for fun and profit... all before prestiging to earn powerful bonuses, all so you can do it all over again. row.name: R & P: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Embark on an epic journey in Revive & Prosper Prologue, a captivating single-player factory builder! It is a one-map gateway to the world of Revive & Prosper. IF YOU LIKE THE PROLOGUE, PLEASE ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR CART Features: Unleash your creativity as you construct a thriving base amidst landscapes you have revived with the mighty power of water. Put an end to manual excavation. Eliminate the reliance on resource deposits. Employ the Digging Wheel to excavate soil and transfer it to the Sedimentation Machine, which will efficiently sort the soil into all the necessary resources you require. Craft your industrial world from the ground up in this third-person base-building adventure with the help of delivering Catapults! Golems work tirelessly using bonuses for faster constructing, digging, planting and cooking. However, they will decompose eventually, beckoning you to craft new companions. Extend their existence by generating Biomass in Biopress and supplying it to the golem factory, which they will utilize to rejuvenate their lifespan. Be ready for changing weather that can impact your base. Rain can raise river levels, potentially causing floods if floodgates aren't opened promptly. Sandstorms provide wind for Windmills but can also lead to mild drought. Prepare for heat waves by storing water. Immerse yourself in a world teeming with possibilities, where building, producing, and harvesting blend harmoniously with a living ecosystem.
row.short_description: Build and survive in Prologue to Revive & Prosper, a voxel base-building strategy. Cultivate food, gather resources, and control mutants. Remodel the terrain, and flow of water, build automated factories. Unlock the entire build menu by completing the map goal! Wishlist FULL Revive & Prosper game.

About the Game Viking Hiking is a 3D Platformer featuring a buff viking called 'Bøf, son of Tøf', on a quest to reach Valhalla. Bøf carries a magic horn that he uses in an 'unconventional' way. Jump, dash and vault with the horn to overcome obstacles and explore the environment. Are you ready to prove yourself worthy in the eyes of the gods? Bøf can freely explore an entire island. It is up to you to decide which path to take to collect the necessary runes. Confront numerous platforming trials and devise your own way to conquer them. Let yourself be carried away by the beauty of this lush but challenging island! An epic journey awaits you adventurer

row.name: 3D Printer Manager
row.detailed_description: 3D Printer Manager  is a strategic idle management game that takes you into the addictive world of 3D printing. Start your journey as a hobbyist in your bedroom with a single, noisy printer and a dream. Your goal? To build the ultimate 3D printing empire. Manage your fleet of machines, optimize your filament supply, and fulfill customer orders to fund your expansion. As you grow, you'll move from a cramped bedroom to a garage, an office, and finally a factory. Whether you're a 3D printing enthusiast or a fan of tycoon games, 3D Printer Manager offers a satisfying blend of strategy, progression, and idle mechanics. Key Features Build Your Fleet: Purchase and manage distinct printer types including reliable Cartesian workhorses, lightning-fast CoreXY machines, and tall Delta towers. Each comes with its own speed, cost, and reliability trade-offs. Master Materials: It’s not just about plastic. Work your way up from basic PLA to advanced materials like ABS , TPU , Nylon , and premium Carbon Fiber . Each filament type commands a different market price and requires careful management. Deep Upgrade System: Fine-tune your machines for peak performance. Install Klipper firmware to boost speed, improve durability to reduce breakdowns, and upgrade efficiency to cut material costs. Expand Your Empire: Outgrow your space? Move your operation from a humble Bedroom (4 slots) to a Garage , Office , and eventually a high-tech Factory capable of housing dozens of machines. Automate & Optimize: You can't click forever. Hire staff ranging from Rookies to Veteran Operators to keep your farm running 24/7. They'll handle print jobs, perform repairs, and prioritize high-value orders while you sit back and watch the profits roll in. Fulfill Orders: Take on contracts for specific prints, from the classic 'Benchy' to complex 'Articulated Dragons.' Balancing bulk orders with daily production is key to maximizing your reputation and income.
row.short_description: Start in a bedroom with one 3D printer and build a manufacturing empire! Manage filaments, upgrade machines, hire staff, and expand into a factory in this addictive idle tycoon game.

row.name: Technofumer
row.detailed_description: Step into the exhilarating world of TechnoFumer, the premier third-person shooter that immerses you in the role of a daring digital hunter! This thrilling, action-packed game tasks you with the mission of tracking down and neutralizing rogue YouTube influencers. Prepare for a heart-racing adventure as you navigate through intricately designed levels, sharpening your skills to achieve the highest scores and secure extraordinary rewards. Access all game statistics, including the Hall of Fame, daily leaderboards, total playtime, player engagement, and much more, at: 🎯 Game Objectives: In TechnoFumer, your objective is clear: secure the highest score within a month to claim spectacular prizes. Explore the digital realms to locate the elusive influencers, now controlled by a mysterious digital virus, and halt their disruptive spree! As the game was initially conceived as a competition, there are no checkpoints; a single death means restarting from the beginning. It requires nerves of steel to complete the game. 💣 Gameplay: Hunt the Infected: Traverse expertly crafted levels, from urban jungles to futuristic cities, in search of the infected influencers. Face a multitude of challenges, including advanced enemy AI and strategic boss encounters. Strategize to Win: Each influencer presents a unique challenge and demands a tailored strategy to overcome. Adjust your tactics dynamically and demonstrate your prowess as a marksman. 🌐 Global Community: Become part of a vibrant community of players. Share tips and experiences across social media platforms, engage in friendly rivalry, forge alliances, and exchange strategies to ascend as the ultimate TechnoFumer champion. Are you prepared to embark on this thrilling journey and showcase your marksmanship against renowned YouTube influencers? Arm yourself, take precise aim, and conquer the TechnoFumer leaderboard today!

row.name: The Last Exodus
row.detailed_description: The Last Exodus is a fast paced turn based strategy made as a sandbox experience. Game has multiple single player story-driven campaigns and a fast paced multiplayer mode where you can play cooperatively with your friends or competitively against your foes. The Last Exodus will have multiple campaigns with persistent fleet where your units and tech from previous missions will be available to you in future ones. As you complete missions your technology will advance and your fleet will grow until you became the unstoppable force in the galaxy. Single Scenario mode will also include a hot seat mode where you can play with your friends on a single device. Every player controls the fleet and the heart of that fleet is your mothership. Mothership is a massive capital ship on which you can build various subsystems which have different functions. Building subsystems on you capital ship you will be able to research new technologies, gather resources and produce various ships to strengthen your fleet. Technology is a very important aspect of the game. Not only will it increase strength of you ships and weapon systems but also unlock new options for designing a new blueprints of ships that can be deployed into battle. Instead of being limited to a number of ship types in you roster, your fleet can adapt to new circumstances during the battle. So you will be able to customize your ship blueprints to better counter enemy fleet. Once you research new chassis and weapon systems, plating and engines, you will be able to combine them into a new killing machine.
row.short_description: Turn-based tactical strategy with massive capital ships, frigates, gunships and fighter squads. Gather resources, research technologies, design and expand your fleet. Destroy your enemies. Single player and multi player mode, hot seat mod also available.

row.name: Haunting Hijinx
row.detailed_description: Haunting Hijinx is a spiritual successor to a classic minigame where one player is a ghost and up to four players are ghost hunters. Haunt a Spooky Mansion Concealed by shadow, you will seek to outwit the ghost hunters and make them faint. A single touch is all it takes, but beware their searing lights! You must be clever if you are to catch the fiends off guard. Your goal is to make all the hunters faint by grabbing them. You are invisible by default. Sprint to gain a helpful speed boost at the expense of being visible. Charge your summon meter to summon a drain area under each hunter. Any hunter that doesn't quickly get away will be defenseless as their battery gets drained. The hunters' flashlight beams will briefly stun you, make you visible, and deal significant damage. Join Forces to Corner the Ghost Each armed with a flashlight, you and your friends will delve into the darkness to hunt down the ghost. Even though you can't see the ghost in the dark, you can sense when it draws near. Stay together; you will not survive alone for long. Your goal is to destroy the ghost by shining your flashlight on it. Your flashlight has limited battery life. You will need to pick up new batteries over time to keep the ghost at bay. You will be alerted when the ghost is nearby, though you should be wary of any tricks it may play to keep you on edge. Teamwork is essential. The ghost can easily outmaneuver a lone hunter but will struggle against a coordinated group. You will faint if the ghost touches you. Shine your flashlight on a downed hunter for a few moments to revive them. In the meantime, take care that you aren't vulnerable to being grabbed yourself!
row.short_description: Outwit your friends as the ghost or cooperate to catch it in this spooky minigame for 2-5 players.

row.name: Last Bloody Snack

Tormented by psychological demons, Cody's journey unfolds in a dark and atmospheric adventure where players must guide him through the dangerous corridors of his haunted home. The game's intense narrative delves into the psychological horror genre as Cody confronts a monstrous entity fueled by an insatiable hunger for revenge. Solve Puzzles, Confront Demons As players step into Cody's shoes, they find themselves in a race against time to escape the clutches of the relentless monster. The game environment, once a place Cody called home, transforms into a treacherous labyrinth full of intricate puzzles and hidden passages. To survive, players must help Cody uncover the secrets binding him to this nightmare reality. Atmospheric tension builds with every step, creating an immersive experience where fear, survival, and self-discovery intertwine.
row.short_description: Cody, haunted by psychological demons, envisions a monstrous threat eliminating all he hates.

row.name: Super Dragon Punch Force 3

Whether you're a fighting game rookie or a seasoned lab monster, fast and fluid combat awaits in spectacular 1-v-1 fights.
