row.name: Bullet Hell Monday: Finale
row.detailed_description: Dive into the thrilling world of bullet hell shooters with 'Bullet Hell Monday: Finale'! Even beginners can enjoy this intense action-packed game, featuring a gentle introduction to the bullet hell genre. Get ready for an authentic bullet hell experience! In 'Bullet Hell Monday: Finale,' players will navigate through a barrage of bullets while taking down enemies. Upgrade your craft and aim to conquer the challenging Chapter Mode. Chapter Mode Embark on various missions in each stage, ranging from simple to challenging. By completing missions like 'Defeat 30 enemies!' you'll unlock boss stages. Defeat the bosses to progress to the next chapter. Craft Upgrades Enhance your craft through a variety of level-up options, including shot power, shot speed, bomb duration, and more. Upgrade your craft and blast through the stages with devastating firepower. Beginner-Friendly The stages start off easy and gradually ramp up in intensity. You are not obligated to clear the difficult missions, so if you find yourself struggling, feel free to try your hand at another mission. Easy Mode In Chapter Mode, you can choose the difficulty level before starting a stage. Opting for Easy mode reduces enemy attacks, making it more manageable to complete the stage. If you find yourself stuck, consider selecting Easy mode for a smoother experience. row.name: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai
row.detailed_description: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and big village-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, monthly events and your dumb ways to die not harming your fun level. 🏹 Survival Games, casualized Chop every tree, hunt rabbits and deer, stone and copper mining - resource management are a staple of every survival game, and Daisho is no different. However, we threw away the hunger games in favor of a replenishing stamina pool so you can start every game session on exploration instead of just preventing yourself from dying. 🏛️ Build your own Japanese village estate From setting up your first camp to building an entire Japanese village, you'll be pretty busy making a home for yourself and all the rescued souls that turn up to settle as workers. Manage their resource refining jobs, build houses and beautify the city with fountains and other decor. ⚔️ Carry a big stick (mind the pointy end) Craft your weaponry from a selection of clubs, katanas, bows, spears and more. Upgrade them to make pointy ends even more pointy, embellish your craft with gems and their attributes, and poke around at the Shogun armies, bandit bosses and other generally unfriendly folk. 🗺️ Explore Japan and its dungeons Dive into dark medieval history and unravel the story of Oda Nobunaga, known as the great Japanese unifier; lead the siege to the stronghold of Kyoto, or rebuild the ancient estates and temples around Mount Fuji. Learning about history has never been more fun! 📅 Enjoy Seasonal Events Keep coming back for freshly designed seasonal events as they happen. Missed one? Don't worry, we've put them into your game progression and keep them fresh every year. 📱 Put Japan in your pocket Not at home? Experience Daisho: Survival of a Samurai on your phone or Steam Deck, fully optimized for the mobile gaming experience. And we're working to make your savegame available fully cross-platform. And many more features to come: Events ⭐ Quests ⭐ Talent Trees ⭐ Coop Building⭐ Mini Games ⭐ Achievements ⭐ Dojo PVP Leaderboards ⭐ Guilds & Chat As developers of Daisho: Survival of a Samurai, we hope you enjoy our casual approach to the Survival RPG genre. We are always happy to get in touch directly with our players and gather feedback - hop onto our Discord: 💬 Thanks and have fun surviving!

row.name: Indigo Park: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Indigo Park Indigo Park is an immersive first-person exploration game that takes you on a thrilling journey through the eerie remnants of an abandoned amusement park. As the protagonist, you will step into the shoes of an adventurous soul eager to uncover the mysteries hidden within this once vibrant and lively attraction. Explore a desolate world where time has stood still, and nature has reclaimed its territory. The amusement park, once filled with joyous laughter and cheerful music, now echoes with haunting silence and faded memories. Guided by an A.I. assistant*, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you avoid the reason it shut down. Once one of the most renowned theme parks of the world, Indigo Park was suddenly shut down after a mysterious, horrific incident. Years later, in a search for nostalgia, you break into the park to explore the abandoned attractions. You may remember this place, but you'll need some help from a special A.I. friend*. Meet Rambley! Previously the park's A.I.-driven* tour guide, Rambley the Raccoon will take over screens and other aspects of the park to communicate with you! Explore the park as you find collectables, secrets, and discover why the park was shut down, all while being guided by Rambley! Find items, solve puzzles, and restore power to the park as you run from the reason it shut down. *Rambley, the AI character is a work of fiction, and is not utilizing actual 'AI', rather stunning 2D animation and voice acting to communicate with the player. Explore! In this first person horror experience, you'll explore the abandoned environment. Follow Rambley's guidance as you uncover secrets hidden inside these ruined walls. Featuring an exciting collectables system, thrilling encounters with the park's residents, and more!
row.short_description: Explore the abandoned childhood wonder of Indigo Park! Guided by Rambley the Raccoon, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you run from the reason it shut down.

row.name: Ur
row.detailed_description: The Royal Game of Ur, also known as Twenty Squares, has a history that stretches over five millennia! Its earliest boards date back to 2500 BCE and examples have been found across the Mediterranean. This game is a 3D computer gameplay experience that takes you into the ancient world. The game board, pieces, and dice are 3D reconstructions of actual ancient examples from museums. This historical game is harder than it looks! This is a race game: speed is of the essence! It brings to a board game the ultimate skill for the merchants, traders, bandits and pirates who drove their fleets and caravans around the ancient world. The goal is to get your counters from start to finish around the board, before your opponent does. Prove your strategic skill! How will you play out your strategies: do you want to put all of your pieces on the board at once, or focus on moving a single piece along? With a good throw of the dice, would you rather move your own counter ahead, or take one of your competitor’s off the board? Watch out, this game was used for ancient divination: you may see a glimpse of your future as you play! Game Features: Desktop or Laptop gameplay via keyboard. Roll virtual dice on each turn and move your pieces around the board. Land on a rosette for an extra turn or land on an AI opponent's piece to trap it. Three different levels of gameplay difficulty through different AI opponents. Three different avatars for gameplay. Built in tutorial. Track your high scores in game. Control your resolution and background music. Educational! Learn about the Royal Game of Ur, a real historical game played around the Mediterranean for thousands of years. Read ancient phrases between players as you play. Free! Use for classes. Project Team: Kylie Gilde - Lead Programmer, Freelance Programmer Dr. Sandra Blakely – Project Director, Emory University, Department of Classics Dr. Joanna C. Mundy – Project Manager, Digital Projects Specialist, Emory Center for Digital Scholarship Kevin Dressel - Technical Architect, Shiny Dolphin Games LLC Dr. Joy Li – Game Development Collaborator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Computer Game Design and Development Craig Brasco – Visual Interface Collaborator and Illustrator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Art | Graphic Communications Evie Wang Edmundson - Freelance Composer and Producer David Herrod - Student Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University (2020) Josh Winston - Trailer, Digital Scholarship Associate, Emory Center for Digital Scholarship

This is a 3D gameplay experience taking you into the ancient world! The game board set is a 3D reconstruction of an ancient example from a museum.

row.name: M.E.A.T. Veterans
row.detailed_description: DEVELOPMENT PLAN - HIGHLIGHTS Currently, M.E.A.T. Veterans is an early access game, which means that work on it is not yet complete. A lot can still change until the full release and launch. Just one month after the title becomes available, the first update will be released with fixes made based on community feedback. We plan to keep up the pace of monthly updates until the release itself*. We will strive to significantly expand M.E.A.T. Veterans and in addition to a number of technical improvements, we also plan to create new maps, the first arena or an increase in the selection of models and weapons, as well as several special features, including additional game modes and further social features.. The official M.E.A.T. Veterans server will be announced after the first update. *Critical issues, however, will be fixed as soon as possible, regardless of the assumed update schedule. About the Game After M.E.A.T. RPG and the announcement of its sequel in the form of M.E.A.T. II Absolute Zero (whose free demo is already available!), the time has come for another title. M.E.A.T. Veterans is a fully free-to-play online action game that will take you back to the fantastic world explored through the pixel art RPG from the M.E.A.T. universe. Get ready for a lot of new features! This time you won't be hiding behind the back of Sir Dunkan Culligan. Instead of impersonating a character, you will remain yourself. And you'll be the only one you can count on to fight the enemy. Well, unless you decide to form an alliance and fight in the name of the team. However, you must be ready for anything, because the enemy never sleeps. And he can quickly revive. And most importantly, know that it can be anyone. Even your existing friend. Why? Because in M.E.A.T. Veterans you'll be up against a formidable opponent - the opponent on the other side of the screen! M.E.A.T. Veterans is a multiplayer shooter, and that means you'll face not just NPCs, but the truest players. Well, unless you're initially afraid of confrontation - there's nothing stopping you from testing your mettle against Bots beforehand. Nevertheless, your time will come, so start training now! Currently, you can do this on two maps. One is the familiar Sudbury town from the M.E.A.T. RPG, and the other is the MBS XII Sect Crypt. There are four gameplay modes to choose from: Team Deathmatch (a team game characterised by quick respawns - the team with the most enemies defeated wins), Deathmatch (an individual game with random respawn and 3-second spawn protection). You have a variety of weapons at hand, including a revolver, shotgun, rotary machine gun, crossbow, dynamite, smoke grenade and even a Molotov cocktail or Tomahawk. But that's not all your options. The list of weapons will continue to grow with future updates. However, you already have the opportunity to fully customise your weapons with skins and stickers available in the shop, as well as extensive settings, for example in the form of a customised sight. You can also individualise your profile with avatars, badges and achievements. You will also be able to make your presence felt - for example through the spray system, but also, and perhaps above all, through the possibility of saving your position in the global player ranking. A significant improvement, especially in the team game modes, is the voice chat, thanks to which you will be able to keep in touch with other players.

row.name: Gutasaga
row.detailed_description: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game HISTORICAL WORLD The game is set in the 6th century AD. The map is based on historical prototypes of that time, and all locations, buildings, ships, and items are inspired by historical findings. If you are interested in the historical background of anything in the game, it is ready to provide you with answers. FIRST-PERSON NARRATIVE Immerse yourself fully in the game. Everything that happens in the game is described from the perspective of the main character of that time. Paganism, which would later be replaced by other religions, was the dominant belief at that time, and the game allows you to see the world and historical events from a different angle. EXPLORATION A vast territory is open for exploration from the very beginning, without limiting your actions. The world is filled with historically unique locations, goods, and factions. Explore the world and discover rare artifacts that will aid you in the game. TRADE SYSTEM Trade with various factions throughout the map for profit or the development of your settlement. Find unique goods that are not available in other settlements or even discover items for which others are willing to pay five times the price. RAIDS AND PIRACY If you need to quickly acquire different resources, goods, coins, or artifacts, remember the path of force. Gather a crew and raid other settlements along the coast or along rivers. Study the routes of trading vessels to launch surprise attacks and seize ships. REAL-TIME COMBAT SYSTEM Engage in battles with your assembled team against enemies from different factions. Use various artifacts and items in combat to achieve success. If a challenging battle takes place on the water, knowledge of your own and the enemy's ship will play a decisive role. SANDBOX Buildings in settlements will be randomly generated at the start of the game. This means that each new game will be unique, providing a fresh gameplay experience. You will have to make decisions regarding the placement of your buildings, considering the availability and demand for goods in other settlements. LIVING WORLD Both you and NPCs will influence the development of all settlements. The more you trade and satisfy the needs of a specific tribe, the faster it will progress. Resources obtained by NPCs do not disappear from the game but remain with them and can be used for the development of their own settlements. Each settlement has a level that determines the amount of available land for buildings, and each building has its own level, which improves its functions with development. SHIP MANAGEMENT Journeys need to be well-planned and prepared; otherwise, they can end in disaster. Consider the carrying capacity of your ship, efficiently manage your supplies, allocate funds for the maintenance of the crew, and monitor their health. UPGRADING YOUR SETTLEMENT You will have the opportunity to build your own settlement, but remember that its territory is limited, and you cannot have all the buildings at once. Prioritize wisely and develop your settlement to increase the construction area and gain access to unique goods and artifacts. CRAFTING If you have a desire to create something with your own hands, you can do so in one of the dedicated crafting buildings, such as a forge, weaving workshop, shipyard, carpentry workshop, or tannery. You will need to find all the necessary components for crafting, which won't be easy, but the resulting items will have better stats. COMPANIONS A unique companion - slave, wife, or other character- will assist you in everyday tasks to make your gameplay easier. You can assign this unit to a building to improve its stats. Additionally, companions will help you with weekly tasks that appear in the settlement.
row.short_description: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game. Immerse yourself in the 550 - 600 AD saga. Be the Viking who opened trade routes with Constantinople. Encounter over 40 nations with unique cultures on your journey. Succeed in trading 205 historically recreated goods. Or try raids and piracy.

row.name: Cecelia
row.detailed_description: Delve into the mysterious beauty of a daunting and surreal setting. Cecelia is an ephemeral, atmospheric adventure offering a captivating blend of first-person exploration, platforming, and leaning on an unlikely giant companion. Waking up on the coast of a fantastical island laden with basalt columns, searing lava flows, and perilous cliffs, you find yourself stranded, left to unravel your presence and purpose. However, your journey is not one of solitude. You unearth a magical rock that awakens a colossal stone baby, whose origin is as mysterious as the island itself. The giant’s size is both a challenge and an advantage, as you'll need to maneuver and use her immense stature to negotiate the challenging environment. But Cecelia is still learning, and she’ll need your help to survive the island’s hazards as well. Each step and leap forward brings you closer to understanding the island’s secrets, and the entity within the distant, foreboding lighthouse. More than just a game, Cecelia is a journey of introspection, exploring trust and interdependence.
row.short_description: A mysterious island. A giant baby made of stone awakens. Learn to trust each other if you want to explore the perilous terrain, seeking answers from the island's enigmatic call and an ominous force awaiting you in the distant lighthouse.

row.detailed_description: 【AHSARAH】SEASON EVENTS AND REWARDS About the Game Delta Force is back! The iconic series returns as the definitive free-to-play modern team-based tactical shooter, and featuring three distinct gameplay modes: - Warfare: battle the enemy across land, sea and air in truly epic 32 v 32 PvP combat, featuring a wide range of vehicles and unique tactical gear. - Operations: Delta Force meets the next generation extraction shooter as you deploy behind enemy lines with your squad, search for valuables, take on rival players, and extract before it’s too late. Alternatively, our PvE Raid mode offers challenging objective-based missions designed to push your squad to the limit. - Black Hawk Down: step into the boots of legendary Delta Force operators for this remake of the classic series campaign based on the gripping 2001 movie.  We are committed to NO PAY-TO-WIN and development is driven by community feedback. And remember… “No-one gets left behind” Words from the Game Director, Shadow Guo As a player: Delta Force was the first shooter I ever played, igniting my passion for the genre. I'm extremely grateful for the opportunity to create Delta Force, and my goal is to share that unforgettable joy with even more players. I hope this new Delta Force game will become the tactical FPS experience I dreamt of all those years ago. As a Game Director: We're pushing Unreal Engine to its limits to deliver a truly cross-platform experience that allows players worldwide to immerse themselves in a vivid world of deep characters, explosive destruction, and top-notch action...all worthy of the 'Delta Force' name. Join me in crafting a game for all Delta Force players - Delta Force, a game for us all.

row.name: Bot Crisis
row.detailed_description: Put your wits and acting skills to the ultimate test! In this 3D online game, players are transported to a variety of captivating stages. The goal? To identify which of the characters are real players and who's just pretending to be a bot! Gameplay Identify real players : Can you discern who's a real player and who's an expertly disguised bot? Behave as a bot : To avoid detection, you must behave as a bot yourself. This means moving around randomly and avoiding doing anything that would make you stand out. Expose the players : There are animals and other hazards that can expose the real players. For example, some innocently annoying animals will only approach real players. Owls that only follow real players! Competition leaderboard. Features Multiple stages : The game features multiple stages, including a farm, a desert, a haunted forest, a snow level, and a battlefield. Customization : You can customize your appearance, including your skin color and clothing. Chat : You can chat with other players. Though it is up to you whether to help them or fool them :). Leaderboard : Compete on a global leaderboard to become the ultimate Bot Crisis champion! Cross-play Players using PC and players using mobile can play together. Humor The game is full of humor, with funny animals and other hazards that can expose the players. This makes the game both challenging and fun. FAQs Is the game multiplayer or single player? Yes the game is an online multiplayer game. However, you can also play it alone if you only want to discover the stages. How many players can play in a single room? Up to 10 players can play in the same room. Is the leaderboard global? Yes the leaderboard is global. Compete with everyone to become the number one in the world! Do I need to play it with my friends or can I find random people to play with? Both. You can play it with your friends or with random people. You can also discover the stages alone.
row.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a bot in a game… well now is your chance! Grab Bot Crisis now and see if you can trick actual people into thinking your a bot!

row.name: Pixel Royale 3D
row.detailed_description: Ever imagined a world where mechanical skill and actually playing the game was what mattered? Yeah, we have too. We grew up playing pixel shooters for most of our childhood, and we've had to watch the genre shift in a way that isn't healthy for the community. So we decided to take the genre in a better direction. We made Pixel Royale to gather the community to a place where they can have fun with the genre again, and most importantly where their voices can be heard again. One of our main goals is to build the game around the community, after all, without a community, there wouldn't be a game! Pixel Royale  is a pixelated FPS with a high focus on aim and strategy . With 6 categories to use in-game, there are virtually endless combinations to fit any play-style. Maybe you want a balanced loadout with good consistent damage for anywhere from short to long-range, or maybe you want to just rocket jump around and shotgun people in the face. We won't judge! Primary: Your main consistent and (usually) reliable weapon. Shotguns, Rifles, SMGs, you name it, we got it. Secondary: Switching to your secondary is always faster than reloading, but sometimes they can hold their own. Melee: Most people just pull them out to run faster, but if you can get up close they won't even see it coming. Experimental: As the name suggests, these are the most unique weapons, but also the most difficult to use. Sniper: Find a good spot, start scoping, and give your enemies a swift end. After all, professionals have standards. Explosive: Pesky enemy hiding behind a corner? Send a rocket their way. See a group of enemies? Send a rocket their way. Don't feel like aiming? Send a rocket their way. It's also important to build your loadout on the map you decide to play in. River Battlefield: A large battleground divided in 2 by a river. With plenty of peeking spots, this map is perfect for avid snipers. Night Battlefield: River Battlefield, but dark! Prison: A close-quarters map with plenty of corners and hallways to hide behind. Keep a sharp eye out and watch your back! Pixel Manor: A medium-sized map with 2 fortresses for each team. Shoot through the windows, get on top of the buildings, or sneak into enemy territory. Space Station: A large indoor map with winding corridors and a maze-like design. Have your gun ready any time you turn a corner! Cargo: A small and chaotic battlefield with few places to hide. Be quick on your feet and ready for anything to end victorious. Pixel Royale  is frequently updated with active support from the developers for any problem you may be facing. Updates can range from cool content and quality of life adjustments to huge new features and changes. But there aren't only practical customizations, your character and every weapon have tons of skins available to fully configure your loadout. Don't forget the skin creator for creating skins in-game and the skin importer for importing skins from other games of a similar 'blocky-quality'. So if you feel the well's run dry for pixel shooters, download the game and join our effort to bring pixel shooters back to what they were, and beyond!
row.short_description: Ever imagined a world where mechanical skill and actually playing the game was what mattered? Yeah, we have too. Pixel Royale is a pixelated FPS with a high focus on aim and strategy, and is actively updated with the features that the community requests the most.

row.name: Little Shrimp：Legend Reborn
row.detailed_description: This is a highly immersive role-playing game set in the martial arts world, and the existence of this world is shaped by you. Here, you can experience classic storylines from famous martial arts novels, and enjoy a variety of entertaining gameplay systems, whether it's the thrilling life of martial arts or the leisurely farming life – the choice is yours. In the martial world, bonds between people are inseparable, and stories collide with one another. The game features hundreds of NPCs, each with their own stories waiting for you to discover and explore. As you, still green behind the ears, step into this world, what kind of stories await you? Can you feel a sense of belonging in this martial world? This is the story of Little Shrimp. [Game Features] The martial world is full of mysteries, with intense battles and numerous sects. The game gathers various classic martial arts techniques from famous novels, covering both internal and external skills. The combination of martial arts, tactics, and the synergy between martial arts and heroes requires strategic thinking. Why not showcase your skills and demonstrate your superior martial arts strategy, young hero? [Chosen Ones, Embrace the Gifts] Every hero who arrives here is chosen by fate. However, Little Shrimp martial world doesn't follow the usual path. The chosen ones are entitled to generous gifts. Accept this VIP10 and a heap of gold and silver treasures on your journey. There are even more treasures waiting for you to explore and unearth along the way. [Humorous Martial World, Fun Everywhere] Little Shrimp martial world not only recreates classic scenes from famous martial arts novels but also adds its own unique flavor. Don't miss any corner of the martial world, as it is filled with surprises and hidden Easter eggs. While wandering through the martial world, you might unexpectedly encounter flower-picking bandits, money-robbing villains, or witness a fierce battle between two tigers. What choices will you make as a young hero? Will you fuel the chaos, rescue those in danger, or stand by and watch? Who said there's only one choice, after all, life is about having fun! [Six Years of Crafting, Masterpiece of Ingenuity] Six years in the making, this game boasts a mature and comprehensive system. The game's features are diverse and well-developed, ensuring that monotony and predictability have no place in the game. The retro art style, coupled with martial arts-themed background music, and a variety of gameplay modes – once you dive in, it's hard to pull yourself out. [Martial Arts Mastery, Intelligence and Valor] Come and experience the mysteries of martial arts, which involve not only physical but also mental challenges. The choice of formations, the pairing of heroes, the influence of secret techniques, and the timing of skill releases – all require a sharp mind. Engage in exhilarating sparring sessions with other martial artists in the martial arts competition. The stage is set, waiting for you, young heroes, to showcase your skills. [Entertaining Gameplay, Free Exploration] Practices, adventures, dual cultivation, and inheritance – the martial world is full of stories waiting to be uncovered. Sect conflicts, gang invasions, and the pursuit of villains paint a colorful picture of life in the game. Sometimes, stepping away from the conflicts, cultivating fields, running a tavern, or leveling up through AFK activities allows for a relaxed and enjoyable experience. May your journey in Little Shrimp martial world, which is filled with excitement and discoveries! Little Shrimp Team
row.short_description: Little Shrimp：Legend Reborn is a captivating Wuxia idle RPG that offers an open-world concept and an engaging storyline. With its free exploration of the Jianghu, leisurely gameplay, and auto-leveling fun, you'll have a blast with high levels of character involvement.

row.name: Nothorian
row.detailed_description: Nothorian: The Eternal Conflict between Heaven and Hell At the dawn of creation, when the cosmos was still a blank canvas, two opposing forces emerged: the Gods, guardians of light and life, and the Lords of Hell, personifications of darkness and destruction. For eons, these two factions waged an endless war, a cycle of epic battles that shook the foundations of reality. The Gods, with their divine power and dominion over creation, often emerged victorious from these clashes. However, their nature was tied to the very structure of the universe, and over time, this structure began to weaken, taking the Gods' power with it. Unlike them, the Lords of Hell possessed a sinister quality: the ability to rise from their ashes, again and again, after each defeat. The Age of Divine Twilight In the current age, the cosmic balance has tilted dangerously. The heavens, once bastions of divine power, have darkened, and the Gods, weakened by the passage of time and the wear and tear of countless battles, are on the brink of extinction. The Lords of Hell, sensing the vulnerability of their eternal enemies, have seized this opportunity to unleash their fury upon the mortal world. Hordes of demons and infernal creatures emerge from the depths, sowing chaos and destruction in their wake. The mortal realms, once protected by divine vigilance, now find themselves at the mercy of dark forces. Nothorian is an action-adventure roguelike set in a vast, dark world where despair and courage battle for supremacy. Explore the regions of Talanar, Nuteron, and Aeronian, from the withered hills to the fields of eternal ice, as you uncover the secrets that led to Nothorian's downfall. Face spectral enemies, corrupted creatures, and forgotten horrors as you advance your power through a dynamic system of unique abilities and choices that shape the course of the story. Nothorian es un roguelike/roguelite de acción y aventuras ambientado en un vasto y oscuro mundo donde la desesperación y el coraje luchan por la supremacía. Explora las regiones de Talanar, Nuteron y Aeonian, desde las colinas marchitas hasta los campos de hielo eterno, mientras descubres los secretos que llevaron a la perdición hasta la isla de Zhaval. Enfréntate a enemigos espectrales, criaturas corruptas y horrores olvidados mientras mejoras tu poder mediante un sistema de combate dinámico, habilidades únicas y decisiones que marcan el curso de la historia.
row.short_description: Nothorian is a dark [MMOJRPG-Single player], a role-playing game in a vast universe, focused on action.

A handful of mighty Spartan warriors are ready to fight and stop the fierce enemies. Warrior Next is a simple and intuitive action game with gameplay that takes seconds to figure out. Hordes of enemies will come from everywhere and you will need to level up as much as possible before going hunting for the mythological beast. Move your Spartans in 8 directions. Your attacks will be automatic so you'll only have to worry about avoiding enemies and carefully choosing which weapon and skill you want to upgrade. Be careful because once you lose all your Spartans the game is over and you will have to restart the level from the beginning! CONTROLS: - 'WASD' to move. - 'ENTER' to confirm the selections. - 'P' to pause the game. - 'ESC' to quit. STARTER TIPS: - Find more Spartans as soon as possible! They have been taken prisoner, free them! - Defeat the weakest enemies first! - On the sides of the level there are very dangerous enemies. Leave the center part of the map when you are strong enough!

row.name: Cosmic Clash
row.detailed_description: Cosmic Clash is minimalistic arcade shooter where you battle your friends in the star fighter of your choosing. Dodge or destroy enemy munitions with precision flying and shooting or defensive utility, while you weave your way through random events. Be the last player standing and become Clash champion. Play local multiplayer, online, or in a mix with local players connecting on the host machine. Remote play supported.
row.short_description: Battle your friends for space superiority in this arcade style space shooter. Select your star fighter and jump into Cosmic Clash where you try and eliminate your friends while surviving the perils of space.

row.name: 我想要你的心
row.detailed_description: This is a platform jumping game. You can win the girl's heart by collecting gold coins and hearts. Be careful of hearts and monsters that will hurt people on the road. Collect hearts!
row.short_description: This is a platform jumping game. You can experience happiness in it. If the game often flashes back, you can use Windows Compatibility mode to select Windows 7 to run

row.name: Monday Meltdown
row.detailed_description: It's time for a Monday Meltdown. A solo-developed, super-fast 8-player top-down shooter built for one thing: dominating your friends . Inspired by classics like Hotline Miami and Soldat , and spiced up with plenty of gore. Dominate your friends or foes in a variety of fast-paced gamemodes. Host or join a match and you're straight into the action—no waiting around. Got no friends? Bots are supported. Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons  that all serve a specific purpose -  Good plays win the game, not just the gear you're holding If you're on a killing-spree, killstreak  weapons will be awarded ensuring chaos unfolds Winning is cool, but winning with style is better. Unlock new character and weapon skins to look good doing it. Add salt with taunts and custom killphrases , or hunt for cool in-game secrets to unlock exclusive skins. Are your ready to melt some Mondays?
row.short_description: Fast. Bloody. 8-Player Mayhem. Dominate. Taunt. Repeat. Free. No strings attached. Ever.
row.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Potions & Emotions
row.detailed_description: Potions & Emotions is an indie visual novel created by a small team of student developers. Accompany Thalia--an aspiring alchemist and wannabe super villain--who is hell-bent on taking over the entire planet. She travels to a magical forest in order to collect raw materials for her alchemy projects, and stumbles upon a sleepy town hidden within. After seeing this and recognizing the potency of the magic surrounding this town, she decides to start small and set up her secret lair within its walls by taking over as the town’s next mayor.
row.short_description: Potions and Emotions is a creative game where you play the conscience of the villain. Join Thalia—a fae with big ambitions—who intends to take over a town hidden in a magical forest. Whether her shoulder angel or devil, you get to guide her actions and witness the consequences of your choices.
publishers: John Paul the Great Catholic University

row.name: Thursday Nite Thunkin'
row.detailed_description: Mark February 22 in the history books since my dog turned five today and I finished TNT. IT'S TIME to Thunk on a Thursday Nite with the best rhythm game in 22 years! Follow Jim-Bob's day, which includes: Six levels that all play differently! (Two coming soon in updates) Uniquely animated cutscenes for each level, done in several different styles! An entertaining story! T.N.T. is pretty short, and will most likely only take around an hour to complete, which is why it's free. I doubt anybody would buy it if it costed money. But the whole TNTeam put a lot of effort into this game and we hope you enjoy it!
row.short_description: I'm not sure why there are two descriptions but pretend I put something really funny here

row.name: TriFute - Online Button Soccer
row.detailed_description: A New Spin on Button Soccer TriFute offers a dynamic button soccer gameplay, where every button can move in real time. Key Features: Thrilling button soccer gameplay. Full player control over every button. Play local multiplayer. Play online. Planned Improvements: Better Artificial Intelligence. Graphical improvements. *The game doesn't have a single player mode against the AI
row.short_description: TriFute, a unique button soccer game, allows you to play dynamic matches against online opponents or local multiplayer.

row.name: Pow Vista
row.detailed_description: Level up in a real-time online world with other players, unlocking new skateboards and hoodies as you go. Get XP in over 10 skills, each opening up new abilities and ways to play the game. Every mob has its own loot table, so even the weakest foe can drop rare items for your PowDex. There’s also a chance that mob might drop an egg that hatches into a pal to follow you and help out.
row.short_description: Enter an MMORPG where skateboarding is tied directly to combat, gathering, and crafting. Level up elemental skills, chase rare drops, and build your legend as an early player. Play how you want with optional PvP, zero pay-to-win, and frequent updates shaped by the community.

row.name: BOOMEROAD
row.detailed_description: ■『BOOMEROAD』 BOOMEROAD is an exhilarating action-adventure game in which players slide along boomerang rails you will create. You will be playing as the main character, Boomy. Boomy has to reach a tower with a mysterious boomerang while overcoming the obstacles and aims for the Ancient Tower. ▼A new experience in the vast sky The game is set in an ancient ruin floating in the sky, and the player slides through the vast skies at their own will while searching for the Artifacts. ▼Aiming, throwing, and sliding. Easy operation and exhilarating action The exhilarating action with the 'rail-drawing boomerang' is the charm of this game. ▼Numerous gimmicks to make the action more fun You will aim for the Ancient Tower with the boomerang while dodging lasers and using a blower to generate wind on several occasions. ■'TimeAttackMode' to test your skills Choose efficient routes and skillfully handle boomerangs to reach the goal quickly. ■The setting is an ancient ruin floating in the sky The game is set in an ancient ruin floating in the sky. Boomy, a young archaeologist boy, visits the ruins as he believes in the legend that there are hidden treasures of an ancient civilization in the towers of the ruins. Using one of the ruin's artifacts, a boomerang that can draw rails, he adventures through the ruins, which are shrouded in the veil of secrecy. ▼The Ancient City area is where you can enjoy the clear sky ▼The Ancient Fortress City area is where you can immerse yourself in the shining moonlit night view ▼Collect the 'Oparts' hidden in the ancient ruins
row.short_description: BOOMEROAD is an exhilarating action-adventure game in which players slide along boomerang rails you will create. The game is set in an ancient ruin floating in the sky, and the player slides through the vast skies at their own will while searching for the Artifacts.

row.name: NOTTOLOT
row.detailed_description: NOTTOLOT is a robot hacking action game. Use the main character's ability to hack enemy robots to escape from the factory! 　 ■Exhilarating hacking action Control enemy robots with the main character's ability to hack them. Sneak up from behind...tackle and hack! ■Enemy robots with various functions Fly in the sky, climb walls, and more, Manipulate enemies to break through gimmicks and clear all three stages! ■Tense factory escape The main character 'Rolly' longs for the outside world. Can he escape from the robot production factory guarded by enemy robots?
row.short_description: NOTTOLOT is a free play robot hacking action game. The main character, Rolly, uses his 'hacking ability' to control four enemies and escape from a robot production factory!

row.name: DORONKO WANKO
row.detailed_description: 『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game. In this game, you can become a cute, innocent pomeranian. And you can make your master's home messy and dirty. Let's explore this beautiful house and make it dirty and muddy at will! Pomeranian can get muddy by 'rubbing' against the 'mud' spread on the floor. Spread out the mud with 'splash'! Let's make the whole area muddy and messy. Sometimes you can find 'hidden pome' when you are spreading mud all over the house. When you find all the 'hidden pome', the 'Good Smell Room' 's door will open. (Let's go inside quietly before others notice!) More mud, more damage! You can check the total amount of damage you have caused from the ending “Receipt”. When you cause enough damage, you will receive a “gift”?! They will help Pome’s exploration by making it easier to splash mud and obtain key items. A little action can cause a huge damage? Use personal appliances and toys to get even muddier. The Pomeranian's adventures will remain as a 'badge of memory'. A random move may get an unexpected badge. 'Put on' the 'Goods' and make your Pomeranian more pretty. Don't forget the special goods that can release mud!
row.short_description: 『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game. In this game, You can become a cute, innocent Pomeranian, make your master's home messy and dirty. 'Will the master be angry with me?' Don't worry. Because you are a sweet doggie.

row.name: Fight! Olyn Island
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord We value your opinion, so if you have any feedback on the game, or if you need any help, feel free to join our Discord. Game Features Smooth and detailed fighting scenes featuring brand new 3D modeling & immersive experience into a fantasy world of animal chess pieces. A game that can live up to every little bit of your imagination of auto chess. Easy to play, fast-paced, and strategy-oriented. There are even Runes, Hero DIY, and other new and well-designed elements, created all for your best experience! A great number of Geos and different types allow you to adopt a wide range of strategies so that victory and defeat are instantly reversed following each and every move of yours on the battlefield! Whether it's the interplay of stats and special effects or the position arrangement of Geos, everything remains essential to victory! Come participate in the PvP modes, Match, Ranked, and Championship! The thrilling battles are always on! Do you dare to invite your friends to fight together and become the top auto-battler player?
row.short_description: Explore the mysterious Olyn Island! Play against other players and use cute animal heroes towards victory!

row.name: To Have and to Hold
row.detailed_description: Yuel’s life is a mess. He’s twenty-eight years old, he works a boring office job, and he’s barely scraping by with his limited finances. Throw in the fact that his wealthy father disowned him almost a decade ago, then died six months prior, and his life really couldn’t be any worse… Or could it? After being invited to his aunt’s wedding, Yuel reconnects with his handsome, easygoing older cousin, Tavi. A string of unfortunate circumstances lead Yuel to sharing a hotel room with Tavi for the wedding, and (more worryingly) the same bed. With emotions running high and fancy champagne in abundance, what will happen next? The answer: something Yuel will probably regret. 40k words of text (approx 2-4 hours of reading) A linear story with no choices or branches Detailed character and background art A cute BL story about a couple of cousins Drunken confessions Emotional angst Sex!
row.short_description: A short boys love / yaoi / gay visual novel about a couple of cousins whose paths cross at a family wedding. They both get a little drunk, emotions run high, and things take a surprisingly steamy turn.
row.notes: This visual novel contains coarse language, cursing, scenes of alcohol consumption, and a sex scene of dubious consent which takes place between two adult characters when they are both drunk. The main couple in this story are also first cousins.

row.name: Pawggle
row.detailed_description: One simple rule: Eliminate all the red pegs from the game board before running out of balls. Pawggle is a casual Peggle/Pachinko style game but, this time, you step away from the visor. Step into a world where you become the guiding hand for your furry companions, aiding them by strategically placing blue pegs. Features: Assist five adorable fur creatures Conquer a series of challenging levels ensuring you never run out of balls Exercise your skill and try being number one on the leaderboard Join the fun and experience the joy of Pawggle as you master the art of the peg!
row.short_description: Pawggle is a physics puzzle game. Help poor-sighted adorable fur creatures by strategically positioning your pegs and immerse yourself in a joyous furry symphony.

row.name: eWorlds
row.detailed_description: Embark on the ultimate intergalactic adventure! Crash-landed on a mysterious tropical island, you find yourself in the heart of Lost World —a place teeming with secrets, challenges, and hidden treasures. Your mission? To uncover the Loops that will unlock the gateway to the Space HUB , a vast interdimensional nexus connecting a lot of worlds —each with its own unique theme, challenges, and lore. A quest for the legendary Golden Loop In eWorlds, every step you take is part of an epic quest to find the legendary Golden Loop . But this journey isn’t for the faint of heart: each world you explore brings its own set of puzzles to solve, traps to dodge, and mysteries to unravel. Whether you’re racing against the clock in thrilling time trials or simply soaking in the diverse landscapes, every moment is packed with excitement. Collectathon enthusiasts , rejoice! eWorlds is a love letter to the classic platformers that captivated our hearts. As you delve into each world, you'll find exciting new ways to interact with the environment, revealing hidden paths and secrets that were once out of reach. Power-ups: your key to mastering Equip powerful Power-Ups to tackle the game’s challenges! Smash through barriers with the Hammer , soar through the skies with the Umbrella , or use the Grappling Hook to navigate treacherous terrain. These Power-Ups aren’t just upgrades—they’re essential tools for overcoming obstacles and discovering every Loop . Share the adventure But the adventure doesn’t have to be a solo one. eWorlds lets you share the journey with friends in cooperative play . Team up to tackle the multiverse’s toughest challenges, strategize to collect every Loop , and uncover secrets that might just be impossible to find on your own. Customize your journey As you traverse these worlds, don’t forget to collect coins scattered throughout your journey. These coins can be spent in the in-game store, where you’ll find an array of skins to customize your character. Mix and match to create a look that’s uniquely yours, and show off your style as you explore the multiverse ! What awaits you in eWorlds: Collectathon glory: : Gather Loops in each world and unlock the path to the ultimate prize—the legendary Golden Loop. Diverse worlds: From the tropical mysteries of Lost World to the futuristic landscapes of Alienware Station, each world is distinct and packed with surprises. Time trials & Challenges: Push your skills to the limit in thrilling time trials and face a variety of challenges designed to test your wits and reflexes. Power-Ups: Discover and equip powerful items that give you new abilities, making you stronger and more versatile as you progress. Cooperative play: Share the adventure with friends, combining your strengths to overcome the most formidable obstacles and unlock every secret. Unlockable Worlds: Explore and conquer each world to unlock the next, uncovering the mysteries of the multiverse one Loop at a time. Customization: Collect coins across different worlds and use them in the store to get a variety of skins. Mix and match to show off your unique style! Important note: We will only be providing support in English and Spanish, but we have automatically translated the game into other languages to enhance the experience for everyone (French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Korean, Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese). However, please keep in mind that this is not a professional translation and may contain errors.
row.short_description: Get ready for an intergalactic adventure in eWorlds! After a crash, you’re stuck on a tropical island. Grab the Loops to unlock the Space HUB, which will open up exciting worlds. Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover mysteries, solo or with friends. Are you up for the legendary Golden Loop quest?

row.name: The Forest of Conx
row.detailed_description: The Forest of Conx is a survival horror tower defense game, where you have came to a forest to find a mysterious creature named 'Conx', unfortunately, this task isn't as easy as once planned.. Features in The Forest of Conx: -Exploration The vast forest provides lots of environments to explore -foraging Before night hits you must collect a descent amount of globs, these globs will allow you to buy towers to defend yourself -Upgrades The makeshift cabin you hunker in has many uninstalled upgrades that you can use to better your chances of survival -Progressive Difficulty The difficult of enemies increases as the days go by, make sure to not overstay your welcome in the woods.. -Towers There are many Towers you can buy and place around your cabin, these towers will defend you from creatures once night hits.. -Challenge and Freeplay Modes Even after you complete the main story, there are still more things to do! Such as mods, the level editor, challenge mode, or the freeplay menu. Some other things to keep in mind: -Your cabin has a limited power supply, make sure to recharge power via the fusebox outside. -There's a large cave system underneath the forest, make sure to explore these tunnels thoroughly -Be aware of flash floods and other disasters! -Beware Conx...
row.short_description: The Forest of Conx: A spooky noir styled survival horror tower defense game

row.name: The PenguinGame 2 -Lies of Penguin-
row.detailed_description: Pass the trials of the penguin wise men and save Antarctica! The Penguin Game2 : Lies of Penguin is an action game made with a deep impression of the soul-like genre. The story of the penguin hero's desperate struggle to save Antarctica, a total of 7 types of high difficulty boss battles, and 2 endings have been implemented. Human destruction of the environment has caused the earth's temperature to rise. Antarctica is turning into an environment where the glaciers are melting, making it difficult for penguins to live. You appear in a hopeless penguin village after pulling a legendary club from a rock. Pass the trials of the 4 penguin wise men and awaken as a hero! You are the only penguin who can save Antarctica from crisis and take revenge on humans.
row.short_description: The heroic penguin pulled the legendary club from the rock. pass the ordeal! Revenge on humans! Save Antarctica in crisis! The Penguin Game2 : Lies of Penguin is an action game made with a deep impression of the soul-like genre. Challenge a total of 7 types of boss battles!

row.name: Keepers Of The Lost Arts
row.detailed_description: This game is an endless runner set in a Medieval town and time. We understand that running can be rather tiring, so you can also just walk and enjoy that medieval vibe. Just watch out for those oncoming horses! If you want to collect some loot along your jogging route, we've got you covered. Coins and gems, and someday we'll have scrolls about lost arts. How do I win? It's endless. You win when you're done chilling with the game. Can I shoot or beat up bad guys? Oh nonono... none of that here. We just jogging along. Or walking. And running. And also sliding. Like, under obstacles. Oh yeah, and jumping over stuff. Just run forward? Yeah, pretty much. You can also go sideways. As in left or right. In fact, it's recommended. And jumping way up and sliding under stuff, as was made clear a few the sentences ago.
row.short_description: This is an endless runner set in a Medieval town and time.

row.name: Project Z: The beginning of the end. Chapter I
row.detailed_description: Project Z is a TopDown view Tower & Defense game, set in a post apocalyptic city from the future. The title is exclusively developed for PC by Parisi Interactive Games. The game system consists of defending a shelter while placing traps to defend yourself from zombie attacks. We transport you to the year 2025, where a human experiment laboratory tries to develop a substance that would bring the dead back to life. But whose experiment hasn't gone quite right, and now the world isn't what it once knew. Our character (Leonard) faces alone against waves of zombies whose objective is to attack the shelter, to contain these attacks, Leonard will place traps throughout the levels and use the few weapons that he possesses. Special features: To get the use of the traps, you must collect lots of money that you will find distributed in the levels or by killing the zombies. The weapons you will use will be provided by non-playable characters Explore the level to get an idea of the key points marked on the map to prepare your defense Play slowly, since the waves are not automatic, you must press the wave call button. Contains moderate violence and gore
row.short_description: Tower & Defense game, with TopDown view set in a post apocalyptic world of zombies

row.name: Salaryman RESCUE!
row.detailed_description: 🏙️ About this game VR-exclusive Salaryman RESCUE! plunges you into the vibey, citypop-kissed streets of Tokyo, tasked with guiding wave after wave of groggy salarymen to safety - by any means necessary! Use zany physics toys and automation management to solve wave after wave of puzzles, avoiding the Tokyo traffic and the looming threat of UFO abduction! --- 🍺 Key Features 🎵 Citypop Vibes: Soak in neon-lit vibes and a wavey, dreamy aesthetic, perfectly capturing that citypop nostalgia! 👨🏻‍💼Save the Salarymen!: Endless waves of tipsy office workers need your help to get home safely. 🧩 Challenging Waves & Puzzles: Every wave presents a unique challenge, each with multiple solutions. It’s up to you to strategize, experiment, and find the most efficient way to guide the salarymen safely home. 🚗 Ragdoll Hilarity: Stay alert! The bustling traffic isn’t kind to our inebriated salarymen. It might be hilarious, but try to avoid letting speeding vehicles send them ragdolling across the streets. 🛸 Watch Out For UFOs: Safeguard the skies and thwart UFOs attempting to abduct the wandering salarymen, using a variety of tools and tactics. 🪙 Coin-Operated Mechanics: Explore the vibrant streets to discover hidden coins - then use them in various coin-operated machines to unlock new strategies and solutions. --- Ready to embark on a neon-soaked adventure? These salarymen ain't gonna rescue themselves! Grab your VR headset and join the rescue mission today!
row.short_description: Dive into VR-exclusive Salaryman RESCUE!, a puzzle-management game set in the neon streets of Tokyo. Guide inebriated salarymen to safety, manipulate coin-operated machines, dodge bustling traffic, and thwart UFO abductions, all while soaking in the unique citypop atmosphere!

row.name: Dark Lord
row.detailed_description: Join Official Discord About the Game Step into the treacherous yet alluring shoes of the Dark Lord, steering a realm filled with eccentric characters and convoluted plots. As you stretch your tendrils of darkness across new lands, exercise your cunning in balancing political intrigues and military might. Juggle advisors who are as likely to stab you in the back as they are to kneel in awe. Fortify your stronghold, and revel in a narrative that’s as endlessly unfolding as it is drenched in layers of deliciously dark humor. The cherry on top? Community Stories Mode, where you can dive into the tales crafted by other players, as well as compose and share your own adventures using a convenient editor. Dive deep into a rich strategic role-playing game with roguelike elements and embark on an adventure unlike any other. As the enigmatic Dark Lord, watch as chaos reigns in your kingdom. Cultivate your territories, manage cunning advisors, mastermind devious conspiracies, and tackle quests brimming with dark, witty humor. In a realm where shadows dominate, humor—of the darkest kind—finds its way. Relish in the game's unique brand of comedy as you expand your domain, engage with quirky subjects, and embark on hilariously twisted quests. Face challenges with a wicked grin! Your choices have weight, dictating the twists and turns of the narrative. From outsmarting assassins to navigating interactions with wise yet cunning advisors, craft a tale unique to your reign. Get ready for challenging trials and complex tasks. What fate awaits your kingdom? It's in your hands! Find the delicate balance between military might and cunning political intrigues, as not all battles are won with strength. Skillfully manage your advisors to solidify your rule, but beware, as they may engage in their own treacherous game behind your back. The hand-crafted visuals of the game plunge you deep into the ambiance of a brooding kingdom. Every detail, every shadow speaks of a world built with care and passion, ensuring a visually captivating journey intertwined with riveting narratives. As you ascend the throne of darkness, you'll find that ruling is no easy task. Trust comes at a premium; decide who to execute for disloyalty and who to shower with gold for their undying allegiance. Yet, beware—today's faithful servant may be tomorrow's backstabbing traitor. And if you think you can play favorites, think again. Pin your advisors against each other in a treacherous game of divide and rule, ensuring no single advisor gains enough power to challenge your dark reign.
row.short_description: Unleash your power in Dark Lord, a roguelike RPG filled with strategy, adventure, and sardonic wit. Rule your growing realm with an iron fist in Story Mode, dive deep into the legends created by other players, or forge your own in Community Stories Mode!

row.name: Battle Of Tarlis
row.detailed_description: Campaign with 10 large maps (each map have different biome) Each level grants you passive skill (attack speed, armor, life) Battle enemy minions with sword, axe, hammer or even bow! After completing campaign you can play it again on higher difficulties! Use the skill any you want (spear, shield, transform, swap item, potion healing) Collect items from the ground dropped by enemies to inventory or stash! Earn gold to buy or gamble items with merchants in town Use elixirs to get percentage bonuses of elements to survive!
row.short_description: 'Battle Of Tarlis' is game where you explore many areas to get the best gear or highest level to defeat bosses or survive the hardest zones!

row.name: G-Scramble
row.detailed_description: overview Vertical Scrolling 2d Shooting Game Choose between two types of ship and attack the stage! armament Main Shot[ Bomber Option[ system Steam Achievements Steam Ranking other Created by Shooting Game Builder
row.short_description: Vertical Scrolling 2D Shooting Game Created by Shooting Game Builder

row.name: Save the Dungeon!
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Save the Dungeon! Heroes are invading your home, they aim to take everything you have. They have declared you evil Overlord as a justification to desecrate your land and end your life. It is time to call forth your minions and prepare the Dungeon for war! We stand with you Overlord to prove to these “heroes” that you are revered as the Overlord of these lands for a reason! Save the Dungeon! is a top down tower defense game where you must summon your minions to defend the dungeon from a horde of heroes! There is three levels implemented in the game with two different overlords to choose from and 6 different minion types to summon! Features Buy new items and upgrade existing ones in the shop! Summon Dangerous Minions Will you show the so called heroes why you are the Overlord or will you allow them to extinguish life and rob your home?
row.short_description: Save the Dungeon! Is a tower defense game from the perspective of the villain. Upgrade your minions to hold back the relentless hordes of heroes.

row.name: Infinite Borders
row.detailed_description: Do you want to define your own war style in a strategy game? Infinite Borders is calling you! With over 10 million downloads, Infinite Borders is one of the most popular strategy games in East Asia. When you enter Infinite Borders, you will return to the Three Kingdoms period--a turbulent dynasty in Chinese history--and have a chance to pen your epic. You will play as a lord and fight alongside Liu Bei, Cao Cao, Lv Bu, and other great Three Kingdoms heroes. Form unique teams with diverse combinations of generals and tactics to defeat more enemies and conquer more lands. You can make special policies and guide your city towards prosperity. In Infinite Borders, grasping the final victory requires not only strength, but also intelligence and strategy. Now, on the brink of war, it's time to join the battles and rewrite history, my lord! Build Your Estate, Gain Abundant Resources Construct buildings and upgrade facilities in your city to attain numerous supplies like wood, iron and soldiers. Devote your resources to expansion and development! Command Your Troops, Various Generals Collocation There are over 300 heroes with different skills waiting for you to recruit. Assemble your generals and formulate kinds of lineups to defeat your enemies! Fighter or Farmer, Diplomat or Spy, Make Your Choice How to rise to the top in this chaotic world? You can be an aggressive fighter who crushes the battlefields. You can be a hardworking farmer who concentrates on building and defending. You can be a sociable diplomat who establishes good relations with other alliances. You can be a mysterious spy who disintegrates enemy forces secretly. Determine your law of victory and write a new chapter of history in this war game! Open Eastern World, Free To Explore The upgraded 3D graphics restore an authentic ancient eastern world with dozens of famous historic landmarks like Yangtze River, Yellow River and Yueyang Tower, proving immersive gameplay experience. Embark on your unrestricted adventure right now!
row.short_description: With over 10 million downloads, Infinite Borders is a popular strategy game set in China's Three Kingdoms period. Fight alongside legendary heroes to conquer lands and defeat enemies. Build unique teams, guide your city to prosperity, and make special policies. Infinite Borders is calling you!
