row.name: Dance Dash Beatmap Editor
row.detailed_description: Simple drag and drop layout for easy note placement Import any song mp3 file and customize Variety of default and customizable shortcuts Vibrant community support No export required, immediately test Efficient resource management Super cool lighting presets, customization in development
row.short_description: Dance Dash Beatmap Editor allows you to create beatmaps for your favorite tracks, choreograph your most treasured tunes, and let the world know how you rock!

row.name: Crowned Control
row.detailed_description: Crowned Control is a game about a group of knights, lured into an old dungeon by tales of legend. According to the stories, there's a legendary crown in there that grants ghostly powers to the one wearing it! Of course, every knight wants that crown for themself! Acquiring it will require teamwork, however. They'll need to work together to get the crown off of the current wearer's head, and onto their own! Our knights are armed with their trusty sword, shining armor and whatever artifacts (or rubbish) they can scavenge from within the dungeon. Hit each other with swords, spill oil to slow the others down or taste some exquisite cuisine in the fine peppers of the underground, to give yourself a speed boost. Other than legendary artifacts, this dungeon also houses a myriad of traps. Our knights can choose to expertly avoid these, or cunningly use them against the one wearing the crown (or their friends, of course). At the end of the day, all that matters is who gets to wear the crown the longest, so employ whatever tactics you need to make sure that person is you! This game is made by 5 students from Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment in the 2nd year of their bachelor in a period of 11 weeks.
row.short_description: A couch co-op multiplayer game, where the goal is to grab the crown and keep it on your head for as long as possible to win the game!

row.name: The Chef's Shift: First Course
row.detailed_description: Get ready to cook up a storm in 'The Chef's Shift: First Course' - a fast-paced typing game set in a bustling restaurant! With your keyboard as your weapon, you'll need to cook and serve delicious dishes to hungry customers before they lose their patience. But that's not all - you'll also need to juggle all kinds of crazy distractions, from rat invasions to unruly customers. Embark on a culinary journey through the Italian restaurant in The Chef's Shift: First Course, and experience the start of Lorenzo's chef career. Savor the diverse flavors of the cuisine, where each dish will feature different quirks & challenges. 1 teaspoon of chaotic, fast-paced gameplay 1 package of easy-to-pickup, hard-to-master TYPING mechanic 1 cup of fun time management bits And we mean it! Navigate through the menu by typing Prepare & serve your customers by typing Select your dialogue choices by typing Throughout the game, you will meet various characters, from customers with their own personality, to characters who propel the story forward.
row.short_description: A fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING. Play through the Italian restaurant and get a taste of The Chef's Shift!
row.notes: The story is about mafia families and crime life. There will be frequent mention of criminal activity in the storyline like drugs, gang wars, illegal gambling etc. The most violent thing shown is the display of gun and killing rats.

row.name: The August Before: Chapter One
row.detailed_description: ‎The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. In Chapter One, play through the first snippets of the story and get acquainted with your room, and the people in your life. Teenage love, first losses, and notes from friends are scattered in the corners: explore the details of the heroine's life, pack up the life you will take with you, and say goodbye - if you can. And remember - you can't take the past with you. All is well that ends well — and all is well that ends. Features Clean up the room before leaving, find the necessary items, and pack them in a suitcase. Keep track of the diary, change the music, arrange the objects, and try to remember not to disturb the dark corners of the room. Sort through the items and appreciate the resulting order and the details of the story that unfolds in the process. Explore the chaos and enjoy your freedom to drag, erase, disassemble, break, and fix things in the highly interactive space.
row.short_description: The August Before: Chapter One is the first chapter in a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

row.name: Heroes & Redemption
row.detailed_description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell game where different characters and ability combinations are utilized to fight against progressively stronger enemies in order to survive. Play as the warrior Otwin Reid, who defeats the creatures and enemies that suddenly appear in the world. Acquire new companions and try to find the ones responsible for this chaos. FEATURES 8 playable characters with different ability appearances. 4 types of altars with different tasks. Epic boss fights. 4 sets of armor that provide different powers. 10 rings, each possessing a unique power. 20 active and 22 passive abilities, a total of 42 skills . 29 empowered skills that enhance your base skills. FIGHT AND EXPLORE  Level up by slaughtering enemies that spawn in every direction. Make your character near immortal in this adventure by choosing one of randomly offered abilities each time you level up and by purchasing runes, armors, rings and empowered skills at the hub. Complete levels by fulfilling objectives at altars that appear in specific waves. Explore special locations on the maps or complete achievements to unlock new characters and abilities. MEET THE HEROES Each hero brings unique strengths and a dark past to the battlefield. Whether it's the furious warrior, the elusive rogue who strikes from the shadows, the spell-weaving mage, or the unstoppable paladin with hammer in hand, every character is ready to confront dark forces. Join them, harness their powers, and fight for the fate of the realm! COMPLETE YOUR TASKS In addition to defeating enemies, you need to complete tasks at altars that appear in random places with random objectives. EQUIPMENT You can earn soul shards by completing altars or killing enemies, and you can purchase armors or rings with soul shards. There are 4 types of armor sets in total. Some of them grants you increased protection but slows you down, while others grants you less protection but different powers. Combine or use the set that best suits your playstyle and destroy the enemies in your own way. Purchase 10 mystical rings, each granting unique powers to transform your character’s abilities – from enhanced strength and speed to soul absorbing magic and life-stealing powers. SPEND YOUR GOLDS AT THE HUB At the hub, you can purchase characters, runes and even buy empowered skills that evolve your powers. A WORLD FULL OF CHAOS Survive in the putrid dark crystal cave, embark on an expedition in old graveyard that filled with the traces of forgotten tombs, uncover the secrets of snowy village, be careful where you step in toxic sewers that filled with perilous waters and creatures, explore the old prison with ancient stone cells and annihilate all the enemies that cross your path.
row.short_description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.

row.name: BYLE
row.detailed_description: Step into a world where the line between sanity and madness has been blurred by the malevolent force of BYLE. In BYLE, you are a mercenary on a mission to liberate the people from the clutches of this mind-controlling substance. Embark on a journey through the city consumed by chaos, as you battle hordes of twisted enemies, discover powerful weaponry and powerups, and take down the sinister BYLE. Fight Against the Corruption: Take on the role of one of many unlockable characters, each with their own stats and armed with the sole purpose of saving the city from BYLE's malevolence. Every playthrough is different as levels are procedurally generated and powerups are random. Multiple Game Modes: Choose your path to victory between the Save the City and Colosseum game modes. Save the City offers the traditional roguelike experience, traversing through procedural levels, collecting weapons and powerups, and taking on bosses. Colosseum offers wave-based combat where difficulty increases the longer you survive. An Arsenal of Destruction: Equip yourself with an extensive selection of powerful and unique weapons. Experiment with melee combat, firearms, and experimental BYLE-fuelled technology as you find the perfect weapon to suit your needs in combatting the corruption. Face Over 50 Unique Enemies: The city is brimming with enemies, once residents of the city but now corrupted and forced to fight in the name of BYLE. From mutated abominations to corrupted civilians, you will confront a diverse range of foes that will test your combat skills. Confront Powerful Bosses: Test your mettle against formidable bosses that guard the heart of the BYLE's corruption. These colossal adversaries will push your skills to the limit, demanding flawless combat techniques in order to come out on top. Discover Unique Powerups: As you delve deeper into the heart of the city, discover special powerups that will give you an edge in your fight against BYLE. These enhancements can change the tide of battle, allowing you to grow stronger or use powerful abilities that will help defend against the horrors that await. Prepare to confront your worst fears, battle relentless foes, and liberate the city from the imprisoned by BYLE. Are you ready to become the hero this world desperately needs? Will you be the saviour that cleanses the city? Find out in BYLE. Featured at Insomnia i70's Indie Zone
row.short_description: Fight through a corrupted city, battling over 50 unique enemies and powerful bosses. Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and uncover mysterious power-ups as you strive to liberate the city from the clutches of the mind-altering BYLE.

row.name: Can Strike
row.detailed_description: In “Can Strike,” you play as a worker at Fish Co, where the employees have gone on strike to demand better working conditions and fair wages. But the company isn’t backing down - they’ve sent in waves of robots to break up the strike and force the workers back to their jobs. As a member of the union, you’ve been granted powerful weapons to defend yourself and your fellow workers against the robotic onslaught. Use your skills and strategy to destroy the robots and keep the strike going. The future of your job and livelihood is at stake - will you be able to hold your ground and fight for justice? With intense action, challenging gameplay, and a gripping storyline, “Can Strike” is an epic battle for survival. Join the fight and defend your rights!
row.short_description: Your employers at Fish Co are sending in Robots to end your strike! Use your union-granted weapons to destroy the waves of robots to keep the strike going.
row.notes: This game contains some swearwords and some violent actions.

row.name: Bouncers
row.detailed_description: Short Description Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear. The Mini Square The Mini Square (creative name huh?) will follow you forcing you to constantly move as you avoid all the other enemies. The Bouncer The Bouncer (The names get more creative I promise) bounces off the edges of your screen and can switch directions at any bounce. The game starts off easy with 1 Bouncer but multiplies as your score gets higher. 1 Bounce = 1 point * multiplier. The Asteroid The Asteroid (See? More creative huh?) spawns every 10-15 seconds and will track you. Juke it to avoid it! The Dahser The Dasher can spawn more than once at a time in any location across your screen. They will face a random direction and charge until it leaves the screen. The Thief If the thief spawns, it will go faster than the mini square! If you get hit by it, it will take some of your points! Avoid it for 30 seconds and it will de-spawn. Slow Motion When an enemy gets close to you, other than the mini square, it will trigger slow motion putting a red vignette smoothly faded onto your screen and slow motion will activate so you can be precise when dodging. Collect Powerups Powerups will help your run last longer! Collect powerups like +1 Life, Shield, Star, Purge, and Speed! Healing Healing is handled by a random chance of health packs or passive healing! Health Packs: Collect health packs to heal instantly! Passive Healing: Avoid damage to continue healing! Health Zone: The health zone can spawn randomly, stay in it and it will continue healing you! Leaderboard Compete on each difficulty to get on the top 5 leaderboard! Key Settings / Fun Options Movement Mouse Controls (Strongly Recommended): The player moves smoothly towards your mouse. Most recommended for beginners WASD/Arrow Keys: Snappy movement using WASD or the arrow keys Rainbow Bouncers A toggle to have every bouncer spawn as a random color Special Thanks Special thanks to my best friend George N. for coming up with some of the ideas in my game. He is in the credits section for the ideas he came up with. Backstory Well the short reason why this exists is my computer science teacher. But here is the long story: I was a freshman in high school (at the time I'm writing this, I’ll be a sophomore) at 14 years old. (I turned 15 6 days ago at the time I’m writing this, July 16 2023) I recently finished a project I started the year before using python. I didn’t have to do any of the labs, I was way ahead of everyone, they were learning python and I learned it in 5th-6th grade. But since I was not working on anything, I started failing. I talked to my computer science teacher and he said for me to make another project with something new, he needed to challenge me. So I decided to learn 2D game development with Pygame. Pygame was nice, I learned it in 2 days on vacation, but following a tutorial was not enough, I wanted to prove to myself I knew something. I decided to recreate pong but then I wanted my own original idea. So I made the first version of Bouncers, called “Dodge Lines” I know it’s terrible. But it is a concept I had in mind for a few years. I worked on the game way too much and also during class and adding constant updates. 47 days later, I had 46 releases of my game on GitHub. I loved it, but I was limited by pygame and wanted to learn Unity. Surprisingly it was easier. I remade Bouncers from scratch. Remade almost every feature and improved it. I upgraded the graphics an insane amount because Unity is insanely better. And then for about half the school year, I worked non stop in and out of my classes. I would be walking in the halls to my next class working on my game with my gaming laptop in hand. Eventually I polished the game and added so many new features, I thought of putting it on here. Finally, after a long time, I am putting my dream game on Steam. I made some changes like technical stuff with the leaderboard and achievements so I guess that not all of this was made by a 14 year old, but I don’t think it matters too much anyway. Credit goes to my computer science teacher, hopefully he has steam because I am giving him a free copy. Thank you for reading this and showing interest in Bouncers, it really means a lot.
row.short_description: Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear.

row.name: The Last Flame: Prologue
row.detailed_description: GET THE FULL GAME! There's much more to explore in The Last Flame! This prologue version is just a taste of what the full game has in store! The full game features: Get access to a lot more stuff! Make amazing builds with 325 items, 65 heroes, 150 relics and 60 origins. Access to the third act and meet the final boss in a secret act! Face 30 challenging enemies and 12 bosses! Progress through 5 difficulties which will challenge your knowledge and strategy! Push your builds to their limit in the endless mode, a mode where you try to reach the highest floor! Experience the game in diverse and fun new ways with the challenge modes! About the Game The Last Flame is a roguelike auto-battler which focuses on build creation, strategy and decision making. Recruit special heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create unique synergetic builds! Every run, you will need to create powerful builds that will take down your foes! The Last Flame offers an incredible amount of build diversity. Combine heroes, items, relics and origins together to create amazing builds! Hero and team building have been designed with flexibility and freedom at their core which allows you to discover and create unique synergetic builds every single run! In between the automated combats, you will have to cleverly guide your heroes through the adventure by making the smart decisions! Manage your resources, choose the optimal path in the map, make powerful builds, and strategically position and plan the combat phase! Get access to a lot more stuff! Make amazing builds with 325 items, 65 heroes, 150 relics and 60 origins. Continue the adventure in the third act, and meet the final boss in a special act! Face 30 challenging enemies and 12 bosses! Progress through 5 difficulties which will challenge your knowledge and strategy! Push your builds to their limit in the endless mode, a mode where you try to reach the highest floor! Experience the game in diverse and fun new ways with the challenge modes!
row.short_description: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! The Last Flame is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.

row.name: Toy Shire: Room One
row.detailed_description: Play through the three levels in Kevin's Room and defend your room against your old toys. Face Memphis-X in the final level and put a stop to his assault as he crushes your soldiers in an attempt to get to your base. You received new toys from your family. Isn't that lovely? Oh, it's for sure... Your old toys, though, aren't getting along as well. They are no longer cared for and have been forgotten. So what follows next? They're going to join together against you and assault your brand-new toys, so be prepared. But never worry! You're in luck since your brand-new toys are troops of green soldiers. They still require your aid though! Control, strengthen, and defeat the opposing forces! However, focus with care, the enemies you encounter might not be your old playthings! Tower building alone won't be sufficient to repel incoming attackers. Build up your own troops in the best feasible positions, then unleash attacks into enemy territory. Never abandon your towers, and deploy your troops in accordance with the traits of the enemy. First, the attacking forces will attempt to get past your defenses. Build and improve towers to aid your army. By using unique abilities, you can support your troops and towers as well. Safeguard your base against waves of attackers. You need to pick the right troops if you would like to prevail. Clean the paths and guard any open routes. Upgrade your troops and unlock new ones to take down the waves and claim victory. Enter a world and a narrative built around the toys that enriched your youth, including toy soldiers, dinosaur sets, robots, building blocks, and more.
row.short_description: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome to the Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers! FULL GAME AVAILABLE NOW!

row.name: JustWatchMyCat
row.detailed_description: JustWatch MyCat is a puzzle game that manipulates blocks of cats to eat fish. When you press the arrow keys, the cats move in that direction all at once on a 2-d map. In addition, new gimmicks appear every 10 stages, and there are a total of 50 stages. Cat Block : Move in unison in the direction entered until blocked in that direction. Cat blocks bite the fish in their mouth when they touch it. Puffer fish : When a cat block touches the puffer fish, the cat becomes addicted. You can heal by eating regular fish blocks. At this time, the cat blocks don't bite the fish in its mouth. In other words, cat blocks that ate puffer fish are only satisfied by eating two blocks of fish. Switches and gates : Open or close the gates on the map when a block steps on the pink switch. However, passing over the switch is not applicable and there must be a block on the switch at the end of the movement. A closed gate acts like a wall. Dog Block : Dog blocks move in unison in the opposite direction of the input direction. If a dog block and a cat block compete for position with one space left when they collide face to face, the cat block takes its place. Dog blocks can operate the switch, but they do not interact with regular fish or puffer fish. Portal : Portal always appears in pairs. When a cat or dog block touches one portal, it sends it in the opposite direction of the other. Cute Cat Photos : Provides cat photos for every multiples stage of 10. In fact, one of the reasons I made this game is because I want more people to see my cat. If the game is too difficult, you can also skip it by pressing the space or enter key. However, it is made up of puzzles that can be solved with a little thought, so I recommend you to try it.
row.short_description: It's a cat puzzle game that solves using the direction of gravity.

row.name: Mixing Ammos
row.detailed_description: Use the skills to attack (or being counter-attacked by) the enemies, and defeat the boss. Control Ely, Astra, and Jennifer to hunt down their long-term frienemy - Exo, uncover the traitor - Dreyar, and defeat the ultimate Exo - red. You are not going in grids, but moving freely. Walk, Run, or Sprint to any movable place and attack your enemies with Gun/Sword/Shield. Gun/Sword/Shield skills are long/mid/short ranged, while Gun skill can break Sword skill, Sword skill can break Shield skill, and Shield skill can counter-attack Gun skill. Choose your next move wisely!
row.short_description: A turn-based free-move strategy game. Walk/Run/Sprint freely without the grids. Your attack could be countered so choose your next move wisely.

row.name: 可可味大冒险
row.detailed_description: 本作品为现实中的声优可可味粉丝同人生贺衍生作品，与现实中的真实状况无关。 写在前面 哼哼哼！没错！这个是超美丽，超优秀的人气声优可可味！——的粉丝同人生贺游戏 本游戏为RPG像素角色扮演游戏，将为您讲述一个美好而又充满艰辛的冒险故事。 游戏有着丰富的剧情和超过25位粉丝NPC出场角色，故事以收集物品玩法与解谜玩法为主。 游戏拥有精美CG及二十多首原创背景音乐。 游戏简介 在这里，你将扮演超可爱超人气少女可可亚！展开一场关于友谊的大冒险~ 幽默诙谐的故事一定能够让您感到轻松愉快！请去一起见证吧，一个关于友谊的无厘头却又温馨的故事。 角色 可可亚 生日：8月21日 “可刺激了！”
row.short_description: 在无尽的大海上，行驶着一艘叫做可可亚号的大船，然而有一天，可亚号遭遇了风暴......名为可可亚的少女，将会展开怎样的冒险？

row.name: Triplets Trouble!!!
row.detailed_description: Being a single parent is hard. Being a single parent of triplets is pretty hard. Being a single parent of triplets shortly after a global pandemic is very pretty hardy. But do you know what is much, much, much harder? Enduring boredom! It is almost impossible to survive! All the games have been played! All the cool books have been read! All the cartoons have been watched! Everything has been done and undone, turned and turned over! What will Kazuki, Kazumi and Kazuko, the amazing and mischievous triplets, do to continue existing in such a boring world?!
row.short_description: Triplets Trouble!!! is a visual novel slice of life about a father and his triplets in a period shortly after the pandemic. Each game played by the children became a mini-game, in a short narrative over seven days in the life of this family.

row.name: 哥布林信条：起源  Goblin Creed: Origins
row.detailed_description: Goblin Creed: Origins is a fantasy RPG with combat and adventure. · Challenging levels Break into the woods, climb mountains, cross rivers, and avoid chaotic casks of wine Four different scenarios require you to use your brain and perform delicate maneuvers! · The watchman of silence but conviction Jump, roll, attack, and use items to overcome immediate obstacles Facing fierce enemies, challenging difficult dangers, only to fulfill the mission! · Foreshadowed backstory Why do the two masters and apprentices live here all year round? Why do the dark barbarians invade at this time? As the watchman, can you convey the news in time A magical journey began.
row.short_description: The kingdom is in danger. You must communicate this to your master!

row.name: The Wild Outback
row.detailed_description: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game set in the West. It's a goofy single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots! The Wild Outback is a large, barren territory located in the middle of a country called Witherwest. It is a lawless, uncharted area where anything goes, and it just so happens to be the place where the aliens want to settle down. The main cast of characters who are trying to stop the invasion are volunteers, equipped with their own unique set of weapons to stop the invasion. In this war against the invaders, you may find cowboy allies, powerups, and a whole lot of money to increase your fire power, you're going to need all the help you can get! Picking up stars will summon Cowboy Allies, whom will follow you around and aim wherever your cursor is pointed. Collect as much money as you can, as this will level you up and increase your vitality and your weapon speed. Survive in a chaotic and wacky world where everything's out to get you!
row.short_description: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game in a Wild Western setting. It's a single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots!

row.name: THEORY
row.detailed_description: 'Theory' is an intense first-person shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. Players find themselves in a vast, desolate landscape As a survivor, you'll navigate through mountains, decaying cities, and treacherous rural landscapes, all while facing constant threats from zombies. Your arsenal includes an array of a handgun, and rifle and shotgun weapons, all of which are essential for fending off the undead and ensuring your own survival. This game was developed as a final project by a team of three people. There are various mechanics such as: Shooter Car driving Books Hand Lamp (F key) Interact Storytelling with objects Elif and Ali escaped from city life and settled on a farm. After spending many years on the farm, Elif puts her thoughts on paper and publishes a book. In his teachings spread from hand to hand, he states that a civilized and prosperous life is possible, away from mechanized modernism. 'Every effort and breakthrough in human history is for happiness. A person who is not happy cannot contribute to life.' The theory spread among the people and people began to get used to the idea of leaving monotony and living a comfortable life. City administrators are against this situation and declare Elif persona non grata. Meanwhile, Elif gives birth to Vefa. After a while, Vefa gets sick and Ali takes Vefa and goes to the hospital. Even though a few days have passed, Ali and Vefa still haven't arrived. Thereupon, Elif decided to hit the road and jumped into her car with her hunting weapons. Various difficulties and adventures await Elif in this quest. Will these difficulties bring Elif back to her family?
row.short_description: 'Theory' is an intense first-person shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. Players find themselves in a vast, desolate landscape. As a survivor, you'll navigate through various environments.

row.name: Feywing
row.detailed_description: 'Ever wonder how some folks always know where to go, and how to find what they need? Ever wonder what it'd be like to have the intuition that leads you out of harm and into safety? Would you like the ability to choose not just the safest path to a destination, but also the ability to avoid dangerous paths? If you're daring enough, there is a way to gain a supernatural sense of direction and finding your way around. Be warned, it's not safe. Some people trigger the ritual without intent, becoming another number in missing persons cases. Perhaps it is not a bad idea to know how it works in order to avoid it.' Feywing is a short game loosely inspired by classic internet ritual stories. As a participant of the Feywing ritual, you must memorize and navigate the strange environment of the Crossroads to collect materials, make effigies for the ritual, and find a way out of the Crossroads. During all of this, the whimsical Feywing will be there to guide you along. Of course, the Crossroads is a strange, liminal world with dangers all around. In daylight, you may be safe. As night draws near, your worst enemy is the environment surrounding you... Multiple endings to discover. Randomly generated maps, relocating landmarks all around. No map, only your compass and landmarks to memorize the area. Survival hinges on attention to your surroundings. That tree behind you was further back a moment ago.
row.short_description: Feywing is a short game loosely inspired by classic internet ritual stories. You must memorize and navigate the strange environment of the Crossroads to collect materials for the ritual, and escape the Crossroads. During all of this, the whimsical Feywing will be there to guide you along.

row.name: Hidden Nightmares
row.detailed_description: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. How would you behave if your psychiatric disorder continues to keep you stuck inside endless nightmares and you begin to feel that someone demonic is slowly taking control of your mind? Have fun going back and forth from the dream world to the real world, but take a good look at the world around you-something may have changed and may no longer be as you left it the last time you fell asleep. Hidden Nightmares is just a horror experience built in an attempt to bring within a video game the feelings felt within the nightmares we experience on a daily basis. Waking up will not be so easy anymore, especially if someone has invaded your dreams by force.
row.short_description: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. Experience the horrors generated by the human mind and wonder if you will ever wake up again.

row.name: Project Rogue
row.detailed_description: Created by programming students at the Academy of Art University on our free time, Project Rogue is a roguelite, first-person dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs with a modern touch. Explore the endless dungeon as you kill monsters, level up, and collect loot. The dungeon is procedurally generated so it will always be a different experience. Find magic items to improve your character so that you can survive boss fights in deeper levels. The class you select determines your starting equipment, and then you choose how your character progresses. Will you play a hardened fighter wielding two-handed weapons? Or perhaps a spell caster that overwhelms enemies with magic? You are in control. Features Procedural content generation Old school RPG vibe Stat-based progression Character customization Endless replayability
row.short_description: Explore the endlessly generated dungeon as you kill monsters, level up, and collect loot in this first-person dungeon crawler. Magic items improve your character's stats so that it's easier to use better equipment and learn better spells. You choose how your character progresses.
row.notes: Goblins, skeletons, ghosts, and other monsters carry weapons to attack the player with. There is a blood spatter effect on the screen when the player attacks with their weapon. Weapons can drop, be found in chests, or be purchased in town.

row.name: The Lancaster Leak - Crisis At Call Center
row.detailed_description: Episode 2 - CRISIS AT CALL CENTER It seems another tape has been leaked as FBI intern Valerie Bardot is still missing. To prove a point, the leakers have up the ante. 3rd Person TWIST Play through the perspective of multiple security cams, hacked computers, and wiretapped phones. SOMETHING IS LURKING A new tape means a new entity... Features 30 minutes long Linear story Jumpscares Playing first game is recommended but not required.
row.short_description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a cover-up of a tragic mass casualty event.
row.notes: Jump scares, death, & blood.

row.name: Resonite
row.detailed_description: Dive into a brand new digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you come here to socialize and hang out with people around the world or to build, create and develop anything from beautiful art, interactive avatars and gadgets, to complex interactive worlds and games, Resonite is an endlessly customizable place where you'll be welcome and where you'll find a group to resonate with. Thanks to our advanced engine, we ensure that multiplayer experiences stay perfectly synchronized between players with zero effort for our community content creators. Whether you're just hanging out with people or building complex worlds and contraptions with other creators, Resonite will make sure every details stays in perfect sync and keeps you in control of your experience. Socialize with anyone Online socialization and real-time communication whether you're in desktop or VR is the foundational layer of everything in Resonite. Being able to communicate and be yourself is an important part of the platform. To make this possible, we offer a number of key features: Low latency voice - communicate in real time with other users in session with latency rivaling that of other messaging applications Fully custom avatars - import, build and customize any avatars in-game and in real-time to look like the best version of you Full body tracking, eye & face tracking - to maximize your avatar's expressivity we support 8 trackers (feet, knees, hips, chest and elbows) as well as eye and face tracking Haptics support - with support for haptic vests such as bHaptics, you can increase your immersion and become part of the virtual world Instant messaging - chat over text, send invites, voice messages or even arbitrary items to your contacts Flexible session visibility & security - you are in control of the visibility and accessibility of your sessions, anywhere from public to fully private, with an access list you control. All validation and verification of joining users is done on your client - if you set your session to Private, you can be sure that it is private Customizable UI - the user interface is your gateway to using the platform and just like everything else in Resonite, it can be customized and extended to better suit your needs and make your daily experience more comfortable Self-moderation tools - we understand that not every interaction on the platform will be good and that's why we want to empower you with a number of self-moderation tools - moderate your own worlds with silence, kick and ban functions or easily mute and block individual users avatars or their entire presence. Our goal is to give you as much control over your virtual experience as we can. Multi-world presence - just like tabs in a web browser, you can be present in multiple worlds and switch between them in a fraction of second Play, explore and share Socializing does not have to end at chatting with your fellow users. Resonite is a universe full of fun gadgets, avatars and games to explore, with features to make any session fun and exciting. Easy media sharing - drag & drop pictures, audio/music or videos into any world to share with other users with synchronized playback - it's that easy! Inventory system - did you find or made something cool? Save it to your inventory! You can spawn any items, gadgets and tools in any world (as long as you have permissions to do so) - everything is fully synchronized too! Dynamic avatar scaling - exploring the world or interacting with users at different scales can give you quite a different experience - you can change your avatar's scale anywhere, at any time (unless it's limited by the host of the session)! High quality audio streaming - want to host a party and be the DJ? Streaming your system audio in full stereo in high quality is a few clicks away World search & session discovery system - looking for a cool world to visit or what your friends are up to? Searching worlds by their names and tags as well as seeing which worlds your contacts are in will help you there Stream to your audience - our in-game recording and streaming tools make it easy to produce captivating and dynamic camera shots, whether you're streaming or filming videos for social media Custom locomotion - we don't limit you to just walking around - you can fly, noclip switch to zero-g or build your own customized locomotion system - ever tried to walk on a surface of a Möbius strip? Build and create If you have a creative itch, you may enjoy the powerful toolset that Resonite offers to you. Not only you can build and edit absolutely anything - from your avatar, items, to the entire worlds or even making your own tools, you can collaborate with others in real time and achieve true creative resonance! Realtime collaboration - the collaboration on our platform is so seamless, that you will often forget it's there - our powerful engine ensures that the world and everything in it starts in perfect sync, no matter what you do - you'd be hard pressed to find any feature or functionality that'd be visible only to you (unless it's your private UI of course!) Edit anything - everything you see in the world can be edited and customized with the game tools - in fact, we built a lot of the official functionality in-game with the same tools that are accessible to you - from the home world, default avatars, to video players, color picker UI or progress bar - you can take them apart or build your own from scratch and favorite them Save anything - you can save literally anything on the platform! Whether you built a new item, an avatar or a world, or made modifications to an existing one, everything can be persisted with a single click of a button. You can efficiently store multiple copies as well - our deduplication system will ensure that any shared assets only get counted once Development tools - our development tools range from simple brushes and procedural meshes to more advanced and powerful ones, similar to ones you find in classical game development tools - except that you can use them in VR with real time collaboration! Cross-world synchronization and persistence - with our integrated cloud tools, you can easily preserve user data between sessions or synchronize state across multiple different worlds Import 3D models - thanks to open source libraries, it's extremely easy to bring in large variety of 3D model formats - simply drag and drop your FBX, OBJ, GLB or other files and bring them in Texture/Audio/Model processing - need to make a quick edit to a texture, audio file or 3D mesh? Basic editing functions are fully accessible in-game - from hue-shifting textures, normalizing and clipping audio to recalculating normals and tangents on meshes or baking them Export content for external tools - as easy as it is to bring content in, it's just as easy to take it out! With this, you can make edits using external tools or make Resonite part of your workflow Code and develop ProtoFlux - ProtoFlux is the crown jewel of our creative tools - the most powerful visual programming language that our experienced team has designed to date, which lets you quickly prototype and build anything from simple interactions to complex games and systems - with full real-time collaboration support and immediate feedback Script anything - ProtoFlux can interact with anything - the world, the items, your avatar and any combinations of these! Websockets - thanks to built-in websocket support, you can easily communicate with external applications and scripts and build extensive functionality, such as your own game servers, fetching external data to integrating new and custom hardware, without having to depend on official integration Async Flows - creating code that needs to yield or wait across different frames is a native feature of ProtoFlux, with full execution scope preservation - you can even have multiple async flows running off the same code, each with their own unique context, which is a highly powerful and flexible tool for simplifying your logic Flexible storage system - locals, stores and data model - pick where you store your computational data depending on the desired scope and context, to build highly efficient systems Resonate with anything, anyone, anywhere... We are a team of passionate developers, who are developing more than just a piece of software, but something that we call a second home. We are committed continuous development, with frequent updates and community driven focus. This project is a combination of our dreams and visions of what digital spaces like this should offer and the collective needs, desires and aspirations of our community. Much of our focus and vision is on giving you, the users and inhabitants of this virtual universe, as much power and agency as we can, whether it's over controlling your experience on the platform or being able to (re)build anything we do. It would be our honor if you decide to join our universe and help us build it together. Whatever your background or interests are, we want to build a place where everyone can resonate together.
row.short_description: Enter a novel digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you resonate with people around the world in a casual conversation, playing games and socializing or you riff off each other when creating anything from art to programming complex games, you'll find your place here.

row.name: Entropic Decay: Prologue
row.detailed_description: “The definition of entropic is having a tendency to change from a state of order..to a state of disorder...' Entropic Decay is a lovingly crafted linear first person shooter driven by narrative, puzzles, combat arenas, and horror sequences. It takes inspiration from Valve's games, with its use of environmental story telling and pacing between enemy encounters, striking a balance between combat and atmosphere. Think the atmosphere of a slow-burn horror inspired walking simulator fused with movement and combat options of a shooter... One level featuring combat between the military and mutants in the world of Entropic Decay. A preview of the horde mode, featuring waves of enemies (including soldiers) that gradually get more difficult as waves progress. Includes a custom soundtrack. Use time dilation to outmanoeuvre enemies and dodge projectiles- including bullets! Time dilation also allows for altered movement, dashing multi-directionally to evade enemies and dodge projectiles, and a double jump to reach places not achievable otherwise. Projectile based ballistics system. NO hit scanners here! Every ranged enemy/player firearm are ALL projectile based. Dynamic dismemberment. Blow your enemies apart with a robust blood and gore system. Feel the impact of each distinct weapon, or just shoot an explosive barrel and watch the bloody show! Cunning, reactive A.I - The soldiers in Entropic Decay don't mess around. They react to grenades, can hear you, take cover, flee, and throw their own grenades. The mutated work in packs, can hear you running and will roam the area you were last seen. The military will shoot the mutated on sight, but taking them down is no easy task, even for the well trained. A variety of mutated to fight against - Currently there are over ten different mutated to contend with. Ranging from agile spider mutants and dogs, to hulking tanks weilding lead pipes. Puzzles to break up combat sequences - Puzzles and narrative pieces are used to keep the player engaged to avoid simply being one type of genre and keep things fresh and dynamic. Physics interaction - Interact with the world with physics puzzles, and deceive enemies by throwing objects or craft a devious trap by arranging explosives in your environment to detonate on an unsuspecting foe. Stealth, A.I and how they interact - Distract your foes by throwing an object or bring them closer to setup an ambush with a whistle, or simply sneak by and avoid combat all together. Use your wits and the environment and the A.I will respond allowing emergent gameplay and tactical options. Narrative driven gameplay - The story will be told through the environment with the player merely an observer of things outside it's control. Find notes, audio logs, and data entries to piece together the collapse of society and the scientific ambition that caused it. Some time in the future, a signal is detected carrying a small meteor. The signal is tracked, and the crash site investigated on impact. A mineral is found. Astrobioligist's are amazed to find a living pathogen inside the mineral. The pathogen is extracted and experimented on, and the findings indicate aggressive cell growth when in contact with other organisms....dead or alive. Rapid cell mutation causes a rabies like disease. Anything infected with the pathogen becomes a hive-minded aggressor to everything not infected. The pathogen spreads and envelopes the world. Civilisation becomes an overgrown, decaying husk of the nature we once knew. The decay and despair is juxtaposed with beauty, as plant life flourishes due to the pathogens effect on cell growth, and everything man-made returns to nature, but rises again with a twisted skew. The last bastion of humanity are elitist's, deploying the military to kill anyone on sight who aren't in uniform. Military death squads roam in packs, taking orders for food and protection from the pathogen, while trading their humanity. You awaken in a facility, fumbling for hazy memories of before the place you find yourself in.... Journey through a world foreign to all but the mutated, and find a place free from decay and entropy at any cost...
row.short_description: This is the free prologue version of Entropic Decay, a fast paced, but slow burn horror/action FPS inspired by games from the late 90's through early 2000's. Enter volatile scenarios filled with danger, from both the living and the dead, where wits are as crucial as brawn...
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content, and some non sexual nudity.

row.name: Powers in the Basement
row.detailed_description: Will Phail is a fifteen-year-old like many others: lazy, spoiled, and phlegmatic. But he has one thing that others lack: he's useless! Experience Will's drama in this short adventure as he searches for his favorite T-shirt so he can hang out with his friends trying to defend his already compromised reputation. Dodge lazy grandparents, mischievous rats, and carnivorous plants, and find the courage to descend into the frightening basement, where powers beyond understanding lurk, waiting to be awakened! A dive into the golden age of point-and-click adventures A state-of-the-art, ultramodern 9-verbs interface, to put you in total control The humor of the great classics, with jokes conceived for smart people, like YOU who have decided to play this game! Amazing 3D graphics: Dimple, Dlat, and Dapproximate Awesome MT-32 music and 22KHz sound effects that will blow your mind Challenging and merciless puzzles that will force you to rack your brains! The Game Powers in the Basement is a 5/6 hours long point-and-click adventure game, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production. It's a witty and sometimes surreal game, with clean humor, also suitable for children, set in a pseudo-fantasy world in which the medieval fairytale is punctuated by anachronisms, elements of modernity, and absurd references to nerd pop culture. It's a challenging game made for puzzle lovers, those who like to have a-ha moments in the shower or while cooking, but we did our best to make it a fair and enjoyable experience for casual gamers as well If you are a longtime fan of this genre, well... we hope we can bring you back to your childhood for a while.
row.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure game set in a comedic medieval fantasy world, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production.

row.name: 骑士派对
row.detailed_description: About this game: Mainly a collection of different game types. Including some of my wild ideas, or being a Stitch Monster, or replicating the games I loved when I was a child. There is currently only one model of simulation management+self playing chess: This mode can be played by up to 8 people Before the game starts, you can form a deck of up to 20 cards. These cards will draw one card per turn within the game. These cards are used directly without the need for resources, so it is crucial to make good use of the card's characteristics. The only way to obtain cards in the game is to create them through resources such as knights, equipment, magic, and trap cards. There are two main ways to obtain in-game resources: 1. Sending chess pieces to explore outside the adventure association to obtain resources or legendary weapons, but there will be rewards and risks, and your chess pieces may encounter various accidents. So please find the place where the current attributes of the card appear to match it 2. Purchase land in the main city and build the resources you want to produce. These venues will provide materials for each round. Also, the person who loses in each round will receive a deduction of gold coins and be given to the victorious person. Battle rules: The system will randomly assign the opposing sides, divided into attacking and defending sides. The attacking side can use magic cards twice in battle. The defensive side can only use one magic card, but they can set traps during the preparation phase to trigger when the opponent attacks. The rest will depend on the battles of the knights! Regardless of the gameplay, I will try my best to showcase the characteristics and skills of the knights. If you have any good ideas or ideas, you can also send them to me. Let's implement it together . About in-game cards: I will default all card types to everyone in the game (including all different professions, magic trap cards. I will also add new types in the future), as well as card packs dropped twice a week. These should be enough for everyone to play. As I am completely unfamiliar with numerical values, please play them as casual games. We will weaken or enhance based on everyone's collective opinions. Please understand. Each knight possesses four attributes: profession, skill, talent, and bond. Hero cards (such as SR and SSR) have fixed talents and bonds , and professions and skills are random . The professions, skills, talents, and bonds of other knights are all random , so when drawing, other knights may encounter extremely unfavorable situations. (These random parts will be fixed when extracted) ]There are currently a total of 54 talents (9 additional talents will appear during the adventure in the knight's self riding mode), 87 skills, 20 professions, and 16 bonds. I will try my best to utilize the attributes on the card to their fullest potential in each game mode Each card is not unique, so rest assured.

row.name: Love In The Dark
row.detailed_description: Dark Love is a multiplayer cooperative horror game where players need to form a team and work together to save the protagonist's girlfriend, who has been possessed by an evil spirit. [Game Plot] The girlfriend is a recent graduate in civil engineering, full of hope for the future, but she gets assigned to work in a remote mountain area. Despite being separated due to work reasons, the couple maintains a sweet romantic relationship. Tonight, while talking with the girlfriend on the phone, she suddenly receives a call from a local wealthy businessman inviting her to his house. The businessman claims to have an important project that he wants the girlfriend to handle, hoping to exchange engineering experiences with her. Although the girlfriend is very reluctant, she reluctantly agrees to the businessman's invitation for the sake of their future. For the next few hours, you anxiously wait for the girlfriend's message, but there is no response. You become extremely worried as her phone is also unreachable. Feeling panicked, you immediately rush to the businessman's house with your friends. When you open the door to the businessman's house, a strong smell of blood hits your nose. You cautiously peek inside and find the floor covered in bloodstains, while the businessman sits in a chair, pale and staring at you. Your heart races with fear and disbelief. You feel a sense of despair, suspecting that the girlfriend's situation might not be optimistic. Suddenly, a foreboding feeling arises in your heart, and you quickly turn around, only to see the girlfriend's figure appearing at the door. She looks terrified, with tattered clothes and wounds all over her body, rushing towards you... [Gameplay] Teamwork: Players need to form a team of up to 4 members. Each player has different skills and abilities, requiring proper task allocation and mutual cooperation. Mysterious Rituals: The game's objective is to save the girlfriend possessed by an evil spirit. To achieve this, players must find and destroy ritual items hidden throughout various locations. Exploration and Puzzle-Solving: Players need to explore the game map and solve various puzzles and challenges to find clues and items to help the team complete the mission. Confronting the Demon: During the game, players must face the attacks of the evil demon. She will chase players and attempt to capture them, requiring the team to avoid her and find defensive methods. Agility and Strategy: Players need to demonstrate agility and strategic thinking. They must react quickly, allocate tasks properly, and use various items and skills to survive and accomplish the game's objectives. Visuals and Sound Effects: The game's design and sound effects create a horrifying atmosphere, immersing players in a tense and terrifying gaming experience. Overall, Dark Love is a horror survival game that tests teamwork and strategic abilities. Players must work together to find clues, solve puzzles, and be cautious in facing the demon to successfully save the protagonist's girlfriend.
row.short_description: In this multiplayer horror game, a loving couple receives an invitation from a wealthy man for an event. Despite my concerns, she insists on going. To protect her, I decide to secretly join and keep her safe.

row.name: The Light in the Darkness
row.detailed_description: The Light in the Darkness is a captivating role-playing game that takes players on an emotional journey through the dark times of the Nazi occupation of France during World War II. In this game, players take on the role of a Polish Jewish family living in Paris, experiencing the hardships and challenges they face as they try to survive in a world that is becoming increasingly hostile towards them. Gameplay in The Light in the Darkness revolves around making choices and exploring the environment. Players will interact with various characters, engage in dialogue, and make decisions. The game's story is told through a mix of in-game events and documentary evidence, which adds a layer of authenticity to the experience. The game also features a variety of simple mini-games, which help to break up the narrative and add variety to the gameplay. One of the key features of The Light in the Darkness is its educational platform. Players will be able to access archives and photos, as well as explore history in a way that is designed to make Holocaust education accessible for all, including those who don't have the ability to visit museums.
row.short_description: The Light in the Darkness tells the story of a working-class family of Polish Jews in France during the Holocaust. It is the first videogame to portray the Holocaust, releasing free for educational purposes.
row.reviews: “Opening with the Évian Conference of 1938, which doomed Jewish refugees by refusing them entry to safe countries, the game follows a family of Polish Jews in Paris as they experience the Nazi occupation, leading, ultimately, to the Vel d’Hiv roundup in 1942. In the space of a moving hour, Bernard touches on the Nuremberg Laws, antisemitism in fairy tales and anti-Jewish propaganda. He shows how the Holocaust was, pace Whoopi Goldberg, a “race-based” genocide and how quickly France went from embracing Jews to sending them to their deaths.” The Times “Mr. Bernard’s approach could even be used to deepen people’s understanding of other genocides. The game arrives at an urgent moment. The Anti-Defamation League, an advocacy group, reports that anti-Semitism has reached a record-high in America. Elsewhere, memories of Nazi horrors are waning as elderly survivors die. By keeping their stories alive, the game helps to inform new generations about the atrocities that Jews were made to endure.” The Economist “The Light in the Darkness forces you to consider the terrifying emotional truth of this dark chapter in history... it’s hard to think of another game that has really dug into the horrors and the trauma of the war like this.” Radio Times

row.name: DawnOfCombat
row.detailed_description: Battle at Dawn' is a game I developed independently in my spare time, created out of a passion for the hobby. The game is distributed for free, and I welcome interested peers to join in the exchange and learning. My BiliBili homepage is: The game is still in the development stage, and the launched version only contains the core combat slice. I hope to gather everyone’s ideas and opinions during the early experience stage to continuously refine and optimize this product. In this game, players will find themselves in a vast universe full of unknowns and challenges. They will pilot a spaceship in this endless sea of stars, battling hordes of enemies in an intense competition for survival. Before each round of the game starts, players need to remodel their spaceship and choose weapons to prepare for the upcoming battles. They may have to remove some armor and shields to install more weapons, meaning they must take on greater risks but at the same time, the potential rewards could also be higher. Throughout the game, players need to collect coins dropped by enemies upon their death. These coins can be used to purchase various upgrades in the store. These stores randomly appear during the player's game progress, and players need to fly their spaceship over the store to buy upgrades. Choosing and allocating these upgrades wisely is key to victory. Each new game represents a whole new set of challenges and possibilities. Players need to constantly adapt and evolve in the ever-changing battlefield in order to survive and win. Whether to risk choosing more powerful weapons, or finding the store at the right moment for upgrades, each decision could impact the final outcome of the game. 'DawnOfCombat' is waiting for every player seeking excitement and challenge, as they navigate their way to glory and victory in this infinite cosmic adventure.
row.short_description: I'm elated to unveil 'Battle at Dawn,' a game born of my passion, now in development. Immerse in core combat, navigate a universe teeming with challenges, and join me in refining this free experience. Your insights are golden! Explore more on BiliBili:

row.name: Werelderfgoed: Romeins Aquaduct van Nijmegen en Berg en Dal
row.detailed_description: In de 1e eeuw voor Christus zetten de Romeinse legers voor het eerst voet op het grondgebied van Nijmegen. In het gebied bouwden ze legerkampen, waar vanuit zij vochten tegen de Germanen. Eén van deze legerkampen was gevestigd op de Hunerberg. De soldaten in het kamp moesten onder andere worden voorzien van vers water. Daarom werd een aquaduct aangelegd dat water van natuurlijke bronnen naar het legerkamp leidde. Het traject was zo’n 5,5 km lang en loopt door de huidige gemeenten Nijmegen en Berg en Dal. Het Romeinse aquaduct van Nijmegen en Berg en Dal is uniek in Nederland en is onderdeel van het Werelderfgoed de Neder-Germaanse Limes. Deze visualisatie laat zien hoe verschillende delen van het Romeinse aquaduct van Nijmegen en Berg en Dal eruit moet hebben gezien. Verschillende locaties langs het traject van het aquaduct zijn te bezoeken en kunnen van dichtbij worden bekeken.
row.short_description: Ontdek hoe het Romeinse aquaduct van Nijmegen en Berg en Dal eruit moet hebben gezien. Bezoek verschillende locaties langs het traject, van de bron tot de waterbak in het Romeinse legerkamp.

row.name: Call of Farming
row.detailed_description: A game where you can create your own farming or simulation game. It includes an inventory, crafting, buildings, growing plants, farm animals and much more. Call of Farming includes everything you need in a farming or simulation themed build. Add new items, structures, plants and animals, customize it to your needs. Key Features Top-Down, Third Person or First Person Inventory system Crafting system Equipment (depending on character) Resource gathering Character attributes (health, energy...) Farming (Seed planting, plant/fruit growing, hoeing, irrigation) Farm Animals (eat, grow, produce) Wild Animal behavior (wandering, running away, chasing) Hunting and Fishing Food and cooking NPC shop to buy/sell items Combat (attack and hp) Product durability and food spoilage Storage boxes (chest) Domestic animals (chasing, attacking and digging behaviors) Riding Level system and XP Bonus effects (Consumables or equipment that increase stats). Game clock, day/night cycle Save/load system Art Animated characters (male and female) Animated animals (cow, sheep, chicken, pig, deer, bear, squirrel, bird...) Base material (wood, grass, rock, straw...) Gathering tools (hoe, scythe, axe, pickaxe, fishing rod, ...) Food (fruits, apples, nuts, meat, fish, ...) Cooked foods (tacos, popcorn, bread...) Structures (fences, barbecue, crate...) Environment (trees, bushes, rocks, ground patterns...) Agricultural plants (strawberry, pumpkin, pepper, tomato, wheat...) Town models (lamp, bench, houses, shop stand...) All 2D icons for interactive models

row.name: 태백 가문의 사람들 : Prologue
row.detailed_description: Sorry. This game is not available in english. 반갑군. 나는 신호석이라고 한다. 일정한 거주지를 두지 않고 여기저기 방랑하면서 살아가고 있지. 그날도 열심히 떠돌아다니고 있었는데 태백 중공업의 이사께서 나를 찾더군. 이야기를 들어보니 이제 곧 태백 그룹 회장의 장례식이 열리는데 거기에 자기 아들 대신 참석해서 유산을 받아와 달라는 거야. 왜 하필 이 몸을 선택했느냐고? 그야 내가 태백 중공업의 이사가 인정할 만큼 능력 있는 녀석이기 때문 아니겠어? 일단 유산을 받아내면 섭섭지 않은 보수도 주겠다는군. 나로서는 거절할 이유가 없었지. 그래서 장례식에 참여하기로 했어. 그렇게 회장의 집에서 1주일을 보내게 되었지. 이건 바로 그 1주일 동안 있었던 일들을 기록한 이야기야. = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = 태백 가문의 사람들 : Prologue 태백 가문의 사람들은 노벨 타입의 어드벤처 게임입니다. 유산 상속 과정에서 일어나는 일들을 경쾌하게 담아낸 게임으로, 약간의 미스터리, 약간의 웃음, 약간의 연애 요소를 포함하고 있습니다. 이야기를 읽어가며 중간에 등장하는 분기 지점에서 선택문을 선택하는 것으로 여러가지 결말과 다양한 전개를 확인할 수 있습니다. 프롤로그 버전은 게임 도중에 종료되며, 선택에 따라서 2개의 배드 엔딩을 볼 수도 있습니다. 게임이 완성되기까지 적지 않은 시간이 필요할 것 같아, 우선 초반 부분을 프롤로그 버전으로 등록하게 되었습니다. 저사양에 플레이 타임도 짧고, 메모리도 적게 사용하고, 로딩도 거의 없으니 자투리 시간에 가벼운 마음으로 해보시길 권해드립니다.

row.name: Stacks:Jungle!
row.detailed_description: Stacks:Jungle is an adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey filled with crafting, quests, and exploration! Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, gather loyal companions, try delicious exotic food, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more. Please use the Steam discussion forums if you notice any issues with the game or the included localizations. Key Features: Immerse yourself in a beautiful and magical jungle environment, where adventure and exciting quests await, all through the power of cards! Powered by the Stacks: Engine, a card game framework heavily inspired by the renowned Stacklands game. Collect, create, and use over 150 unique cards. Learn and master 70+ craft recipes creating game-changing strategies. Explore 22 breathtaking locations filled with mysteries and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Take on over 200 tasks and quests, testing your skills and unraveling the jungle's mysterious lore. Choose from three captivating scenarios: go on a treasure hunt, master the art of fishing, or indulge in the beauty of butterfly collecting.

row.name: FatalZone: Outbreak
row.detailed_description: Survival takes a deadly toll… The world has been ravaged by a zombie virus, but humanity doesn’t give up that easily! Outbreak is the demo version of FatalZone, a bullet heaven zombie apocalypse shooter where you have to clear a path to safety through hordes of the living dead. The demo version includes: 1 location 4 character classes 30 unique perks to upgrade your characters with 6 types of weapons 6 types of armor 28 attack and defense skills 10 evolution paths for weapons and attack skills 31 enemy types (12 of them have unique art) 6 different difficulty levels for the location 6 base camp buildings, each with its own features and 3 upgrade levels 51 character stats Lots of mutations that change character stats randomly 5 powerups (on top of all the resources and XP) 34 achievements Take on the zombie epidemic and add the full game to your Wishlist to get notified when it launches! Your mission is complete if you hold out for 30 minutes during a raid. Can you last that long? If you're about to be overwhelmed by the zombie onslaught, just get to the chopper! Evac is always an option—wrap your mission up early and live to fight another day. Risk your merc to get resources and upgrade your base, level up your skills, and develop a deadly build to fight the undead. In this world, whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger! But remember, no one is immortal... Develop your survivor camp to unlock buffs. Upgrade merc skills in the Training Hall, recruit new mercs at the Mercenary Base, and upgrade your weapons and armor in the workshop. Upgraded buildings increase your chances of survival. During a run, your mercs are exposed to the virus that takes its toll on the body. A bigger viral load undermines a merc's physical state and increases their chances of developing a mutation that could be beneficial or detrimental. Experiment to create the most viable fighter! Features: Upgrade your camp to unlock buffs, equipment, and mercs Your mission is complete if you hold out for 30 minutes during a raid, but you can always cut your game session short by evacuating the contaminated area. Hire and train new mercs to replace KIAs Use the evac copter to wrap up missions early Create the most effective merc build Gain mutations that give unique skills or debuffs Use the inventory to place weapons and armor. Weapons grant starting fighting skills, while armor provides stats Choose from 5 levels of difficulty Fight on procedurally generated maps. Every run is a new challenge! Unlock numerous achievements to prove your mettle

row.detailed_description: Before you say 'Oh here's another Battle Royal game' Let me tell you FWTF aka Fun with the Fitzgerald's it's what it says in the title it's all just about the fun. My six-year-old Daughter is a massive gamer just like I was at her age but most of the more suitable popular titles were just too difficult for her. So we teamed up to create a simple yet fun Battle royal game that can be enjoyed by all ages. The Fitzgerald's family is a fun loving bunch. Drop into the land where you will find a cool array of weapons to knock out your opponents with. From small snowball guns to epic ice blasters or electric zappers, rocket launchers, slime bomb guns, and paintball guns there are so many fun ways to play be sure to grab a cake or two and splatter your opponents right in the face. Pick up and eat beans to land smelly pumps. For quick getaways get your hands on a jetpack to fly away if you're finding yourself in trouble. The battle is played out on the Fitzgerald land and there can be only one king or queen of the land. There are handy level shops around the land to buy your favourite weapons by simply collecting as many coins and diamonds from the wide range of chests scattered around the land and if you are lucky enough to pick up some x-ray glasses you can seek out your opponents much easier. The safe zone will shrink in fast making matches quick and fun. Oh by the way watch out for Bruce the zombie and the ghost of posh aunt's mansion they think they own the Fitzgerald's land too. So come on and join in on the fun.

row.name: 鈴集無名の丘 ～ Little Doll Queen
row.detailed_description: [1.About the game] Little Doll Queen is a derivative work (fangame) of the Touhou Project series under Team Shanghai Alice. In this game, you play as living dolls, following the instructions of your master. (well, except Medicine) It's a danmaku experience full of poisons and suffocation. That means, this is a shooting game (bullet hell), where the screen is full of enemy bullets which you have to avoid, and enemies which you have to shoot. Your goal is to defeat the enemies and clear the levels one at a time, in sequence, to solve the incident affecting Gensokyo. [2.Story] Gensokyo suddenly plunged into a huge miasma of toxic fog, and the lands are now gloomy and lifeless. But that is not the only problem: Children’s spirits have flooded out en masse to possess nearby phantoms and fairies. The source of these strange phenomena is the Nameless Hill, a forgotten land of sin. These spirits have overwhelmed the lands, from the Sai no Kawara to Gensokyo, and the miasma’s spread has taken the usual human incident resolvers out of commission. In response, the sage Okina Matara held a discussion with the other sages of Gensokyo, and sent out her two dancers to solve the incident. Meanwhile, in the Primate Spirit Garden, Keiki Haniyasushin sent out her pride and joy –- Mayumi Joutouguu –- to investigate, in the hopes of expanding her territory into Gensokyo. As for Medicine Melancholy, someone who dwells in the Nameless Hill itself, she appearsto have set off on her own. In particular, she is conducting her affairs, in her own time, separately compared to the others, as if with her own agenda in mind. Thus, the four of them headed towards the Nameless Hill. Coincidentally, all four of them are doll-like beings. [3.Controls] Up, down, left, right : Control your character Shot key (Z) : Shoot Bomb key (X) : Spell card (bomb) (limited use) Slow key (Shift) : Slow down your movement. This puts your character in a focused state (focusing), so your character’s hitbox and grazebox will also be visible. Pause key (Esc) : Pause the game User 1 key (C) : Perform a Spirit Release (explained later) User 2 key (V) : Press and hold this key after the first text box of any dialogue scene, to skip subsequent text boxes. In-game, only Satono and Mai can use this key, to swap between each other. Please see the “config.exe” file next to the game executable, for reference and reassigning of the controls above. Alt+Enter : Toggles between window mode and fullscreen mode. Left Ctrl: Speeds up replays and the Staff Roll. [4.System and items] Spellcard item : Gives you an extra spell card (bomb). Point item : These give you score, and also raise your M-Point Item Value. The height at which you collect them is irrelevant. Infant spirit item : Collecting this charges up your Spirit Release for use. See the relevant section for further details. Infant Spirit Meter : When spirit items are collected, the Infant Spirit Meter on the right of the screen fills up. See Spirit Release for further details. Heart’s Poison Meter : This is a meter of lily of the valley flowers (a.k.a. suzuran, or convallaria majalis) on the far right. As you graze bullets, the meter fills from right to left. Once full, it turns white, and you unlock a Last Word, an optional end-of-level extra attack. Last Words do not take away lives or bombs even if you fail, so they are always beneficial to you. [5.Spirit Release] Defeated spirits and fairies drop a fixed amount of infant spirit items. Infant spirit items fill the Infant Spirit Meter on the right of the screen. When it is full, you can use a Spirit Release with the User 1 key (C), and release the infants’ spirits around you. This creates a shockwave attack that keeps you invincible, and clears away enemies and their bullets, like taking candy from a baby. Except you’re taking the babies... and you’re throwing the babies at enemies... and the babies have long since passed away. (there’s no candy either lol) There’s no candy, but each Spirit Release produces a free spellcard item (bomb) for you, so use the Spirit Release proactively! [6.Miasma Promptuary] A list of the poison clouds you will see in this game is provided below. Pink : Has a diamond texture. Collect it for an extra life! Oh, how refreshing! Red : Staying inside for too long is dangerous; you will lose a life after 2 second. Orange: These clouds fire out bullets, so stay far away. Yellow : You’ll be immobilised as long as you’re inside it. Green : You’ll move faster as long as you’re inside it, for better or worse. Light blue : Totally safe; guides your way through poison. Can still visually distract you. Indigo : A puff of pacifism. You won’t be able to shoot when inside. Purple : Perhaps you’re already familiar with purple miasma; it slows you down. It’s an old friend! But you have no camera to help you this time. Use the Poison Lab found in the main menu to practice working with the poisons' appearances and effects for yourself. [7.Advice for Novices] Pink poison clouds with diamond textures are Extends (extra lives). Get extra bombs from Spirit Releases. Please look for the pink clouds and frequently use Spirit Releases! Pink clouds have diamond textures, but there are also dangerous red poisons -- you must tell them apart. If you see suspicious objects approaching, a basic strategy is Streaming and Restreaming. Focus (press Shift), then slowly move sideways, thus gathering aimed bullets together behind you, giving you space. When running out of space, do a quick dash in the same direction, wait, and let the aimed attacks target your new location. Then you can stream back in reverse. Remember to use spell cards (bombs) anytime you feel threatened; it’s wiser than wasting all the bombs you currently have after accidentally getting hit. (The excess WILL be lost.) [8.Scoring] For advanced players looking to reach a high score, it is essential to avoid getting hit needlessly, capture spell cards successfully, and collect point items, which do not change their value depending on your height. Having lots of lives, spell cards, and point items ensures the end-of-stage score bonus is higher. Grazing helps, but is not single-handedly enough to greatly influence score. Of course, you should ensure you graze enough to unlock the Last Word, in order to get its spell card bonus and point items as well. [9.Flower Wreath of Death] If you are hit by a bullet, a flower wreath effect appears on you and shrinks away in half a second. Using a spell card (bomb) during this time produces a deathbomb. Deathbombs are almost identical to normal spell cards (bombs), but there will be an additional flower wreath that expands outwards from you. Continuous damage is dealt to enemies enclosed within. Do note that deathbombs will always consume TWO spell cards. Only one spell card will be consumed if you have exactly one left.
