row.name: Star Legacy VR
row.detailed_description: Regarding the Suspension of Updates on Steam Regarding the Suspension of Updates on Steam Due to the limited manpower within our team, we have devoted a significant amount of time to the optimization and updates for the Quest standalone VR system. As a result, we are unable to continue to guarantee the frequency of updates or the gaming experience on the Steam version. Consequently, we have made the difficult decision to temporarily suspend updates for the Steam version of our game. For those who wish to experience the latest version of our game, we encourage you to visit the Quest platform to download the updated content. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all our players for your affection and support throughout this journey.and we welcome you to join our community to discuss everything about the game with us. Thank you for your understanding and continued passion for our game. About the Game Game Background： As an interstellar guardian, the player will travel between various planets to protect the interstellar heritage while fending off waves of enemy attacks in the game's universe, which is full of interstellar artifacts and mysterious energy. Gameplay & Features： This is a VR shooting game with Roguelike elements, featuring multiple planets for you to challenge. Each planet offers a unique environment to explore. Choose from a variety of characters, each bringing a new gaming experience. With a wide selection of weapons available, each offering different control mechanics and immersive audio-visual feedback, you can customize your gameplay. Unlock numerous skills and props to enhance your abilities and defeat waves of enemy attacks. Face powerful chiefs as you showcase your gaming prowess. With each enemy wave lasting a few minutes, strategize ways to destroy them and make use of the store to acquire items in-between waves. Although the current version includes only one planet, three weapons, one character, dozens of skills and props, one leader, and some monsters, the focus is on enhancing the overall gaming experience and optimizing audio-visual feedback. Future updates will continue to expand the game's content. Values： Be wild always places the players first. We decided to release the demo version of our game in its early development stage with the intention of continuously improving and enhancing it based on player feedback regarding their overall gameplay experience. Our goal is to provide players with an immersive experience that truly maximizes their enjoyment of weapons, skills, and combat. We will intensify our efforts during the Early Access phase to further refine the game. What comes next： We will focus on enhancing the game content by introducing a wider variety of characters, weapons, skills, and props. Additionally, we aim to incorporate more diverse battle scenes and dynamic scene transitions. To further enhance the gameplay experience, we will introduce a range of captivating monsters. Simultaneously, we will be dedicated to refining the art effects, as well as improving the AI of monsters and bosses to create even more engaging battles. Taking into account player feedback, we will continuously optimize weapons, skills, and overall immersion to deliver a unique gaming experience. About our Studio： We are a Singapore-based independent game studio, known as 'Be Wild'.
row.short_description: Star Legacy VR is an immersive virtual reality shooting game that incorporates intriguing Roguelike elements into gameplay. Players assume the roles of interstellar guardians who venture across diverse planets and traverse through various time zones.

row.name: Sword of Convallaria
row.detailed_description: An Epic Collaboration Coming Soon! ⚔ Join the Sword of Convallaria Discord Server! About the Game PROFOUND STORY Journey through to Iria, a mineral-rich country whose magical resources have drawn unwanted attention from dangerous external factions. As tensions rise and riots break out, it’s up to you as a mercenary leader to navigate complex situations whilst finding ways to save the fate of Iria. STRATEGIC TURN-BASED COMBAT Experience authentic grid-based tactical battles. Deploy unique allies against diverse enemy types and use every battlefield detail whether it's a cliff, boulder, obstacle, or even a bangalore to secure victory. CHOICE-BASED NARRATIVE Your decisions shape how your town evolves and influence the unfolding story. Be sure to Build relationships and skills to your advantage, and watch as the storyline changes depending on your choices and achievements. “NeoPixel” ART “NeoPixel” retains the popular pixel-style graphics, whilst adding modern 3D renderings (real-time shading, full-screen bloom, dynamic depth of field, HDR, etc.), contributing to premium HD picture quality and lighting effects. STUNNING HERO COLLECTION & DEVELOPMENT Recruit and train a roster of unique companions at the tavern, teach them amazing skills, build their equipment at the forge, improve their stats in the training field, and lead your self-built mercenary group into legendary quests with different factions SCORE BY HITOSHI SAKIMOTO Music producer Hitoshi Sakimoto - best known for scoring FF Tactics, FFXII, and Tactics Ogre - lends his passion to Sword of Convallaria with his finest musical pieces to date. JAPANESE VOICE-OVER STARS Enjoy performances from over 40 anime and game voice-acting stars like Inoue Kazuhiko, Yuki Aoi, and Eguchi Takuya who bring each character to life.
row.short_description: Fantasy Tactical RPG revitalizing the beloved Japanese turn-based & pixel art genre. Collect & train a roster of mercenaries, customize your squad, and use your own strategy to save the nation of Iria. Journey through a world of plot twists where every choice you make will reshape your destiny.

row.name: Noble's Life: Kingdom Reborn - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Fires in the villages and cities in the south of France haven't yet extinguished and big English armies are already wreaking havoc in the north. War spreads over new territories, more countries are involved in the conflict, Brittany is plunging into a civil war, and high war taxes are pushing peasants into revolts. The power of the Church has also been broken, it is fought by simony, nepotism and heresies. Meanwhile, the Pope remains in Avignon's captivity. To make matters worse, the first rumors of a mysterious epidemic, that will soon be known as the Black Death, reach Europe. In the uncertain times of the Hundred Years' War, you play as a noble who goes to war at the behest of his king, for which your enemies repay you by devastating your estate. In this unique combination of simulator and strategy game, you will get a chance to lead the rebuilding of a city - the center of your lands - and restore the power in your family's villages. To do this, you will have to make hundreds of decisions and find your ruling style. Free prologue will give you an overview of the early stages of the game, which include the first three months meaning over an hour of gameplay. You'll have the chance to manage a city devastated after the assault, trying to bring it back to life while trying to determine who dared to attack your subjects. Dozens of decisions await you showing the potential of the game's non-linearity and the first, also dramatic, consequences of your decisions. Your choices will affect the look of the city, which you will be free to explore, and the townsfolk, each of whom will be interactive and many of whom will offer all sorts of opportunities to strengthen your estate. Decide on taxes and conscription of peasants into the army, write letters, but also look for clues, as not everything is as it seems at first. And create your own battle plan, then command your troops in real time in a skirmish presenting the beginnings of an unusual and realistic battle system we are preparing. You play the role of a single nobleman, not an omnipotent entity with control over each subject. Therefore, control your estates by imposing or lowering taxes, organizing military conscription among the population, employing specialists, financing various projects, settling disputes, negotiating with various factions or local magnates. Increase your prestige by organizing balls, festivals or tournaments. You can also fill the treasury with stolen goods by doing raids, but then your city should be prepared for the possible revenge of your enemies. You have the option to both take care of everything yourself, as well as commission some tasks to an employable advisers. On the other hand, under the layer of negotiations, elections, orders and diplomatic correspondence, you will find an extensive economic system, giving you many different paths to expand your lands. Decide what kind of ruler you want to be. Each path will give you access to different types of investments, units, diplomatic options, and ways to deal with problems. A battle-hardened raider, a saintly paladin with the support of the Church, a skilful diplomat with allies, a wealthy, enterprising aristocrat who can afford mercenaries, an alchemist ruler, a mad sadist magnate, a carefree swagger are just some of the paths to follow. Nothing prevents you from combining several of them. Find your ruling style! There is a war going on, so the enemy will come to your gates sooner or later. May you be ready! Order recruits to train, turning them into loyal soldiers, pay for the construction of defense machines, invest in fortifications and prepare a detailed plan to defend the city. Additionally, when the enemy approaches the city and prepares to conquer it by attacking the walls, you personally manage the defense. Hard, high walls, siege machines, skillful use of units, and the right strategy will allow you to survive, even when the enemy overwhelms you with numbers. Gather and equip mounted warriors and lead them to plunder enemy lands, harass the vanguard of a larger army, suppress a rebellion or defend your lands. Remember that you have to act quickly and that you can sometimes face unexpectedly great forces. Then, pay attention to the terrain and weather, as well as the equipment of the defenders. There is nothing worse than driving uphill under fire from the archers on top. We focus on historical accuracy, being inspired by the most interesting events of the period. The goal is to reflect the realities of the medieval city and the challenges faced by aristocrats. All this so you can feel the atmosphere by playing the ruler you have created. In addition, the main plot of the game is closely related to one of the most interesting and the longest ever military conflict in Europe - The Hundred Years' War. Feel what it's like to rule real people and face challenges never seen in strategy games. Fight diseases, negotiate with parties that have their own interests, take care of the loyalty of commanders, but also settle (or not) conflicts and problems of ordinary subjects. Rule your lands wisely or brutally crush any manifestations of rebellion or betrayal. Find your ruling style!
row.short_description: Experience the first months after a brutal assault on your own estate in the free prologue of a realistic simulator of a medieval noble combined with a strategy game of historical depth. Manage your town and villages and make decisions in non-linear events.
row.notes: This game is set in the Middle Ages, where the player takes on the role of a noble. The player engages in raids and sieges where people and horses can die of the weapons from the era. The game shows blood effects and death animations. Player's character can consume beer and wine. Texts from the game contain moderately vulgar languages and archaic forms of curses such as bastard, bloody hell, sard, etc.

row.name: Wrong Landing
row.detailed_description: in General : You're ex-military, you and your team were sent on a secret mission after 10 years of non-service, to check out an island where nuclear weapons and radiation were allegedly being tested, after you land badly on the island you have to face hunger, thirst, cold, but most of all fear, you have to make tools, build shelters and try to SURVIVE. You are the only survivor in the whole team and you try to understand the island. Procedural vital system : - For example to keep from getting cold, just start running to keep warm or you need to find a heat source like fire or armor or your health will decrease - when you are in a scary situation, your fear rises and hunger is decreasing faster - each level procedurally increases the maximum level of hunger and thirst - etc... Interesting inventory and crafting : Each item has specific place, like in game the forest... About me and team: Hi, i am Honza Záruba, i am 16 years old and I've been interested in games since I was little, but I didn't always want to just play games but also create them... since 2018 I've been interested in game development in unity engine so at the end of 2022 I decided to do this... it's not as I expected but it's enjoyble and that's the main thing, I want to share it with you and collect feedbacks for future updates :) Thanks for all! We also have a lot of testers, art designers and story creators (Daniela Drábková, Miroul, Jamal, Filip, etc...)

row.name: 水母之夜
row.detailed_description: BUG反馈：602466023@qq.com 遇到bug或者卡关需要帮助都可以发送邮件，会在收到1-2天内回复！（发在社区可能我没法及时看到T T...） 因为本人代码无能且没找到能用的插件，目前提到比较多但是暂无法处理的问题在这里做一个预警，确实非常抱歉【滑跪 steam对接相关：没有steam成就，F12截图 游戏内容相关：没有对话回顾功能，不支持多语言 如果不小心按快跳过了对话又想看，可以在b站搜索水母之夜，有本人录制的流程实况（卡关了也可以查看，近期会给实况分p并更新到和游戏内容完全一致） 背景介绍： 欢迎来到特里托普斯海洋乐园！这里展出一只拥有永恒生命的“红夜水母”，是城市的著名人气景点。 然而，不为人知的是，这里也是世界上唯一一所分裂体生产工厂。 每当夜幕降临，水母产生的奇异生物“分裂体”就会出现在游乐园中，与这些生物战斗，便是“回收员”的工作。 在故事中，新人回收员多尔尼将与队友们一起，展开在游乐园的工作与冒险生活，并探索关于游乐园和自身的更多真相！ 操作： 使用方向键移动，按住shift跑步。 Z或回车键调查，X或ESC显示菜单。 需按照指引调查并推进对话即可。 包含回合制战斗，有真结局和两个小的分支结局。 关于游戏： 《水母之夜》是一款剧情向的rpg小游戏，旨在给oc完整的一生！ 本质属于分享oc故事所以不开放小说，漫画等题材的二创以及cosplay（确实是有人问了所以提一句，明白大家也是出于喜爱所以还是非常感谢...） 关于实况录制： 非常欢迎大家录制游戏实况！我很想看！ 但是请不要在视频封面和标题添加涉及后半段剧情的内容，剧透可能会给其他玩家带来不好的体验。 感谢大家的谅解！

row.name: Darkless
row.detailed_description: Darkless looms over the Silent Mansion under the mysterious moonlight! Ghosts and spirits lurk, seeking to sow fear, but it could be that Nameless has unleashed more than he imagined. After being sentenced to the prison of a lamp as punishment for defying the powerful organization that rules the Mansion, Nameless is willing to do whatever it takes to defeat his enemies. Will you join him in this desperate battle? GET READY FOR AN EPIC ADVENTURE! ● Immerse yourself in an exciting single-player campaign with diverse and unique locations. ● Use your light as your faithful guide to navigate mysterious worlds. ● Uncover all the mysterious spectral medallions hidden throughout the levels. ● Embark on a chilling journey through a nightmarish world where appearances can deceive. ● Make friends with intriguing characters along your journey, each with their own fascinating personality. DISCOVER THE DARK WONDER OF DARKLESS Are you ready to enter the exciting world of children's horror? With Darkless, we have created an exciting 2D platformer that is suitable for all ages. In this game, the player's skill is tested in daring jumps and challenging puzzles, while exploring our protagonist's unique mechanic: the amazing light he emanates. We challenge you, player, will you be the hero who defeats the sinister X-Men, who have plunged the entire mansion into darkness? And most crucial of all, will you be able to recover Nameless's body from the clutches of the X-Men and their dark selfish designs? The fate of the mansion depends on you! Are you ready to face this exciting adventure full of terror and mystery? Discover the world of Darkless now!
row.short_description: Get ready for an adventure as Nameless, a clever spirit trapped in a lamp by a curse. Regain your form by exploring the Silent Mansion. Uncover secrets in this platform and puzzle game.

row.name: Uncharted Ocean 2
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord RECOMMENDED FOR YOU About the Game Time to set sail! This is destined to be a journey full of opportunities. Open new trade routes, accumulate fortunes, and establish a maritime empire of your own! It is also a dangerous journey, you must defeat the evil pirates and other mystical dangers the ocean offers to a captain. Each ship can be further transformed, from the stern, auxiliary sail, bow, armor, and cargo warehouse, all can be processed to meet your need. Wanna war? Then fit more cannons. More money? Build a larger warehouse. You will also meet interesting characters from all over the world, not only can you learn their backstories, but also recruit them to form a team with unique abilities and personalities. All of your partners will be responsible for the corresponding work on the ship, according to their expertise. To achieve the best outcome, you need to put everyone in their appropriate places. As the captain, you have a wide range of choices of professions and skills, as well as more powerful equipment, characters, and warships. Constantly strengthen yourself, and challenge harsh enemies in the deep sea. Once encountering pirates, you must move your fleet flexibly, avoid deadly blows, and defeat enemies through reasonable 'skills' . You can have a MOBA-like experience. As the adventure progresses, your fleet will enter into one instance after another, facing more powerful and special challenges. You can also play your captain as and dive into the heat of hand-to-hand combats, on both sea and land. The land instances are full of surprises too, with powerful bosses and treasures waiting for you! Making money en route is a major source of fun when sailing. In Uncharted Ocean 2, the prices of goods are dynamically changing according to the real supply and demand of goods. You must keep an eye on the market to make a profit. Ships are not only tools to conquer faraway places, but also cozy homes. You can carry out various activities such as planting, breeding and forging on your ship, which would give you rich profits. Based on the real world, Uncharted Ocean 2 builds an extremely large open world, with real land and sea terrain, as well as real coordinates and current systems. This open world is full of amazing details, the latest version has over 200 cities for you to explore each with its own unique flavor. In Tianjin, China, you will encounter storytellers and monkey players on the streets. You can see cherry blossoms and torii in Japan. In Vietnam, you will find the golden temples of Southeast Asia. In Europe, the spectacular churches and castles are a must to see. You're not the only adventurer, there are countless fleets traveling around you, sometimes competing against each other for treasures! Sometimes you will work together to form a powerful combined fleet to face challenging enemies, such as pirates’ dens or giant monsters in the deep sea. It is fascinating and full of depth and fun, and is sure to bring you a colorful and exciting sea adventure!

row.detailed_description: Next part of the URBO About the Game A relaxing puzzle game in which you build a miniaturized city on a green island in the middle of a vast azure lake. Get away from your daily routine and immerse yourself in the world of URBO: Dream One. Watch your city grow house by house. This is just one of the worlds of URBO. Each one offers the opportunity to build mysterious cities in an atmospheric, dreamlike setting. Focus on the game when you feel your mind needs a rest. Follow our news via the link below, perhaps it is exactly URBO's realms that you need for inspiration... URBO: Dream One features a grassy island with a mystical Tower, willing to reveal its secrets to those who are wise. The strange monuments that are part of the landscape hint at the mystical origins of this realm. Look at the world from different angles, at different times of day. row.name: Anarchy Park
row.detailed_description: Step right up to the most chaotic carnival you've ever seen: Anarchy Park! Dive into a frantic fusion of isometric exploration and intense bullet-hell action. In Anarchy Park, every twist and turn offers unpredictable challenges as you venture through a zany amusement park that's as dangerous as it is delightful. With a vibrant world painted in shades of madness, this isn't your typical day at the fair. Instead of sweet memories, you'll face four formidable bosses, each with their own unique styles and tricks up their sleeves. Beyond the bullet hell mayhem, players will explore an amusement park searching high and low for 10 elusive stars, if you manage to collect them all, you'll be rewarded with a silly prize to add to the adventure. Developed over 10 months with a dedication to challenge and precision, Anarchy Park provides players with a concise 2-5 hour adventure that packs a punch. Every moment in this park is meticulously crafted to test your skills, ensuring every victory feels earned. What sets Anarchy Park apart is its distinctive 3D shooting system – a feature seldom seen in isometric or top-down shooters. As you weave through a hailstorm of bullets and chaos, you'll need more than just quick reflexes; precision aiming and strategic planning are essential. Engage with enemies in three-dimensional space, challenging players to aim, shoot, and dodge in ways they've never done before. So, are you up for the challenge? Do you have the grit and gumption to survive the wild rides of Anarchy Park? Step in, take aim, and let the mayhem begin!
row.short_description: Welcome to Anarchy Park! An Isometric Boss Rush Bullet Hell set in a wacky amusement park! Featuring a 3D environment that will challenge your ability to aim, shoot and dodge simultaneously!

row.name: The Lost Son
row.detailed_description: Story Sean and Belle are on their way to visit their son for his birthday but suddenly they wake up in a mysterious world. Lost and confused, the couple ventures out into the unknown to find out where they are and where their son is. Gameplay In The Lost Son is a puzzle platformer where you play as two characters that you can switch between. Each character has a unique interaction with color. The blue character can only collide with blue barriers and pink circle can only collide with pink barriers. As simple as this constraint is it can create some interesting puzzles where you have to use both character's unique abilities to progress! Solo Mode Ready to take on the challenge all alone with that big brain of yours? In solo mode character switching is the key. Make sure to use both character's unique attributes and abilities to advance through the levels! Work Together Want to play with a friend? We've got you covered! In The Lost Son you can connect a controller to the game and it will automatically enter split-screen! Work together to beat the stages and have a blast! (Only works is there is one keyboard and one controller at the moment). Required - Keyboard & Mouse Co-op - A Keyboard & Mouse for the first player, and a controller for the 2nd player Keyboard Controls Move - Arrow Keys/A and D Switch Characters (only in single player mode) - Tab Pause - Escape Jump - Z/Space Stomp Attack - X/S Air Dash - C/Left Click Gamepad (2nd Player Only) D-Pad/Left Stick - Move Button South - Jump Button North - Air Dash Button East - Stomp Attack
row.short_description: The Lost Son is a short but challenging indie puzzle platformer game tease. Have your wits about you and use both characters to decode the cyber ruins and find your lost son!

row.name: Legend of Peks
row.detailed_description: The Legend of Peks was made using RPG Maker MZ's default RTP in less than 100 hours for a subathon challenge for the streamer IHasPeks. for the community While the game does use the default RTP. as commonly overused as it is, i hope you will find fun in this game You are free to download and play this game for free. Heading into the game please be aware of many inside references and possible issues The Legend of Peks Adventure Set forth in a world full of characters with whitty dialogue, crazy events and more. with a lot of inside references Combat Do battle with foes in the Active Time Battle system that adds a strategic layer to every battle you face. Fight everything from a snake, crab, pixie's and even a monkey. Fun Hopefully... but this was made with a lot of love and passion and i enjoyed every second of it

row.name: Legend of the Nine Colored Deer (九色鹿传说)
row.detailed_description: 'Legend of the Nine Colored Deer' is a third-person adventure puzzle game filled with Chinese mythological stories. In this fantastical world, players embark on a mysterious journey, exploring ancient mythical tales and the magical legend of the Nine-Colored Deer. The game features eight meticulously designed levels, each filled with puzzles, challenges, and surprises. In the game, players take on the role of a young adventurer who travels through the world of myths, seeking the trail of the Nine-Colored Deer. They must solve various puzzles and challenges, explore ancient ruins and mysterious caves, encounter mythical creatures and immortals, and face powerful enemies, all while unraveling the mysteries of the legend of the Nine-Colored Deer. Each level in the game has its own unique characteristics, requiring players to use their wits and skills to overcome various challenges. As the game progresses, players will unlock new abilities and equipment, enhancing their strength to face even greater challenges. 'Legend of the Nine-Colored Deer' not only allows players to experience the charm of ancient Chinese mythology but also immerses them in a fantasy world full of adventure and exploration. Get ready to embrace the challenges, unravel the mysteries of the Nine-Colored Deer, and become a legendary hero! Game Guide: left mouse button click item interaction Press and hold the right mouse button to rotate the viewing angle WASD moves, space jumps Words from the developers: This game commemorates a 'Nine Colored Deer' cartoon that we watched when we was a child. Our childhood memories are always so beautiful. I hope to contribute a small amount to the traditional culture. We will continue to work hard to make a series of related works of traditional cultural stories. Please forgive us for the shortcomings! Weiqi Zhao (producer + programming + 3d model + animation + game level design) Xiang Jin (special effects and optimization)
row.short_description: 'Legend of the Nine-Colored Deer' is an adventurous third-person puzzle game filled with Chinese mythology. Seeking the trail of the Nine-Colored Deer, solving puzzles, and unraveling the legend's mysteries. Explore a charming and fantastical world of adventure.

row.name: Childish Life Prologue
row.detailed_description: The preface of 'The Boy's Life' is a top-down pixel horror game. This game tells the story of a girl with a special fate who meets a cat and a mysterious talking body in a different world, and the body and cat help the girl return to the real world. Gameplay: Players need to control the girl to pass through each level. Due to her special fate, the girl has special skills in a different world, which can help players better avoid monsters and traps. Enemies: Enemies can be temporarily restricted by the player's skills, but cannot be killed. The enemies here are not the only danger and are also full of traps. Special mechanisms: Some mechanisms can provide lighting and open paths, but they can also activate some enemies. Players need to make instant route judgments. In addition, there are mechanisms on the map that can accelerate players' movements.
row.short_description: The game tells the story of a girl with a special fate who meets a cat and a mysterious talking body in a different world. The body and cat help the girl return to the real world. The girl has special skills in the other world, which can better avoid monsters and traps

row.name: The Brittle Epoch
row.detailed_description: A short walking narrative for people who enjoy relaxed exploration. In this experience you will walk the environment in first person listening to a narrative that is triggered in certain areas. It is less a game and more a short narrative artwork. A group of children are brought by a singularity AI to their new home in an abandoned subdivision. This story follows two of the girls, Flutter and Juniper, who explore the houses during a winter storm, interpreting what they find within. This is a immersive short story (one hour) that is part two of a trilogy. Part one is seen through a machinima video. It is a chapter in a larger interconnected narrative I am creating.
row.short_description: An immersive short story walking simulator. About an hour to complete for people who enjoy relaxed exploration while investing in a long term narrative project.
row.notes: There is a portion of the story which refers to the rape of Medusa by the Greek god Poseidon. Additionally there is artistic nudity.

row.name: Top Jump: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Step into the heart-pounding world of Top Jump: the exhilarating prologue that will put your speed and agility to the test! Embark on an epic ascent through the treacherous cave, leaping from platform to platform, all while avoiding deadly traps and obstacles. This action-packed prologue offers a thrilling taste of the full Top Jump experience, where every jump counts and every second matters. In this prologue version, you'll get a glimpse of the challenging terrain. Although the prologue offers only a portion of the map, it's enough to showcase the adrenaline-fueled excitement that lies ahead. Prepare to be captivated by the vibrant visuals and immersive gameplay that will leave you craving more! Ready to be a part of the Top Jump legacy? Add this prologue to your gaming collection now and get a taste of the vertical racing adventure that awaits.
row.short_description: Introducing Top Jump: The thrilling prologue that tests your speed and agility! Scale the cave, avoid obstacles, and race for the top spot on the limited map. Get a taste of the action now !

row.name: Dropkick Navvy: First Step
row.detailed_description: ' First Step ' is a short demo for the upcoming 'Dropkick Navvy', designed to help us fine-tune the fun. Do you dig crafting games like Minecraft , Astroneer , and Forager ? How about goofy physics sims like Human: Fall Flat or Moving Out ? We love both — so we smushed em together! Go ham on rocks and trees with slapdash tools you made yourself, then pile ‘em into your little wicker basket and wobble back to your workbench in charmingly precarious fashion. Or just dropkick them suckers clear across the map. Ain't nobody got time for all that. Roam the cosmos and knock down everything in your path to turn them into stuff! Can’t hold all the stuff? Try throwing it or using a basket or something! Craft some tools! And then craft some more tools! And keep crafting until you run out! Then use those tools to help you gather more stuff to craft even more tools. Oh, and workbenches too! Don’t forget the Growth Potions. Craft some of those and throw them at the World Tree! Watch the World Tree grow taller! So tall that you might need a little boost to reach its branches! Expand, expand, expand, until you can’t expand anymore! New lands, new materials, new puzzles just waiting to be revealed!
row.short_description: Dropkick Navvy: First Step is a physics-based crafting/survival sim. Help the World Tree rebuild the broken cosmos as the responsibility falls upon you. Scurry through diverse landscapes, gather essential resources, and build your way towards finding the eternal source of water for the World Tree.

row.name: IronWolf: Free Non-VR Edition
row.detailed_description: IronWolf was originally designed from the ground up for VR and we're excited to make a standalone NON-VR version of the game that's free for everyone. This free version includes all of the missions from the original IronWolf VR as well as the randomly generated missions, however it does not include the map based OpenWorld gameplay, submarine upgrades or leaderboards. If you want to experience this in VR or if you want to enjoy the OpenWorld Gameplay and other features check out IronWolf VR. Unleash torpedoes on enemy ships, shoot down fighters and bombers using anti-aircraft guns, and attempt to survive depth charges dropped by deadly destroyers. Gameplay Fast paced shooting to repel enemy planes with the .50 cal machine gun Stealthily hunt enemy merchant convoys Duel with enemy destroyers, frigates and battleships Single and Multi player Cooperative online multiplayer Play on your own by enabling assists to your requirements
row.short_description: This is the Free Non-VR version of IronWolf VR. A co-op submarine game with a light touch on realism, making the submarine sim genre accessible to a wider audience.

row.name: World of Rune
row.detailed_description: Welcome to World of Rune, a thrilling and immersive MMORPG where you'll embark on epic adventures across a stunning fantasy world filled with magic and danger. With countless quests, dungeons, and battles to conquer, you'll never run out of excitement in this action-packed game. Customize your character, team up with friends and pets, and take on powerful bosses to unlock new areas and uncover hidden treasures. Get ready to explore a vast and magical universe! ● Four Playable Classes with Unique Abilities You start out as a novice class character, and later you can choose a class. You can play as a Swordsman, Mage, Archer and Cleric. Make your character your own – become a unique adventurer in the world of Rune. ● Unique Card System There are over 100+ cards in the game, each with their own unique abilities and stats. You’ll need to collect them in order to become stronger! Collect and Level up your cards to unlock more abilities and powers to conquer different monsters and bosses. ● Partners Formation: Combat with Your Partner Call the best fighters in the land to fight by your side. Collect partners as you adventure through the land and add them to your formation. Deploy partners to increase your Power and join more difficult dungeons and battles. ● Trustworthy Pets to Keep You Company Collect and grow mystical pets that help you on adventures. You can also capture monsters in dungeons to raise them as new pets. ● Hunt the Boss and Win Rich Loots Explore unique maze dungeons and defeat the Boss! Get rare and exciting drops from dungeons to get stronger and increase EXP. Take your character’s power to the next level by leveling up your abilities to overcome dark dungeons and powerful MVP monsters that you'll encounter on your adventures! A fantastic journey awaits! Become an unbreakable adventurer and overcome obstacles in this world!
row.short_description: World of Rune is an MMORPG game with tons of different characters and mystical cute pets. You can play as a Swordsman, Mage, Archer and Cleric.

row.name: Whispering Shadows
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the darkness with Whispering Shadows, an immersive gaming experience that transcends traditional boundaries, exploring the deepest corners of the human mind. Explore Minimalist Settings, Breathe Oppressive Atmosphere : In this two-dimensional world, every step you take brings the protagonist closer to the thin line that separates reality from the nightmare. Minimalist decors, while evoking apparent simplicity, hide deep emotional nuances. Each visual element is carefully designed to amplify the emotional impact, creating a striking visual experience. A Unique Auditory Odyssey: Immerse yourself in this sensory experience where sound becomes your guide. The disturbing voices that resonate in your head are not just noises, but essential components of the narrative. Audio plays a crucial role, creating an immersive symphony of tormented thoughts and inner voices that guide your journey. Schizophrenic Narrative: Whispering Shadows offers a unique perspective by putting yourself in the shoes of a schizophrenic person. Experience the emotional ups and especially downs as you face the disturbing voices and tormented thoughts that emerge from the mind. Each breakthrough reveals a new aspect of the mental mess, offering a poignant glimpse into the complex reality of schizophrenia. Minimalist Gameplay, an Intimate Connection : Whispering Shadows offers minimalist gameplay to highlight the narrative and emotional aspect of the experience. Deceptively simple, your only means of interaction is a single key on your keyboard, used to advance. However, do not underestimate the power of this simplicity. Each step you take represents one more step in the protagonist’s psyche, creating an intimate connection between the player and the character. Evolution of the protagonist : As you progress through the various minimalist backgrounds, watch carefully the subtle changes that occur. The protagonist gradually loses color, reflecting the gradual loss of mental aspects. This visual transformation adds an emotional dimension to the gameplay, making every step significant. Emotional Challenges : Each scene offers unique emotional challenges, corresponding to the themes discussed, such as passion, friendship, family, love, mourning, and finally, the inevitable emptiness. These challenges manifest themselves through subtle events, visual changes, and audio variations, testing your understanding and empathy for the schizophrenic perspective. No Return Choice : Proceed with caution, because once you have passed a step, there is no turning back. This game mechanic reinforces the feeling of inexorability, parallel to the reality of schizophrenia, where choices can have lasting consequences. Whispering Shadows offers a gameplay experience that goes beyond convention, encouraging reflection and empathy through simple but deep interactions. Each advance is an emotional exploration, an advance in the complex labyrinth of the mind. Will you dare to move forward, without ever looking back?
row.short_description: Put yourself in the shoes of a schizophrenic person and experiment the hell of the voices
row.notes: Suicid, verbal violence

row.name: Stick and Balls
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer : A controller with two analog joysticks is highly recommended, and very nearly required, to play this game. If you want to torture yourself on a level even beyond what I made this game for, then sure, try and play with keyboard. Don't say I didn't warn you though. Completing this challenge won't be easy. You will fall, many times, and it will always be your fault. Eventually you'll feel into the technique of controlling two things at once. Through your failures you'll learn the many emergent tricks of a seemingly simple game. Maybe, just maybe, you'll find the peak of this tortuous game. Even more difficult will be the quest to discover each secret and shortcut. The art and music might not be this game's selling point, but there's 26 ball costumes, 8 world themes, and 13 original music tracks to hopefully keep your interest. If you manage to beat my game, I'd love it if you let me know.
row.short_description: Stick and Balls is an exceedingly difficult climb up a minimalist tower. Control two balls, separately yet simultaneously, connected by a stick, with other physics shenanigans that are simple to learn, hard to master. The smallest mistake might lead you on a (psychologically) painful fall.

row.name: She Fell Off
row.detailed_description: Unravel the enigma of the post-apocalyptic world in 'She Fell Off,' an indie game crafted by a single developer that plunges you into a dystopian, sci-fi reality where everything familiar has been lost. This atmospheric, third-person, 3D platformer draws you into a mystery that transcends reality as we know it, enveloping you in a paradox where you control Eve, a vibrant, mysterious heroine. 'She Fell Off' paints a dark yet colorful World where the Earth's crust has been devoured, replaced by an unforgiving, acid ocean. With nothing but three enormous, black lily pad-like plants spanning the size of Africa as the only remnants of life, you'll navigate the once-vibrant world, now turned silent and spectral. But the real mystery lies beneath the surface. Test your courage and step into the underground realm, a perplexing anomaly that houses horrors more terrifying than the surface's desolation. Here, in this minimalistic, precision platformer world, danger lurks in the darkness and the only source of light is you, with Eve's radiant yellow outfit piercing the ever-present gloom. Survival is a matter of skill and grit in this game. Designed for gamers seeking an intense and frustrating challenge, 'She Fell Off' provides no save points. Every demise, every failure, will bring you back to the beginning, forcing you to learn, adapt, and ultimately, to conquer the unknown. It is a relentless test of your resilience as you leap from platform to platform, seeking answers, and perhaps, redemption in the eerie quiet of this post-apocalyptic underground landscape. The game’s precision platforming, combined with its terrifying premise, creates a unique and unsettling twist on the 3D platformer genre. The heart-pounding tension of a horror game mixes with the demanding, unforgiving gameplay of a precision platformer to create a truly distinct experience. As a single-player game, 'She Fell Off' offers an immersive and nerve-wracking adventure that pushes the boundaries of what a 3D platformer can be. Play as Eve, the game's mysterious female protagonist, whose backstory remains as enigmatic as the world she traverses. Delve deep into the head cannon of her mystery, unraveling threads of intrigue and deception. The true essence of Eve, however, is never explicitly revealed, keeping you forever on edge, questioning, wondering, and fearing the unknown. Experience the eerie beauty of a stylized, post-apocalyptic world in 'She Fell Off.' It's a journey into the unknown, a descent into darkness, and a leap of faith into a reality where mystery prevails and danger lurks around every corner. Do you have what it takes to navigate this terrifying underground environment, and unmask the chilling secrets of the past? 'She Fell Off' awaits your challenge. Remember, in this world of shadows and deception, the only beacon of hope is you.
row.short_description: Uncover the cryptic remnants of a destroyed world in 'She Fell Off,' a solo-developed indie game. Embark on Eve's intense journey through a dark post-apocalyptic underworld, devoid of familiar life. Navigate a dark environment, endure unforgiving gameplay, and immerse yourself in an eerie mystery.

row.name: SCP: Nemesi - Alpha Testing
row.detailed_description: ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST! IMPORTANT: This game is in Very Early Access, positioned between the Alpha and Beta phases. Please treat it with the appropriate consideration. Approach it with respect, read carefully, and understand before offering your review. Additionally, please bear in mind that since the game has just been released, the initial player count may be low. We highly recommend joining our Discord server to find people you can play with. Overview SCP: Nemesi is an intense multiplayer survival-horror game that offers a thrilling experience for fans of the SCP Foundation universe and for newcomers too! In this game, players are divided into two groups: one player takes on the role of a powerful anomalous creature, the SCP, while the other four players become Humans, each with their own objectives and branching tasks to complete. Immersive First-Person View Experience the chilling atmosphere through a first-person view, whether you are playing as the SCP or the Humans. The immersive perspective enhances the tension and keeps you engaged in the heart-pounding gameplay. Strategic Human Gameplay As a Human, you have no means of combat, leaving you vulnerable and exposed. Your survival depends on mastering the map and utilizing your surroundings to your advantage. With superior mobility, including vaulting, sliding, and crouching to minimize noise, stealth and cunning are your greatest allies. Key Features Did you see that?! - The Humans' visibility is severely limited by a thick fog, making it difficult to see far ahead. Blinking at regular intervals may cause them to miss something crucial... Every man for himself! - Each Human has a unique set of tasks to complete before they can escape. There's no need to rely on teammates to achieve these objectives, and only when a player accomplishes all their tasks can they make their escape. This place seems familiar... - Explore maps inspired by everyday locations from various eras around the Earth. These meticulously designed non-procedural maps feature intricate pathways and hidden passages, challenging players to learn layouts and navigate effectively, which is crucial to their success. Something old, something new - Each SCP featured in the game closely adheres to the SCP Lore, both in appearance and abilities. To set this game apart from other SCP titles, both lesser-known SCPs and intriguing original creations will be featured as the game evolves! It's dangerous out there! - Prepare for the unexpected with the presence of Environmental SCPs, AI-controlled entities that introduce unique challenges during each match. Be warned! While some are friendly, others may not be...
row.short_description: SCP: Nemesi is a multiplayer survival-horror game where one player takes on the role of the SCP (anomalous creatures, each with its own abilities and appearance), and the other four players play as Humans, each with their own personal goals and tasks that may branch into different paths.
row.notes: This game may include content not suitable for all ages or workplace viewing: Frequent violence or blood.

row.short_description: Line Link is a logical puzzle game, perfect for relaxing or while your computer is loading another game.

row.name: Duskbound
row.detailed_description: Story A red moon shines ominously on a city shrouded in endless night. The people here don't seem to have any life left in them. Well, all except for him. A young woman looking for an escape from her dreary everyday latches onto the only man left with light in his eyes, and musters up the courage to confess her love. If only she had noticed his sharp teeth before it was too late... Features Around 9k words (30-45 minute playtime) One possibly unhinged vampire love interest 5 different endings, plus one unlockable final ending 3 CGs (with variations) Content warnings This game features possibly disturbing content including blood, violence, manipulation, death/murder and dubious consent.
row.short_description: Pursue a cursed romance with a possibly unhinged vampire under the eternal glow of the red moonlight...
row.notes: This game features possibly disturbing content including visual, non-graphic depictions of blood and textual (non-graphic) depictions of violence, manipulation, drugging, death/murder and dubiously consensual kissing and bloodsucking.

row.name: Small Kingdoms Prologue
row.detailed_description: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rival as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game, the Small Kingdoms Prologue is a free introductory version to the full game with a single campaign and a smaller number of buildings and units The Prologue comes with a single campaign map which is a small world consisting of several islands with 2 playable kingdoms and each kingdom having 3 cities. The main game allows more kingdoms and cities on procedurally generated campaign maps In the Prologue the two kingdoms are very much alike. In the main game, you choose to play as one of several kingdoms that each has their own set of islands and cities. The main kingdoms all have similar unit types, but each has their own unique flavour, with strengths and weaknesses for you to use strategically Build up your cities by constructing buildings, gathering resources and training units for your garrison from the world map. Will your cities be economic powerhouses producing loads of resources? Or will they be military training camps designed to get a variety of new units into your armies? Train units for your armies on the world map, then send them into battle and command them on the battlefield to achieve victory in siege and field combat. Will you build a balanced army capable of engaging in close quarters or at a distance? Or will you focus on ranged units to strike down the enemy from afar?
row.short_description: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rival as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game, the Small Kingdoms Prologue is a free introductory campaign

row.name: Heart and Core
row.detailed_description: A 2.5D twin-stick action brawler, Heart and Core allows the player to pilot both JJ and KAI simultaneously, using half the controller for each character for a unique experience. Young engineer JJ and her robot companion, KAI, evade the totalitarian control of the ruthless Santiago. Traverse, hide, and fight your way through a seemingly unending onslaught of enemy RAMs. Use JJ’s Gravity Gun and KAI’s fists to stun and destroy enemies. Each of the two player character has unique abilities that will need to be used together in order to defeat the unstoppable onslaught of RAM's robots. JJ is quite nimble and can jump around a flip levers to allow herself and KAI to navigate the city. JJ also uses her Gravity Gun, allowing her to pickup and move objects in the world, as well as immobilize RAMs themself! KAI on the other hand, although unable to jump, can break through destructible walls using his fists. KAI is also exceptional at destroying the enemy RAM's in just a few punches. JJ and KAI will need to work together to play to their strengths and help each others' weaknesses. However, the forces of Santiago's city will stop at nothing to take KAI's core to power the city. Santiago has deployed many different types of RAM robots to stop JJ and KAI that can shoot, charge, and sometimes even fly to eliminate the duo. Defeat the many RAM enemies in your way and march to the Heart of the city, where you can face Santiago's himself in his Airship. Santiago will stop at nothing to ensure that KAI's core is back in control of the city. Heart and Core features several different traversable areas, each blending seamlessly into each other with no loading screens. Explore several different environments from the Junkyard to the City Center in addition to several unique enemy robots. All characters in Heart and Core, both friend and foe, feature full Voice Acting to create a unique, action-packed adventure!
row.short_description: A twin-stick action brawler. Young engineer JJ and her robot companion, KAI, evade the totalitarian control of the ruthless Santiago. Traverse, hide, and fight your way through a seemingly unending onslaught of enemy RAMs. Use JJ’s Gravity Gun and KAI’s fists to stun and destroy enemies.

The main character meets a girl on a sunny summer day, and the story unfolds guided by her words.
