row.name: The Book Of Hiro - Prologue
row.detailed_description: “The Book Of Hiro - Prologue” is a 3D visual puzzle game developed by two independent developers. Players help Hero embark on an adventure to the palace, using illusions and perspective to solve puzzles and explore the magical world in this book. [Innovative Visual Puzzles] The game features innovative visual puzzles that are imaginative and visually stunning. The innovative visual illusion finding gameplay involves moving the viewing angle, clicking, and other operations to find the hidden “key” pattern in the picture. Each puzzle solved can advance the plot and provide a unique gaming experience and visual impact. [Vivid 3D Graphics] The game features a simple and fresh 3D low-poly style that is full of childlike innocence while meticulously depicting the different scenes in the story. The game’s soothing and distant music complements the graphics to create a mysterious visual pop-up book. [Challenging Gameplay] The game features shiny gold coins, ordinary keys, hammers, gears, and other objects that are common but difficult to find due to the game’s unusual mechanics. Players must make bold guesses and not be fooled by seemingly unrelated images. They must carefully observe and remember that what they see is not necessarily what they get! [Intriguing Storyline] The game features an energetic and art-inspired storybook style. Behind the seemingly ordinary protagonist’s travel story is a hidden plot and an extraordinary experience. The game includes a main storyline and hidden endings waiting for you to explore. The game is still in the intense development stage. If you have any suggestions, please feel free to join our DISCORD channel for discussion
row.short_description: “The Book Of Hiro - Prologue” is a 3D visual puzzle game where players solve challenges and puzzles using illusions and perspective to find the hidden key. The game tells the story of a brave villager named Hiro who was ordered to meet the king and encountered various challenges and puzzles.

row.name: Culture Warz
row.detailed_description: In a world not too dissimilar from ours, social media has rotted minds of the masses turning them into zombies driven by a primal urge to be the most insufferable versions of themselves whilst feasting on brains of the rest of humanity. Who will defeat these social stereotypes? It can only be Chad. -Blast through waves of zombies desperate to take down Chad, use your arsenal of weapons to kill the zombies. Watch out as the horde will increase as you progress. -Fight meme zombies with their own unique abilities, including Karen herself. -Keep an eye out for Golden Boss zombies, they have more health and are much harder to kill -Navigate through a randomly generated map using the environment to your advantage. -Grab pickups the zombies drop to gain the upper hand.
row.short_description: In a world not too dissimilar from ours, social media has rotted minds of the masses turning them into zombies driven by a primal urge to be the most insufferable versions of themselves whilst feasting on brains of the rest of humanity. Who will defeat these social stereotypes? It can only be Chad.
row.notes: Killing cartoon zombies

row.name: Falling Ever
row.detailed_description: ◆History: This game is both the beginning and the end... 'Even if they're not as prepared or worse than me, that's okay...' 'Even if you don't throw me away, it's okay...' 'Maybe I'm the only one in the world who can throw his life away for someone he cares about...' This is a story where everything takes place on a new planet with a new specimen called 'Heflite' who has emotional weaknesses but an immense love for her loved ones and others who live around her. This is a story with a lot going on as it is a Visual Novel Romance where you can 'enter' the story and forget about real life for a few hours full of pleasure for this story and captivating characters! It is not possible to make changes in the future, but you can make some choices during the game that will NOT affect the course of the story. The 'Replay' resource is not available because it is an unnecessary option for this game, as you can easily go back and continue in the dialogues you have already seen with the mouse scroll. In addition, it is possible to change the sound settings for a pleasant experience for each player, and the main thing is that you can also change the speed of the text and the speed of the automatic text so that there is no need to even put your hand on the keyboard and mouse, thus generating a PERFECT experience for those who just want to relax and make the most of their time while enjoying this moving story. This story is about a girl named 'Sutelz Selz' who is kidnapped when she can't even think for herself, and she will have to deal with the feelings and difficulties of being someone of the 'Heflite' species... 'Even though I could organize my emotions to some extent, I couldn't stand it...' With an immersive and dramatic soundtrack, it portrays the moment and the feelings of the characters. ...This is the story of a Heflite girl who was kidnapped and had to learn about love, trust, relaxation and faith... ***The planet and the Hefrids are told of their origins in 'Reset'. *** ◆Cast: < Production / Character Design / Original Story / Main Visual / Character Design / Music Production / Development ＞ Lucas Vacari Gomes All content was designed, created and produced by Lucas Vacari Gomes, who wants to show much more about this planet and the new world of origin of the light novel 'Reset'!
row.short_description: Hundreds of years later, humans and Heflites coexist on a hidden planet near Earth. Finding a mate is the goal, but will something like that really help her break free from the deep darkness she experienced as a child? '...This feeling...is not an obsession...'
row.notes: This game includes: Kissing, Low-level violence, and implied sexual scenes. * In the game itself there is no media showing sex being done. EVERYTHING IS IMPLIED.

row.name: 大话战国Online
row.detailed_description: 《大话战国Online》是一款Q版仿3D即时战斗类MMORPG，游戏取材于中国“战国七雄”历史时期。为了争夺天下霸权，齐、韩、赵、魏、秦、楚、燕七国之间争战不休，而其周边各弱小诸侯国，也纷纷难逃被吞并的命运。 　　直到公元前305年，突天降异象，两颗巨大的天石分别坠落在太行山与泰山之巅，此次撞击撼动了整个天下，撞击后碎石与粉尘形成的黑雾遮蔽了整个天空七日七夜之久而不散。当黑气尽散后，太行山与泰山之顶出现了两个深不可测的神秘洞穴……随着神秘洞穴的出现，各地相继传出夜间会有妖怪出没杀害平民的谣言。而各国诸侯却仍专注于并吞他国，争权天下之事，并无将此放在心上。 　　二十年后，历史上发生了一件惊天动地之事。秦赵两国于长平决战，由武安君白起统领的秦国大军大破赵国军队。面对四十五万之众的赵国降兵，杀神白起尽将降军活埋坑杀于长平。此举震惊天下，闻者无不变色。 　　长平之役后，妖怪出没的谣言已转变为事实。不只是夜间，就连光天白日之下，妖怪也成群出没袭击人类的村落。一切似乎意味着，一场更大的浩劫即将降临人间。各地谣言四起：武安君实乃上古魔神蚩尤之化身，四处出没的妖怪便是千年前被黄帝所封印的九黎魔族。白起一日不除，这个天下迟早会化为人间炼狱。 　　尽管不知谣言所述是否真实，但在相国范睢的力谏下，秦昭王还是将白起赐死于杜邮之地。 　　一切是否就此了结？武安君白起是否真如谣言所述是魔神蚩尤的化身？而太行山与泰山上出现的神秘洞穴是否与之有所联系？里面又隐藏了什么秘密？ 　　在这纷乱的年代，无数英雄豪侠辈出，或是仗剑天下，斩妖除魔，拯救黎民百姓于水深火热之中；或是投效明主，在战场上创出一番丰功伟绩？赶快握紧您手中的宝剑，加入这个战国时代，更多的谜底等待着您来解开，更多的传奇等待着您来缔造！ 　　玩家可以身临其境于温馨可爱的东方武侠画风，通过在游戏虚拟社区中的各种生活，超萌宠物、骑宠设计，充满温馨的门派、部落，仿3D即时战斗、队伍群P、部落战争、国战争霸……逐渐成长起来，影响着整个世界的进程发展，成就一方诸侯、天下巨富、武学宗师……《大话战国Online》也是文化部推荐第三批适合未成年人网游产品之一。
row.short_description: 《大话战国Online》是一款Q版仿3D即时战斗类MMORPG，取材于中国“战国七雄”历史时期，温馨可爱的东方武侠画风，超萌宠物、骑宠设计，充满温馨的门派、部落，仿3D即时战斗、队伍群P、部落战争、国战争霸……文化部推荐第三批适合未成年人网游产品之一。

row.name: Super Mayor
row.detailed_description: Customise your councillor! Meet the locals. Navigate perilous paths. Spend council funds. Deal with pests with your special councillor shoes... Track quests and other progress with your smartphone. Become SUPER MAYOR!
row.short_description: A 100% free, feel-good 2D platformer where you play as a councillor to a rural farming district in New Zealand! Solve problems, meet the public, and become MAYOR in this hilarious, story-rich adventure.

row.name: Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day
row.detailed_description: This is a free prologue for the Riot Control Simulator game, where you can have a short sneak peek at the gameplay and overall game experience. In 'Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day,' step into the boots of a law enforcement officer faced with their first mission: managing security during minor riots sparked by pseudo-fans after a local football match. Experience life at the station, prepping for the task ahead. Your mission is to prevent clashes between these pseudo-fans on the streets. Safely clear the area of bystanders and other fans lingering near the local pub. Establish a secure perimeter using barriers or police cordons to isolate the riot zone. Develop your skills in responding to aggressive individuals, be they riotous pseudo-fans or concerned citizens. Depending on the situation, employ various means, from negotiation to the use of batons, tasers, or gas. Handle confrontations by issuing fines or detaining and searching unruly individuals. Throughout, you'll be supported by your squad. Issue them precise commands, and collaboratively work to avoid escalating the situation further, prioritizing the safety of bystanders above all.
row.short_description: 'Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day' places you in a law enforcement role during minor post-match riots. Manage crowds, establish secure perimeters, and navigate confrontations, choosing strategies that prioritize bystander safety. Learn, decide, and lead! *This is a free prologue*

row.name: Episode 666
row.detailed_description: Delve into a spine-chilling episode of a popular ghost hunting YouTube channel, where you will accompany the fearless YouTube Ghost Hunting sensation, Scott Warren. Scott is excited that after years of building his YouTube following, he has finally hit Episode 666! To celebrate, Scott heads into the sinister depths of Cificap High, a place shrouded in darkness, for what promises to be his most bone-chilling and petrifying episode to date. Do you have what it takes to accompany Scott through Episode 666? Face your deepest fears and embark on this pulse-pounding quest into the unknown, but be warned, once you enter Cificap High, there's no turning back... 👻🎥📸👻🎥📸👻🎥📸👻🎥📸👻🎥📸👻🎥📸👻 This project was created in a one week break taken by 'Wreck Tangle Games' while they are developing their full featured game 'Quintus and the Formidable Curse'. If you enjoyed 'Episode 666' we ask that you support the developers by Wishlisting 'Quintus and the Formidable Curse'
row.short_description: Delve into the spine-chilling world of 'Spirits Uncovered' where you will accompany the fearless YouTube Ghost Hunting sensation, Scott Warren. Scott is excited that after years of building his YouTube following, he has finally hit Episode 666!

row.name: Arkanoid - Eternal Battle : Battle Royale F2P Edition
row.detailed_description: Important Available DLC are not compatible with the F2P Edition. Full version About the Game Arkanoid is an iconic arcade game, developed by TAITO Corporation in 1986. When the mother ship ARKANOID comes under attack, the small spacecraft VAUS manages to escape but ends up warped into another dimension. Wandering in an inter-dimensional labyrinth, VAUS must destroy blocks called 'spacewalls' in order to defeat 'DOH', the creator of the maze responsible for ARKANOID’s destruction. For the first time ever, players will be able to compete against each other, offering an online experience thanks to the Eternal Battle mode, the main new feature of this game, brining the arcade experience to a whole new level. This Battle Royale mode offers the possibility to compete among 25 players online. Arkanoid is one of the most accessible, if not, the most accessible game in the history. The concept remains simple, but you'll will face level after level an increase of progressive difficulty. Features: A brand-new artistic direction and new surprising features, items and powers, conceived by the famous French Studio Pastagames. ETERNAL BATTLE (25-player): Players competing online, the last player standing wins the game. Champions can use special powers to take the advantage during the game. AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE SEPARATELY NEO (1-player): A new game mode. Same Gameplay as the classic Arkanoid Game with new power-ups and new spacewalls RETRO (1-player): Discover a part of History through a vintage Arcade Cabinet VERSUS (2-4 players): Players competing on the same screen (split-screen) based on the Neo mode gameplay INCLUDED IN THE FULL VERSION 4 GAME MODES, including: 2 single-player modes (Neo & Retro) and 2 multiplayer modes, Local Versus and Eternal Battle
row.short_description: The Iconic Block-Breaker Returns! Embrace for free the intensity of the Battle Royale, thanks to the Eternal Battle Mode, up to 25 players online. Play now for free and try to reach the top of the leaderboard. Additional modes are available for separate purchase.

row.name: Nephilim Uprising
row.detailed_description: Embark on an extraordinary gaming experience with 'Nephilim Uprising,' an early access third-person shooter that pushes the boundaries of celestial challenges. Immerse yourself in a divine creation known as the Labyrinth, intricately designed for those deemed worthy to challenge the heavens. Navigate intense battles, strategize to overcome celestial trials, and earn coveted loot reflecting your prowess. This unique adventure beckons to those who seek to ascend among the angels, offering a glimpse into a world where the divine meets the thrill of conquest. Join the uprising and prove yourself in the celestial arena! Gameplay Overview: Immerse yourself in fast-paced combat within procedurally generated environments, ensuring every playthrough is a fresh challenge, delivering an adrenaline-pumping experience. Weapons and Combat: Arm yourself with a diverse array of weapons and engage in intense combat scenarios. Strategic shooting is key as you face waves of enemies, with each encounter testing your skills and adaptability. Labyrinth Exploration: Embark on a journey into mysterious labyrinths that shift and change with each run. Explore the depths, but be prepared – the labyrinth is as unforgiving as it is unpredictable. Randomized Dungeons: Dive into dynamically generated environments, ensuring that no two runs are ever the same. The ever-changing landscape keeps you on the edge, providing a unique challenge in every corner of Nephilim Uprising. Planned Next Updates: Looking ahead, anticipate exciting updates for 'Nephilim Uprising.' We have plans for more weapons, diverse challenges featuring additional randomized dungeons, confrontations with new celestial adversaries, and the thrill of discovering loot boxes within the dungeons.
row.short_description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey in 'Nephilim Uprising,' an early access celestial third-person shooter. Navigate procedurally generated labyrinths, face intense combat scenarios, and conquer divine challenges to prove yourself in the celestial arena!
row.notes: Violence: The game features intense combat scenarios with depictions of fantasy violence, including weapons and magical abilities used against both enemies and the player character. Mature Themes: The storyline explores celestial challenges and divine trials, focusing on the struggle for ascension among celestial beings.

row.name: Mercenary Warriors
row.detailed_description: Mercenary Warriors is a 1v1 Turn Based PVP Strategy Game set in a fantasy world. NEXT GENERATION STRATEGY In Mercenary Warriors, preparation and strategy matter more than twitch reflexes. Its multiplayer focus ensures a constant source of competition and fulfilling encounters. CREATE YOUR OWN TEAM Select 9 of the multiple warriors available to you to form an invincible team. Pick the best leader among your chosen warriors! UNIQUE SKILLSETS Each warrior has unique skills you can use to advance your strategy and achieve victory! Synergize them in the best way possible! MIX WARRIORS TEST NEW POSITIONS FOR EACH ONE STRATEGIZE TO WIN ACHIEVE VICTORY
row.short_description: Mercenary Warriors is a Turn Based PVP Strategy Game set in a fantasy world. Create your own team selecting 9 of the multiple warriors available to you and rise to the top.

row.name: Afterlife
row.detailed_description: Objective The end goal of the game is to complete all the missions and return to the original world. Opportunities If you start the game, you will be given 3 opportunities to try the mission. You must complete all the missions given before you exhaust all of this opportunity. If the mission fails, opportunities are reduced one by one. When all opportunities are exhausted, you cannot return to the original world and dies, and the game ends. How to play the game The defense of a village Your mission is to protect a given village from monsters for a few days. Interact with objects to acquire resources, defeat monsters, and be strong. Interaction and aetheron Left-click on the mouse to interact with the objects in the field. When interacting, you can get an essence called Aetheron . This is the good you need for the upgrade. You can get it by interacting or killing monsters. When interacting with a monster object, it attacks the monster and causes a certain amount of damage. When interacting with resource objects such as trees or rocks, resources are collected to cause a certain amount of damage and acquire resources. When interacting with the village object, repair the village to restore a certain amount of value. Obtaining items If you attack a tree, you can get a certain amount of wood, attacking rocks will allow you to acquire a certain amount of rocks. Crafting Items You can create items with the material items you have obtained. Click the second icon, Craft icon  in the left icon menu to display the craft view. Once enough material items are collected, the craftable items are activated. You can click to consume the material items to create them. Day and Night Day and night change over time. Resource objects are mainly created during the day, and monsters are created at night. Survive Rewards You can earn a reward after one day. You will be given a reward option and you will earn a reward by choosing one.
row.short_description: He who is chosen as a hero must take a test. Pass the test to gain power of hero, and return to the original world.

row.name: Everbee
row.detailed_description: Bees pollinate the most flowers among pollinators. However, bee populations have been declining in recent years due to the accumulation of multiple factors: pests, agrochemicals, and habitat loss. Everbee aims to draw awareness to this issue by letting people raise their own virtual bee hive! Collect Resources Flower: Nectar and pollen can be collected from flowers by clicking on them. The bees will also automatically collect resources for you. Convert Resources: The collected nectar and pollen can be converted into the likes of honey and wax in the top left converting panel. Build New Cells: New cells can be added to the beehive using wax. Functional Cells: Functional cells can automate your work. Once built, the bees will fill functional cells with the needed materials to convert into other resources automatically, for example. Hatcheries can provide the queen bee with space for her eggs. Grow the Colony: New worker bees can hatch if the queen bee is fed and if there is a hatchery available. New workers can boost the hive. Collect New Flowers: If you give it nectar, the hummingbird will fetch new seeds for you. These can be used to grow new flowers that have different nectar and pollen producing capabilities.
row.short_description: This is a game about managing a beehive. Collect resources from flowers to raise bees and expand the hive!

row.name: Aurora
row.detailed_description: NOTE: Requires Ultraleap Hyperion or Gemini to be installed, with a compatible tracking camera connected. Aurora is a virtual space created by Ultraleap – it contains islands where each hosts a different experience for you to explore. Follow our tutorials which will show you how to navigate around the space without having to physically move yourself, and learn how to use your hands by imitating our ghost hands. Aurora is all about interaction. You will pinch in the air to generate different colour ribbons of paint that you can use to create your own abstract art in VR. You will spawn shapes with your fingers, and then grab and stack them with your hands. You will interact with an exploded view of a product, using your hands to orientate a turntable to more easily examine and pick up different sized components. Along with being a fun creative experience, Aurora showcases our experience with hand tracking interactions and interface design reflecting a lot of what we have laid out in our XR design guidelines. It has been built using our Unity plugin which means you can see exactly what is possible to build for yourself with our developer tools.
row.short_description: Welcome to a whole new world of Ultraleap Hand Tracking.

row.name: Fittest Fire
row.detailed_description: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up. The Fittest Fire game features: Powerful melee attacks that devastate enemies and recharge your ammo Fast ranged attacks to dispatch enemies from a distance Tight movement controls with variable jumping, dashing, and wall jumping An explorable world with 12 unique areas, 8 bosses, and 20+ enemy types Fittest Fire comes with a mobile app Fittest Fire is both a game and mobile app. The Fittest Fire mobile app allows you to log exercises and get points based on the weight, reps, time, and/or distance. These points can be used in the Fittest Fire game to: Increase sword and gun damage as well as the attack speed Unlock powerful special attacks for both the sword and gun Increase health points, movement speed, and power up durations Power up with Fire mode once it’s unlocked It's possible to play the game without downloading the mobile app. However, you will not be able to level up without the mobile app and will face significantly more difficult gameplay.
row.short_description: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up.

row.name: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings
row.detailed_description: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings is an epic high fantasy ruler RPG being built in an episodic format. As a solo developer, I strive to deliver a game of the highest quality, the kind I've always wanted to play myself, with innovative turn-based combat, a richly developed world, memorable characters, romance, and an in-depth story. I call Noblesse Oblige a ruler RPG because it combines exploration and turn-based RPG combat using a core party with aspects of rulership, including kingdom management elements, castle customization, and important story decisions that have long-term consequences. At present, new chapters of the game are released every 2-3 months. Old save compatibility with new versions is always maintained, so you can always pick up where you left off when a new version releases. Current Content Current playtime: 50+ hours Latest Version: v0.16 'Promises to Keep'  (released 9-5-2025) Chapters: 15 extensive chapters Words: 900,000+ Other: An eclectic soundtrack of over 140 carefully chosen songs, intricate maps made with over 65 separate tilesets, hundreds of customized animations, and several major story branches with continuing differences. Characters ...and many more to discover! About the Game What does it mean to be nobility? Is it no more than an inherited title, or does it hold some greater meaning? To some, nobility is not merely a station to be held, but an obligation to be met, and yet... Can such convictions hold firm in the face of intrigue, betrayal, and overwhelming odds? Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings tells the story of Alexander, an idealistic yet pragmatic nobleman, and his companions. They will have need of cunning and conviction in equal measure, if they are to navigate the intricacies of politics, intrigue, ruling, and love amidst a tempestuous civil war. Kingdoms dance upon the stage set by those who rule them, and upon this one shall play out a war born from the confluence of three unyielding wills... Upon his return from studying in a distant land, Alexander’s birthright has been stolen and his lands thrown into chaos. Faced with this betrayal and the sudden loss of all that he has spent his life preparing for, he must take up the sword and retake what is his. But a true ruler does not—cannot—live by the sword alone, not if he seeks to create something that can endure. No, victory in battle may be essential, but true triumph comes in subtler ways: to claim a lasting, meaningful victory, Alexander must not merely crush or outwit his enemies, but also navigate the labyrinthine politics of court, inspire his people… and perhaps find love for himself amidst it all. To some, the obligations of a lord are but a burden; to others, a farce. Yet to one like Alexander, who is possessed of the conviction to embrace his obligations, naught could bring greater satisfaction that using his power for good. Beneath the banner of such a lord gather allies, both those drawn by the flame of his will and those who have been touched by the light of his actions. Along the narrow path to victory, Alexander will gather a group of loyal companions—lovers, friends, rivals, allies, even those who were once his enemies, each with unique personalities and skills. Together with them, he will delve into the dark places of the world, traverse mountains, fight great battles... and perhaps most of all, struggle against those most terrible of shadows—those that lurk in the hearts of men, wrought by greed, hatred, envy, and sometimes lust. But it is in deepest darkness that light can shine the brightest. Will you join Alexander on his journey to change the world for the better? Features In Noblesse Oblige, every character is unique, with his or her own opinions, personality, and reasons for joining the party. Every party member has loyalty, driven by their opinions of choices made and paths taken; increasing loyalty unlocks powerful skill upgrades and extra story content for that character. In addition to their unique perspectives on the story, each of Alexander’s companions brings unique mechanics into battle. These include not only a wide variety of skills and playstyles, but also unique passive effects that shape how they approach combat. Combat in Noblesse Oblige is a novel take on the traditional turn-based RPG, one intended to promote skill and judicious use of abilities, rather than merely managing attrition or spamming generic attacks. Beyond the battlefield, a lord must rule his realm. To see this done, Alexander must carefully build and manage key factors like Popular Support, Noble Support, Economic Status, Army Size, and Army Quality, factors that will have important impacts as the game proceeds. Hold court and rule upon upon the disputes that divide the realm, and determine where best to spend your Royal Funds for the good of the realm! Other choices hold far greater import, shaping the very path you seek to walk: with whom to ally, who is most worthy of holding strategic lands, or what faith the realm should follow. These choices, though few, will have a lasting impact upon the story. But ruling the realm is not without its perks. Any lord of any importance has need of a castle, and that castle should reflect its lord’s desires. Accordingly, Noblesse Oblige features a system allowing for extensive castle customization: At present, Noblesse Oblige is free; when the game is closer to completion, this may change. For now, if you enjoy the game, please consider purchasing the optional Crown Loyalist DLC.
row.short_description: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings is a high fantasy RPG that reenvisions turn-based combat in dynamic ways, telling the story of Alexander—an idealistic yet pragmatic nobleman—and his allies as they navigate politics, intrigue, ruling, and love amidst a tempestuous civil war.
row.notes: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings contains general mature themes, including non-explicit descriptions of violence, political intrigue, realpolitik, implicit sexual intimacy, references to attempted sexual assault and coercion, and the use of fictional addictive drugs.

row.name: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
row.detailed_description: Stories from the troubled pasts of two young adults, Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude will take you through their darkest days and immerse you in their deepest emotions. Alex's Hope The difficult story of a boy with a bleak future and a critical lack of love finding a reason to regain hope. A dark atmosphere, a cold journey, and a soft warmth will change his fate. Alex's Solitude The story of a stubbornly good-hearted girl finding rejection and struggling to fit in. A change in persona, a new friend, and a serious wake-up call will lead her to make a life-changing resolution. Content Warning This visual novel contains themes that may be distressing to many individuals, including: Depression Anxiety Suicidal Thoughts Self Harm Substance Abuse Drug Overdose It does not contain any written or visual depictions of death or any graphic depictions of injury or self harm. Features Two individual short stories (Combined length of about 7,400 words) Immersive and intensely emotional storytelling Original hand-drawn characters and backgrounds Original, immersive, and very emotionally driven soundtrack with 12 unique songs Three CGs in each story A cute cat
row.short_description: A boy regains his hope and a girl finds herself in solitude. A kinetic novel that will take you through their darkest days and immerse you in their deepest emotions.
row.notes: This VN contains themes that may be distressing to many individuals, including: - Depression - Anxiety - Suicidal Thoughts - Self Harm - Substance Abuse - Drug Overdose

row.name: Brood Ma : Dadda
row.detailed_description: Originally a real-time audio-visual experience designed for live performance, Dadda has now been adapted for into an avant-garde desktop PC experience, crafted within the UE5 engine. This unique adaptation captures the essence of the live show, offering a disruptive take on technology, experimental noise music, and anxious expression—remapped for you to perform yourself on your own PC. Live Performance Adaptation: Experience the powerful and chaotic spectacle of Dadda, originally designed for live performance, now reimagined as an interactive desktop game. Dark Humor & Symbolism: Explore Dadda's metallic anatomy and personal signifiers, symbols of fragility, resilience, and collective anxieties. Interactive Gameplay: Engage with Dadda's sonic contraptions, from squeaking toys to spinning spirals, creating unpredictable sonic outcomes more in tune with experimental noise music. Advanced Audio Capabilities: Experience fully spatialized audio with standard stereo, and the potential for 5.1 or 7.1 surround. Variable Play-Time: Perform, sequence and replay Dadda differently each time, with play-time ranging from 5-35 minutes. This desktop game adaptation of Dadda re-captures the energy of the original live performance as a single player narrative experience. James B Stringer is an artist, producer and developer. He co-founded the Quantum Natives label and collective and has released music on Tri-Angle, Hemlock and Mantile under his Brood Ma alias. He was Creative Director and co-founder of digital studio Werkflow and has created videogame powered visuals and artworks for artists such as Actress, Rachel Maclean, Sidsel Meineche Hansen, Kuedo, Libby Heaney and many more.
row.short_description: Manipulate the limbs of a fragile automaton to shape an immense dynamic noise score.

row.name: Ocean's Venus
row.detailed_description: “Bell Platinum” also known as “Ocean’s Venus”, now shipwreck, used to be a cargo ship built in the 1950s traveling the North Atlantic ocean. As a newly hired maintenance worker aboard, you live through the vessel’s final voyage, uncovering and documenting its dark history. Complete Tasks Throughout your work day, you must make sure the ship’s systems are in check and are working as they should. Survival is Key A dead worker is a bad worker. If anything or anyone gets in your way, you must always have a careful plan of escape, since there’s not much else you can protect yourself with. Certain crucial game mechanics may require close attention to sound - using headphones in a quiet environment is highly recommended!
row.short_description: A point and click horror game aboard a ship with inscrutable history. Your job as a maintenance worker aboard is to make sure everything runs as it should, or so you've been told...
row.notes: Contains story content which may be disturbing to some players, along with flashing lights and loud sudden noises.

row.name: 莎比编辑器 SUBE
row.detailed_description: The protagonist of this game is a middle school student who doesn't like learning and only sleeps at school every day. She also has two friends who don't like learning like her, one is a boy who thinks he's right but enjoys playing with his friends; The other is a bear who is slow witted but enjoys playing first person shooter games. She doesn't care about these two insignificant friends, just wants to stay at home and play computer games. But she didn't know that behind this seemingly peaceful life, there was an astonishing truth hidden. This game has no gameplay, only basic operations such as movement and dialogue. The play time is approximately 40 minutes. The game has a built-in editor that can be used to customize the game's chapters, plot, interaction, and gameplay. The current content in the game is created using the built-in editor. The method to open the editor is to press the R key 5 times continuously during the game, but it is not recommended to use it when the game has not been cleared, as you may see the plot behind the game and be exposed.
row.short_description: In this game, you will play a junior high school student who doesn't like learning, and all you have to do every day is go to school, finish school, and sleep.

row.name: OyasumiVR - VR Sleeping Utilities
row.detailed_description: What is OyasumiVR? OyasumiVR is a desktop application containing various utilities and automations to help you sleep with a virtual reality headset on . Most of these utilities are built specifically for use within the social vr-platform VRChat. OyasumiVR can detect when you are asleep , and help you in various ways such as: - 🔋 Saving electricity and battery overnight - 🔅 Dimming your headset brightness - ✨ Triggering avatar animations based on your sleeping pose - 📩 Automatically handling invite requests - 🔵 Automating your VRChat status - 🎤 Muting your microphone when you fall asleep - 🛠️ Automating various SteamVR settings ...and many more! Please see the upcoming 'Features' section to read more about what functionality OyasumiVR has to offer. Features 💤 Sleep Detection OyasumiVR can detect automatically when you are asleep, based on your movement! Simply calibrate once, enable the automation, and you're set. If automatic detection is not what you're looking for, there's various alternative automations you can use, that are based on: A time schedule Controller & tracker battery levels Controller & tracker power states SteamVR status Heart Rate Sitting Upright VRChat players joining or leaving 📲 SteamVR Overlay OyasumiVR comes with its own SteamVR overlay, which allows you control some of its features from within VR! By default, double press the A button on your right controller, and it should pop up in front of you. 🔋 Power Automations Controllers & Trackers Automatically have your controllers and/or trackers turn off when you sleep, and save their battery! You'll be happy when you wake up in the morning and find they'll still have some juice left in them! Additionally, you can have your controllers and/or trackers turn off at certain battery levels, or when you put them on the charger. Ideal for hotswapping controllers! Windows Power Policy Save some electricity by automatically setting Windows' Power Policy when you go to sleep and wake up! Simply have it set a more conservative policy (like 'Power Saver') when you go to sleep, and then restore a higher performance policy when you wake up again. Base Stations Have OyasumiVR turn your base stations on and off together with SteamVR. A bit like SteamVR's own base station power management, but compatible with any HMD! As long as your PC supports Bluetooth and is in range of the base stations, you're good to go. 🎮 Device Control OyasumiVR can allow you to easily control many of your SteamVR devices, from controllers, to trackers, to base stations. Easily read detailed battery level and charge status for your controllers and trackers, or turn your base stations on and off with a single click! 🔌 GPU Automations GPU Power Limiting Save electricity by automatically power limiting your GPU when you go to sleep, and restoring its full power when you wake up! Simply set the desired watt limits and OyasumiVR will set them when needed. Power limiting is only available on Nvidia GPUs. AMD users can instead make use of the MSI Afterburner automations. MSI Afterburner If you want more control over your GPU than just setting the power limit, you can have OyasumiVR automatically activate the profiles you've set up in MSI Afterburner. Tweak your over- or underclocks, power limits and more, and have OyasumiVR call for them when you go to sleep, or wake up! 💫 VRChat Automations 🌜 Sleeping Animations OyasumiVR can detect what sleeping pose you are in, and use it to trigger the right animation or pose on your avatar. There are built-in presets for popular locomotion assets, including: ごろ寝システム v2.2 - 3.0.2 by みんみんみーん (Sleep System v2.2 - 3.0.2 by minminmiin) EX version also supported! GoGo Loco v1.7.1+ by franada Alternatively, trigger your own animations with the included OSC script editors! 📧 Auto Accept Invite Requests Automatically accept invite requests from specific friends while you are asleep! You can add the friends you want to let in to the whitelist, or even block certain friends from having their requests automatically accepted with a blacklist. 🔵 Status Automations OyasumiVR offers multiple automations for controlling your VRChat visibility and status message, like when you fall asleep, or wake up! Additionally, you can have OyasumiVR automatically switch your status based on the amount of people around you in VRChat. For example: Switch to blue when you are sleeping alone so your friends can join you, and switch to orange when there's enough people around! 🔔 Join Notifications OyasumiVR can notify you when people join or leave your VRChat world. This is useful if you want to be woken up in certain situations. It can configured to only notify you in specific situations, like only: For your friends For certain specific players When you're being left alone When you're no longer alone 🏃 Avatar Automations You can have OyasumiVR automatically switch your avatar when you prepare for bed, when you fall asleep, or when you wake up! Useful if you have a specific avatar you use for sleeping. 🔧 OSC Automations You can send certain OSC messages to VRChat when sleep mode is enabled, or disabled. You can use the built-in OSC script editor to compose the exact messages you want to send. This is a more advanced feature that you can use to trigger certain features on your avatar. For example: Show a sleepy expression on your face while sleep mode is enabled! ⛔ Shutdown Sequence Ever wanted to fall asleep in VR, but not stay in VR all night? The shutdown sequence has you covered! While you can trigger the shutdown sequence manually, there are several automated triggers you can configure: When you've been asleep for a certain amount of time. When you're left alone in your VRChat world for a certain amount of time. Depending on which actions you configure, it will do any of the following: Turn off your controllers and/or Trackers Turn off your Base Stations Quit SteamVR (And any running game or overlay along with it) Shut down Windows With the shutdown sequence configured, you can fall asleep soundly in VR, knowing that everything will shut down when you don't need to be in VR anymore! 🔅 Display Brightness & Color Temperature Automations 🌆 Brightness Automate your brightness for when you sleep and wake up. OyasumiVR can smoothly transition your VR headset's brightness, so it falls down gradually as you sleep without waking you up. It allows you to control both software brightness, as well as hardware brightness if your headset supports it (e.g. Valve Index or Bigscreen Beyond). In addition to providing you with several automations, you can easily control your brightness levels right from the SteamVR overlay menu! 🌡️ Color Temperature OyasumiVR can also control the color temperature of your VR headset's display. By reducing blue light, it can help reduce eye strain during the late hours, and make it easier to fall asleep. With the sunset and sunrise triggers, you can have OyasumiVR automatically adjust the color temperature of your display to match the time of day. Note that this feature is only supported on some native SteamVR headsets, such as the Valve Index, Bigscreen Beyond, and HTC Vive (Pro). 🎤 Microphone Mute Automations System Microphone Mute Automations OyasumiVR can also do the same, but on a system level, muting your Microphone's audio device instead. With this, you can even switch between mute toggle mode and push-to-talk. This comes with an optional mute indicator in the VR overlay, and the option for binding a controller button so that you can have it completely replace the microphone muting functionality of VRChat or any other VR game you play. VRChat Microphone Mute Automations You can have OyasumiVR automatically mute or unmute your mic in VRChat when you go to sleep and wake up. Perfect if you'd like to prevent others from hearing you snore! 🔉 Audio Volume Automations Automatically change the volume of your audio devices when you fall asleep, or wake up! This can be useful if you want to prevent other players, or other applications from disturbing your sleep. ♥️ Heart Rate Automations (Pulsoid Integration) To support heart rate based automations, OyasumiVR integrates with the online heart rate service Pulsoid. For this you can use any hardware that Pulsoid supports, like bluetooth heartrate monitors, WearOS smartwatches, or Apple Watches. Note that this integration requires a one-time purchase of Pulsoid's OyasumiVR integration, or to have an active Pulsoid 'BRO' subscription. Please ensure you have a compatible device before making a purchase. Sleep Detection You can set up OyasumiVR to automatically enable the sleep mode when your heart rate has been low enough for a certain duration. Just set the BPM threshold and for how long your heart rate should stay under it, and you're set! If you're not sure, you can get some simple insights to determine the right values for your body. Nightmare Detection OyasumiVR can detect when you've got a prolonged elevated heartrate, which could indicate a nightmare. With this feature you can try to cut your nightmares short by automatically deactivating the sleep mode (to for example, increase the brightness), or by playing a sound to attempt waking you up. 🚨 HMD Specific Automations OyasumiVR has various automations for controlling certain features specific to certain VR Headsets. Currently, this includes the following: Bigscreen Beyond RGB Led Control Fan Speed Control 👓 Resolution Automations Automatically adjust your SteamVR render resolution when you sleep and wake up! Having OyasumiVR lower your render resolution helps you reduce the load on your hardware at times when you don't need it. 🔳 Chaperone Automations Automatically adjust the fade distance of SteamVR's chaperone when you sleep. If you have a small play area, you can use this to make sure the chaperone stays hidden while you are asleep, and re-enable it when you wake up! 🏠 Home Assistant Integration OyasumiVR can expose many of its own features, as well as SteamVR's, to Home Assistant over MQTT! This allows you to integrate OyasumiVR with various smart devices you might have in your home, as well as enable you to build your own powerful automations within Home Assistant. For example, you can use this to automatically turn off your smart lights when you fall asleep, or turn them back on when needed! Here is a list of features exposed that you'll be able to read, or control, through Home Assistant: OyasumiVR Features Sleep Mode (Switch) Shutdown Sequence (Button) Sleep Preparation (Button) Heart Rate (Sensor) Sleeping Position (Sensor) Base Station Power (Switch) Power State (Sensor) HMD Brightness Advanced Mode (Switch) Simple Brightness (Number) Software Brightness (Number) Hardware Brightness (Number) VRChat Features VRChat Running (Sensor) Player Name (Sensor) # Players In World (Sensor) Status Visibility (Sensor) World Instance ID (Sensor) SteamVR Features VR Headset Model (Sensor) SteamVR Running (Sensor) Controller & Tracker Power (Switch) (Only Powering Off) Charging State (Sensor) Battery Level (Sensor) Device Roles (Sensor) Bigscreen Beyond Features Fan Speed (Number) RGB LED (Light) Brightness (Number) Translation & Localization OyasumiVR currently supports the following languages: 日本語 (Japanese): Community contributions by なき and Milix-M. 한국어 (Korean): Community contribution by Soumt. 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese): Community contribution by 狐Kon. 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese): Community contributions by 狐Kon, 雾雨花精灵, いんく and Yingxue. Français (French): Community contribution by neuroblack. Español (Spanish): Community contribution by aacal666. Bahasa Indonesia (Indonesian): Community contribution by a9ito. Українська (Ukrainian): Community contributions by senkodev and Fanyatsu. Русский (Russian): Community contributions by Kanjir0, Pacmard and Dimrical. Deutsch (German): Community contributions by Nicer Dicer and Aron. Nederlands (Dutch): by Raphiiko. English: by Raphiiko. Help out with translation OyasumiVR would not have supported as many languages as it does without the help of our fantastic volunteers. I personally think it's amazing that thanks to their efforts, more people get to use OyasumiVR than would otherwise have been possible. If you want to support us, either by contributing missing translations, or by adding an entirely new language, please check out the wiki page on adding translations for instructions on how to get started! In case you're looking for more information, please don't hesitate to hop in our Discord and ask! Support If you are having trouble with OyasumiVR, say you have a bug, or a feature request, you can join our Discord server. Alternatively, you can reach out to me directly on Twitter at @Raphiiko. I'll try to get back to you as soon as possible! License OyasumiVR is available under the MIT license.
row.short_description: Software that helps you sleep in virtual reality. OyasumiVR detects when you are asleep and automates various tasks and settings to make VR sleeping as comfortable as possible.

row.name: Keali
row.detailed_description: Keali includes Six to Ten hours of content. Extra challenges in the form of Mural Fragments that unlock secrets of the past. Leaderboards to race friends and strangers. A complex and engaging movement system with a high skill ceiling for you to explore and master. Unique levels that explore custom platforms, threats, and puzzles. Levels have multiple solutions, some easier than others. Lots of attempts, some frustration, chill beats and more. A quick use tether that auto targets based on your movement, allowing you to attach to world terrain and tether points. Race against the vines to complete levels before they cover everything. Master when to sprint and when not too, saving energy or time. Dash over large gaps, while clearing your fall speed.
row.short_description: The other guardian spirits have gone missing, and it's your responsibility as Keali, self proclaimed master of chores and errands, to fix whatever has gone wrong. Use your tether and other movement abilities to traverse past the creeping vines, fly past dangers and master your skills.

row.name: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype-
row.detailed_description: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype- is a small scale, prototype, anime action RPG showcasing some of the general ideas, aesthetics and gameplay style we’re hoping to achieve with our future game projects! It’s a high speed, stylish, action game with major RPG elements, skills and abilities inspired by classic Japanese RPGs! Follow the simple story of our main character, Yellette, set in the world of Crinoa, on a small excursion in order to find ingredients for cooking. What was assumed to be nothing more than a simple quest, transforms into more trouble than she could have seen coming! Make your way through a small section of the Island of Ezelpor, where the local Jeletan Season has spread wild Jeletan throughout, and take down the few species of these beasts you find with cool, stylish combos and flair! Main Features: -Stylish Action Gameplay By chaining skills together with the game's unique systems and mechanics, you can unleash devastating combos and skills on enemies to show off your abilities in order raise your 'Flair Meter' higher and higher for better rewards! -Active Character Switching and Assists For this prototype, you will be able to control and play as two characters; the fully fleshed out main character, Yellette, and the simpler character, the Jeletan, Ermli! By tapping the 'character switch' button you can instantly switch characters in the middle of a combo or chain to further extend your combos and show just how much flair you can pull off with the techniques available! Furthermore, by holding the 'Switch' button, combos can also be extended by instantly calling your non controlled party member to activate an assigned 'assist skill' for them to perform on a target. -Simple story with in depth lore and an in game glossary Though the story is simple and sweet, it is used to set up the personality of Yellette, our main character, and to further set up the world and setting around her for future titles. Enjoy the voiced main story cutscenes and partially voiced sidequest stories to get a true feel for our characters and world! And then delve into the many terms, places, people and ideologies of the world of Crinoa! Venture into the World of Crinoa and show us just how stylish you can be and just how much flair you can bring forth as a 'Hero of the World'!
row.short_description: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype- is a small scale prototype anime style, action RPG with high speed, stylish action game combat mixed with in depth RPG stats, abilities and systems inspired by classic JRPGs! Show us just how much flair you can bring forth!

row.name: Mayhem Survivors: Animals
row.detailed_description: Animals have gone crazy. Feed them all to survive the Mayhem! Choose your food and items carefully, try out unique builds each run. Features Manual or Auto Attacks. 23+ Weapons 55+ Items 250+ Upgrade choices Fast Paced Gameplay Difficulty Options Choose between challenging mods or casual mods Game Modes Classic Mode(Fast Pace): Fight againts hordes of animals, Collect gems to level up, Upgrade your character and survive for 15 Minutes. Mayhem Mode(Fast Pace): Enemies get stronger each wave, Open a mysterious box to get a random item or a weapon to upgrade your character. Survive for 15 Waves or try to stay alive as long as you can. Feed all the animals to advance through the next round. Survival Mode(Moderate Pace): Survive for a certain time each round. Buy upgrade from the shop with gold obtained from animals fed. Each run takes 15-20 Minutes.
row.short_description: Mayhem Survivors is an action rogue-like game, where you feed cute animals with various different foods in order to Survive. It is inspired by Survivors-like games and features 3 different game modes.

row.name: George McGeehan Gamer Hero
row.detailed_description: Steam Deck Compatible since 25/march/2024! Install game on Steam Deck then before launch set compatibility to Proton experimental, then change the default controller setting to game controller with gamepad! enjoy! :D Reach level 99 in this casual, chill game. No dieing, no guns and no checkpoints! :P Beat the developer's best time (25mins) to reach level 99 by jumping from platform to platform while avoiding mildly annoying and randomized enemies that will make the player fall to the bottom level! Keyboard keys (PC Layout): --A/Left to go Left --D/Right to go Right --J to Jump --R to Restart --M to change music --ENTER to skip cinematic --Spacebar to play/pause intro cinematic --ESC to Quit SteamDeck buttons (controller layout) --DpadLeft/LeftjoysticktotheLeft to go Left --DpadRight/LeftjoysticktotheRight to go Right --A to Jump and to play/pause intro cinematic --B to change music and to skip intro cinematic --X to Restart --Y to Quit Game Launch on Steam community special! -first person to leave a five star comment gets his/her likeness added into the game as a cameo background character wearing a 1st t-shirt! (Edit: congrats to TK2236 for winning, his Steam avatar likeness has been added to the cameo roster, check him out popping in randomly in game!) -you can have your own 2d pixelart cameo added into the game as well, for details check out this link: also, follow me on youtube at: CARBONTEAofficial
row.short_description: George McGeehan wants to save a cat! Play this chill platformer by jumping onto light fixtures while avoiding annoying enemies!

row.name: Midnight Witch Starlight
row.detailed_description: In this 90’s anime-inspired, wave-based, 2D run-and-gun side-scroller, you play as a magical girl on the side of light. Load out your arsenal of spells to free the legion of spirits corrupted by the legion of shadow. Progress through an ever changing forest, to get to the bottom of what's causing the corruption. What is the legion of shadow and what do they want with our world? Defeat waves of enemies to find the truth. With different elements at your disposal, combine them with light to create powerful explosions of magic to push back the dark. Dodge and position yourself to make the most of the spell patterns to deliver the strongest attacks possible. The forest is dangerous though, you'll need help. Meet a mysterious person who offers his wares in exchange for purging the dark. No matter how you choose to play, the forest needs your help to free the light once more. Magical girl character! 4 colorful magic spells! A simple and straightforward side scroller! Big spell explosions! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A 90s anime inspired, wave based, 2D run and gun side scroller, where you are a magical girl on the side of light. Load out your arsenal of spells to free the legion of spirits corrupted by the legion of shadow.

row.name: Crime Scene Cleaner: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the crime scene ...which also happens to be your workplace. Sometimes it’s almost terrific how much of a mess a simple hitman can make, but you’re not here to complain. There’s a reason you took on that job, remember? Your daughter’s life lies in your hands – that’s why you became so good at this. Dispose of bodies and destroy pieces of evidence, all while staying out of the police’s radar. Meet the protagonist in an introduction to his crime scene cleaning struggles. The prologue is free and includes a part of the main character’s story, which takes place in a local entrepreneur’s villa. Discover and hide its dirty secrets using some tools from the full game’s arsenal. Core Features Deep clean the crime scene Activate your cleaner’s sense Destroy crucial pieces of the evidence Explore stories behind the crimes Upgrade your equipment Steal to make more money Stay out of suspicion
row.short_description: When there’s a call, you are the man to clean up after your client’s dirty job. Siding with the mafia is a dangerous game, but they pay well, and you need money, right? So take your mop and better remove those bloodstains quickly before the police come.
row.notes: The game contains crime scenes. The game does not include violent acts but shows their effect, such as blood and bodies. These are scenes that police coroners have to deal with.

row.name: RAINBOW CREAM SAGA
row.detailed_description: Get ready to explore a vast universe with 21 planets spread across 7 epic galaxies, each packing a unique elemental punch. Source Energy (green), Gravitational Energy (purple), Static Energy (blue), Magma Energy (orange), Legendary Energy (yellow), and Anti Energy (red)! On each planet, you'll meet enemies with their own unique weapons. It's not all fun and games tho, cuz each planet is guarded by a wicked Deity. Take 'em down and score some data cubes. You'll need them to triangulate the Ultra Planet, a mind-blowing place with endless resources, rare stuff, and supercharged weapons. And the best part? Ultra crystal gems, baby! Those gems fuel your warp travel, so you better get 'em. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to craft the elusive Ultra Ring. It's your golden ticket to unlimited fuel and intergalactic travel. But you gotta work for it, defeat that final Deity on the Ultra Planet, and collect that sweet ultra essence. But here's the kicker, you might stumble upon a unicorn on your wild journey. And this ain't no ordinary unicorn – it grants you an infinite amount ultra essence, and the ability to travel across all dimensions. A supreme shortcut to victory! Don't forget to gear up and bring your A-game. Enhance those weapons to counter those elemental baddies. It's all about strategy and skill on this wild ride. Plus, you can tame Deities and ride 'em like a boss! Get those tech traps and show 'em who's the real king of the Galaxy. We got 24 unique weapons, each with its own wild combo set. Power and weakness are the name of the game! Plan your moves wisely as you'll face off against 7 elemental enhancements and powers. Get ready for an electrifying combat experience. So are you ready for this epic adventure? The universe is calling, and it's time to show 'em what you're made of! Take the reins on RAINBOW CREAM SAGA and become the legend you set out to be. Let's go, baby!
row.short_description: Welcome to RAINBOW CREAM SAGA, a kickass melee action survival game with some RPG vibes! You can craft weapons, build bases, capture mounts and much more! Come through on this epic adventure and test out your survival skills.

row.name: Cool Cucumber Cricket
row.detailed_description: When you think of cricket what comes to mind? That's right this game needs more cards! In This game you'll attempt to lead your team to test victories by playing cards that make your players better or their players worse. Lead your team Test Cricket Victory Play your cards to tip the scales as you simulate a test match 6 overs at a time. Build a Deck for your Bowlers and your Batters Use cards to improve your players stats, make your opponents worse, change the weather or pitch conditions and many more things. Recruit your team of Batsmen, All Rounders and Bowlers Buy and replace players. Gosh its hard to talk about games I just make them... Hope you enjoy.
row.short_description: When you think of cricket what comes to mind? That's right this game needs more cards! In This game you'll attempt to lead your team to test victories by playing cards that make your players better or their players worse.

row.name: Cooking Craze
row.detailed_description: Cook up a storm serving food from around the world playing our free restaurant game Cooking Craze. Prepare, cook & serve tasty dishes like a professional chef and master the kitchen as you click to grill, bake and cook your way to the top. Bake wood-fired pizza in Rome, grill juicy burgers in New York and prepare fine French cuisine in Paris — but be careful, playing fast isn’t enough! You need to keep your customers happy in order to grow your empire. Can you take the heat, Chef? Cook classic restaurant dishes from across the globe; • Make hundreds of delicious dishes including burgers, pizza, sushi, ramen, dumplings and more • Grill fresh fish, tasty steak, succulent shrimp, and veggie kabobs • Love desserts? Why not deep fry sweet donuts, bake baklava, serve ice cream, cheesecake or cakes? Create a Restaurant Empire! • Choose from over 100 ingredients cooking up tasty cuisine • Create premium dishes with delicious new ingredients • Launch new restaurants while learning new cooking techniques • Add a new recipe from each city you visit • Cook in a variety of settings Level up with Cooking Quests, Powerful Boosts and features! • Serve food fast while managing your time to earn kitchen upgrades • Beat over 4000 levels across six continents • Master all 3 difficulty levels to get golden comment cards to earn free coins and spoons • Dash through service to earn BIG TIPS or work extra shifts to earn money for upgrades • Equip your chef with treats for customers, non-stick pans and MORE! • Upgrade your kitchen & increase your speed • Use a variety of special boosts to cook your way to victory • Cook GREEN with an Eco Boost & go organic for more tips • Win achievements by completing combos, cooking perfect meals & earning big tips The best restaurant gaming experience: • New levels and cities around the world added regularly • Hours of free fun, whenever, wherever you want! • Play online or OFFLINE WITHOUT WIFI or internet after initial download! Download Cooking Craze and create your own kitchen empire!
row.short_description: Cooking Craze is a fast and fun cooking game that lets you explore the cultures of the world through their delicious food! Upgrade your restaurants to serve only the best dishes and use a variety of special boosts to cook your way to victory!

row.name: 2099 Gravity Havoc
row.detailed_description: In 2099 Gravity Havoc The player will play as a special agent trapped on a space station falling into the Earth's Atmosphere. The only way to survive is to collect all the energy cubes scattered across the space station and use them to restart the station's reactor. In the game, the player will have an advanced weapon that can shoot in three different fire modes and a gravity gun that can move objects around. The space station where the player will be fighting is an open map with plenty of resources that the player will need to collect to make ammunition for the weapons, health syringes, and unlock new skills and weapons.
row.short_description: Shoot at enemies in a WEIGHTLESS space station to save yourself from burning alive in the atmosphere!

row.name: As I Began To Dream Playtest
Flow Parkour
row.detailed_description: Flow Parkour is a 3D platformer made with the game engine Unity. Early versions of the game caught my friends attention so I took it seriously and decided to publish it. It has an art style that revolves around the infamous cube and a difficulty that will have you smashing your keyboard in 30 minutes. Flow Parkour comes in two game modes, the normal version and the endless version. The normal version, which has around 30 levels on release, is the original game mode. Your target is to make it to the finish of the obstacle course as quick as possible without dying. (getting hit by a turret, falling in a trap...) In most levels you have access to your weapons, sometimes you only have one of the weapons. It depends on the level. Each level has its own difficulty with a given target. Endless is a game mode with a score, you need to rank up the highest score possible while lasting as long as possible with no weapons but a grappler. You need to cross a large map just to collect around a 100 points without dying every time... Flow parkour has 5 difficulties : Easy - A short or simple level Moderate - A short level that has little to no obstacles (such as turrets) Difficult - A longer level that has a bit more obstacles Very difficult - A level with a very hefty amount of buffed turrets or any other obstacles Extreme - A very long and complex level with buffed turrets with a ridiculous amount of obstacles that makes it nearly impossible to finish So what are you waiting for ? Download Flow Parkour today on steam !
row.short_description: A simple yet fun platformer game made with the game engine unity.

row.name: Only Wish
row.detailed_description: Only Wish Welcome to 'Only Wish', the next-generation advancement of the acclaimed 'Only Up' genre. Embark on an unparalleled gaming journey enriched with breathtaking landscapes, groundbreaking gameplay, and an array of unique features that set it apart. Uncover Hidden Realms Delve into the heart of mystery. Every door you encounter conceals secrets and untold stories, beckoning you to discover what lies beyond. Revolutionary Vehicular Exploration Why limit your exploration to walking? Jump into a diverse selection of vehicles and traverse the vast expanses of our world. Feel the pulse of authentic driving dynamics and harness the full power of vehicle propulsion. Engaging NPC Dialogues Deepen your immersion with intricate interactions from our varied NPCs. Each conversation is designed to amplify your engagement and propel the storyline. Engage with characters, unravel hidden tales, and make pivotal decisions that could alter the trajectory of your adventure. Enter a realm where dialogue is an art, and every character weaves their own unique narrative.
row.short_description: Climb to the top and try to defeat Mister Mysterious! Be careful not to fall!

row.name: Cyber Space Driver
row.detailed_description: This is just a student project for fun, that have an idea simple as straight road to space. In spirit of endless runner genre. Choose one of the four cyberpunk style environments (Cyber City top and down, Road to Moon, Mars Desert) and just drive. The project Inspired by synthwave videos on YouTube where music playlist accompanied by 80s style car, which drive through infinite Cyber space. If you wish you have a chance to put your songs to in game radio. Every CyberPunk style game have its own Cyber Bugs. Beware...
row.short_description: This is little project in the spirit of endless runner genre, so as this a real CyberPunk style project, this is... buggy, synthwavy, peace of junk-art. Cyber Space Driver... Drive straight, that's it.

row.detailed_description: Recommended for you About the Game 5050 is a simple game of chance. Are you feeling lucky? Insert some points and press the button. They’ll either get doubled or turn to nothing. Your objective is simply to accumulate as many points as possible. It’s up to you how cautious you want to play, but it’s high risk reward. Points in your account are safe, but what fun is safety without progress? With only 2 controls, you must play this game on instinct alone. The game is won once you reach 1 million points, and your progress towards this is shown at the bottom of the screen. You can of course keep playing even after surpassing this goal. Controls: The game was designed with a mouse in mind, but you can also play with the keyboard too: Space = Press the button Arrow keys = Change deposit amount
row.short_description: Each time you press the button, it will either double or lose all the points you’ve put in. How much will you risk?

row.name: AploVVare Collection
row.detailed_description: The AploVVare Collection is a collection of small games from the creator of Roseblight, Project Malice, & more! Most games were created for and submitted to game jams, originally created in under 72 hours. Some games are short-term projects, created just for the hell of it. Most have been updated from the original versions to include more content for this collection. Games Included: Terato Tamer - A turn-based strategy game where you seduce monsters to survive Citri Plays Noirwood - A game where you play as a vtuber playing a horror game Reversary - A reverse boss battle game where you are the big guy with a big sword Hellfire Pizza - A game where you deliver pizza... in HELL WELD - An atmospheric game where you fuse weapons to survive the wilderness ...and more!
row.short_description: You found an old game console along with some games at a garage sale. You remember playing these as a kid, and couldn't resist getting it. Maybe you could give them a whirl, just for old time's sake?
row.notes: Most of the games featured in the collection contain mature content, and may not be suited for younger audiences. There are disclaimers at the beginning of each game that have such content so the player knows what they are getting into. row.name: Waking Up: Way Back Home
row.detailed_description: When Earth became an uninhabitable place, humans were forced to live in space. Captain Urus Kramp, governor of the mothership Babylon 3, founded a new civilization and organized intergalactic exploration missions alongside Sub-Officer Leonard Thoran. Years later, Roby, Leonard's son, leaves Babylon 3 and infiltrates a ship heading to an unknown planet where he believes his father is located. Face danger with Roby and join him on his epic mission to uncover what's happening with Captain Urus Kramp and Babylon 3. Will he unveil the mystery, find his father, and return home? His destiny is in your hands. Key features: Third-person adventure. Immersive story. Atmospheric scenarios. Puzzle solving. Relaxing gameplay. Decision making. Exploration and secrets. Alternate endings.
row.short_description: A child infiltrates a spaceship to carry out a secret rescue mission. His objective is compromised when they must make a forced landing on a strange planet. Explore this mysterious place, overcome obstacles, and find the way back home!

row.name: Electoral Dynasty
row.detailed_description: Become the Prime Minister of one of many nations, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. You must keep your job by balancing the agenda of the various parties forming your coalition while also ensuring that your country stays healthy through various decisions. Will you pursue free market capitalism, install a planned economy with workers at the forefront, or strike a balance between the two? Will you form a brutal police state or pursue individual freedoms for all your citizens? The choice is yours... By approving or vetoing Bills and Executive Orders from all sects of the political spectrum, you must ensure that values intrinsic to national health, such as the strength of the military and the quality of education, maintain balanced. You also need to make sure that you're doing enough to make the people want to keep your party in power. Features: - Over 200 Bills, Executive Orders, and Events, making each play through experience distinct - 7 political parties to choose from, falling on all points of the political spectrum - 4 nations with distinct advantages and disadvantages
row.short_description: A political-simulation watch-the-clock strategy game. Pass laws, executive orders, and deal with events, all while maintaining the balance of your nation's most important attributes. Will you manage to keep your coalition together or establish a dictatorship? Only you can decide, Prime Minister.

row.name: Conquest of Empires 2
row.detailed_description: [Game Bonuses] The Early Access Test will open on December 20th. Enter the exchange code: COE888 in the game, and you can get 888 diamonds and 6 kinds of rare items. Join Conquest of Empires 2. Discover the charm of civilization, and enjoy the joy of conquest! Royal Enlistment Order: Join the game and receive 28 powerful historical heroes, including Barbarossa, Louis IX, Alfred the Great, Queen of Sheba, Wu Zetian, Hannibal Barca, and Lancelot! Build an invincible army and conquer the world! Building Upgrade Bonuses: Each time you upgrade a building, you will be rewarded with up to 3500 diamonds as well as various items, equipment, units, etc. to help you develop your empire! Easy to Upgrade with Auto-Fight: 24 hours of automatic fight allows you to upgrade heroes and collect equipment easily, making your in-game adventures more relaxing and enjoyable!! [Game Features] Welcome to Conquest of Empires 2, an epic feast of strategy! This game is like an encyclopedia of ancient civilizations, where you will experience the rise and scramble of ancient civilizations. In the game, you will become a city lord and choose one of the four great civilizations, namely China, Rome, Egypt or Persia, to start your own civilization. This game is not only a building simulation, but you also need to summon heroes and soldiers, skillfully combine all kinds of units and formations, and even fight against longer odds. In addition, you can participate in a variety of missions, build houses, cultivate fields, operate forest farms, upgrade buildings and so on. Every time you complete a mission, you'll be rewarded with generous rewards. In Conquest of Empires 2, you will review the glory of history, fight with epic heroes and revive the glory of ancient cities. It is not only a numerical duel, but also the use of wisdom and strategy. The game has no VIP privileges. We insist on fair competition, and focus on testing players' strategic intelligence and teamwork. We are committed to creating a user-friendly game, so that every player can easily enter the game, enjoy the glory of the ancient civilization, and feel the endless fun of conquest.

row.name: Tales Up
row.detailed_description: Be the hero of the story! In Tales Up, you are the masters of your destiny. You decide which path to take, if you should trust that beggar who claims she can see the future, which one of you should give their life to save the others… Discover unique adventures Each adventure is unique! Want some conflict? Choose a Survival story! An ounce of magic? Choose a Fantasy story! Each story has artwork, a soundtrack and unique animations… and for those who don’t like overly-long stories, we’ve even got series! Play the way you like You decide until the end, and that includes the game mode. - Tabletop mode : share the experience physically with your relatives; in a bar with friends, during a family dinner, with your colleagues... - Online mode : enjoy adventures with the person you choose from all over the world. - Solo mode : take control of your team of adventurers. Progression & Collection You can customize your avatar with different trinkets and goodies. For the more curious among you, you can accomplish missions by exploring secrets in the stories, and level up to earn more rewards! Regular releases New content comes out regularly: new stories, new objects, new characters. Tales Up is a cooperative role-playing game combining board games and gamebooks such as 'books in which you are the hero'. But it's also very easy to learn, so it's perfect to bring fun when having a few drinks in the evening! You'll find stories about zombies, pirates and Vikings... Funny situations and surprises guaranteed! Key Features : - Unique Adventures - Play in the mode of your choice - Individual progress - Updates and new content added regularly - Impactful multiplayer features Enter the world of Tales Up and become the hero of your own story. Get ready for unforgettable adventures! We are an independent french studio made up of a team of passionate people, we hope you have a great time! NB: The game is free to install and you will have free access to all the first episodes of the series to try them out. The complete stories must then be purchased individually via in-game currency (for a fee) or via the Adventurer's Pass, which contains all the stories and more. After a mobile version and also a web browser version, Tales Up arrives on Steam.
row.short_description: Your choices. Your adventures. Become the heroes of the Tales Up universe! You decide which path to take. Choose your team wisely and explore a new kind of role-playing game with Tales Up, the interactive multiplayer adventure video game.

row.name: Tip of the Tongue

'Tip of the Tongue' transforms that experience into a thrilling game, pushing your vocabulary skills to the limit. Game Features: Survival Mode: Keep up the pace! Identify objects correctly to stay in the game. Stumble too much, and it's the end of the line. Vast Categories: From birds and celebrities to kitchen appliances and tools, there's always a fresh challenge awaiting. row.name: At Winter's End
row.detailed_description: Every Winter gives way to Spring. For most people, this is a passive event: something that happens naturally thanks to the positions of hemispheres and stars. But I know the reason why Winter ends. I know because the Wind told me. At Winter's End is a cozy narrative dice-rolling RPG about 12-year-old Noel growing up in the forest of spirits. Explore the forest and complete quests while rolling dice to see how Noel responds to the challenges they face. Play as Noel, a 12-year-old child who has grown up exploring the lakes and woods surrounding their home. These are no ordinary woods, however, and in these woods, Noel has befriended the spirits of the woods. The Wind, Lake, and Stone are just a few of their best friends. Stone, the oldest spirit of nature, told them once that nature only appears to the youngest humans, and that one day they'd no longer be able to see nature the same way. Thirteen years is all they get with these friends. Every winter, it's Stone's job to explain to Winter that the season is over and it's time to leave. But this year, Stone is sick and has lost its voice, so Noel is tasked with speaking to Winter in just one week's time. On the Spring Equinox, Noel's birthday, they must talk to Winter and ask it to allow spring to come. Along the way, Noel will have to assist the spirits of the forest in preparing for spring, talking to them, exploring the forest and helping them make tough decisions with the help of their trusty dice. Along the way, Noel will learn about responsibility, growing up, and eventually, how to say goodbye. Join Noel as they spend one last season in the forest of their childhood in At Winter’s End. Discover a cozy interactive narrative and meet a charming cast of forest spirits and animals. Explore the forest of Noel's childhood, finding old trinkets and new friends as you go. Roll dice and make decisions to help the spirits of the forest prepare for spring. Customize and upgrade your dice to prepare for Noel's final encounter with the spirit of Winter.
row.short_description: At Winter's End is a cozy narrative dice-rolling RPG about 12-year-old Noel growing up in the forest of spirits. Explore the forest and complete quests while rolling dice to see how Noel responds to the challenges they face.
