row.name: On Call
row.detailed_description: About the Game On Call is a visual novel that invites you to work a rotation at Merritt General Hospital to learn about stress management for workers in the healthcare industry. Key Features During your rotation at Merritt General Hospital, you’ll encounter a diverse group of patients facing challenging ailments and disorders. Build trust and rapport with them to help them recover from their maladies. Manage your own stress while confronting these challenges or you may just crack under the pressure. Choice Driven Narrative Make dialogue choices to influence patient outcomes and manage your stress level as you work through your rotation. Overcome their objections to help your patients make healthy choices to improve their conditions. Manage Stress Build trust with your patients and use breaks to manage your stress level effectively. Don't forget to take a moment to decompress every now and then. Patient Tracking Utilize patient SOAP notes to track the treatment progress and decisions made for each patient. Remember to check your clipboard regularly to remain informed on each patient.

row.name: Yujiro's Mansion
row.detailed_description: You're a robber going around a neighborhood doing what you do best. After robbing many houses you stumble across a huge mansion. You break into the mansion, but what you didn't know was that this mansion belonged to the 'Strongest Creature In The World.' The Pinnacle of Physical Force, Yujiro Hanma. Features - Singleplayer - Survival Horror - Stealth - Multiple Endings (Secret Ending, if you can find how to get it!) - Immersive Atmosphere - Hidden Collectibles - Easy to learn controls - Fluid Player Movement - Added in UI crosshair which changes color to denote which objects are interactable - AI stalking you around a dark mansion. row.name: RegicideX
row.detailed_description: Is a 3D Hack'n Slash inspired by games like Nier Automata, Devil May Cry, Bayonetta and Hades. It takes place in a dark fantasy world plagued with rotten and evil angels (visually inspired by biblically accurate angels) and possesed people who have invaded the castle of our protagonist. Our protagonist fights in a series of consecutives arenas, each one with multiple waves featuring different enemies, until he reaches the throne and overcomes the invasion. Failure means starting again from the beginning. The game is fast paced and movility is key, giving importance to dashes, dodges, jumps (and double jumps) and well timing attacks from the attack toolset the player has available. The player also has access to limited powers useful for combat. Each attack or action is suitable for a particular situation or enemy. The final wave of each arena presents a new angel as a final boss to put the player's skills to test and overcome the arena, being able to advance to the next one.
row.short_description: RegicideX is a 3D Hack'n Slash that takes place in a dark fantasy world plagued with rotten and evil angels and possesed people who have invaded the castle of our Lord. You will have to fight in order to liberate your castle and overcome the invasion.

row.name: VAHLUNA CORP.
row.detailed_description: In a quiet little town, there lived an unassuming character named Blorp. He was just an average guy, spending his days working hard and dreaming of a better life. Every evening, after finishing his mundane job, Blorp would kick off his worn-out boots, settle down on his comfy couch, and watch the news while eagerly waiting for the weekly lotto draw. Little did he know that his life was about to take an extraordinary turn. One fateful evening, as Blorp watched the lotto draw, he couldn't believe his eyes when the numbers on the screen matched the ones on his ticket. He had won the Mega Jackpot, an unimaginable sum that promised to change his life forever. However, Blorp's elation was short-lived as, in that very moment, a strange noise echoed from the sky outside. Before he could grasp the situation, he found himself sucked up into a blinding beam of light, transporting him to an otherworldly space vessel. The Vahluna Corporation, a mysterious and powerful alien organization, was behind this abduction. Blorp, now trapped within the alien spaceship, realized that he wasn't the only human on board. It appeared that the Vahluna Corporation had abducted other innocent beings from various planets across the universe. With newfound courage and determination, Blorp knew that he had to find a way to escape and expose the truth about these malevolent aliens to the world. As he explored the vast spacecraft, he discovered that he had two choices: confront the alien invaders head-on, but risk dwindling ammo and their sharpshooting abilities, or take the stealthy path, sneaking around, and seeking hidden vents and passageways to outmaneuver his enemies. Throughout his daring journey, Blorp would encounter different types of aliens, each with unique abilities and behaviors. He would have to use his wits, cunning, and the resources he finds along the way to outsmart these extraterrestrial adversaries. The spacecraft itself would be a labyrinth of advanced technology, filled with mysterious rooms, high-tech gadgets, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Blorp delves deeper into the alien vessel, he begins to uncover the sinister motives behind the Vahluna Corporation's actions and their plans for Earth. The fate of not only Blorp but also the entire human race now lies in his hands. Will he successfully locate the escape pods and make it back to Earth to warn everyone about the impending alien threat? Or will he succumb to the challenges and malevolence of the Vahluna Corporation, becoming just another forgotten captive on their ship? Embark on this thrilling sci-fi adventure with Blorp, as players must make strategic choices, solve puzzles, and outmaneuver the alien enemies to secure a path to freedom and save humanity from the looming extraterrestrial peril.
row.short_description: Confront the alien invaders head-on, but risk dwindling ammo and their sharpshooting abilities, or take the stealthy path, sneaking around, and seeking hidden vents and passageways to outmaneuver his enemies.

row.name: Free For All
row.detailed_description: What do you think is the most important thing in life? money? honor? love? or something else? everything is fine Please enjoy this adventure according to your values. Various races live in harmony in this world. They work hard every day with their own purpose. Become a part of this world too, adventure in their world and fulfill your purpose. 1. Game progress. The game consists of a tutorial chapter and one chapter. Each chapter has its own main story and sub story. Depending on that, there are various quests or items. In the tutorial chapter, you can naturally learn the core features of the game and infer the story of chapter 1 by doing quests. Additionally, upon successful completion of the tutorial, you will receive several items, stats, and reputation. In Chapter 1, you can freely adventure according to your values. As you progress through the adventure in Chapter 1, you will naturally approach the main story, so you will never forget what the main story is. 2. Features of the game. There are two ways to defeat monsters in this world. There is a way to kill monsters by attacking, and a way to expel monsters by letting them go. Depending on how you defeat monsters, there may be changes in the rewards or reputation you get, so you can choose according to your needs. You can get important clues for exploring this world through the conversation function with NPCs, and you can acquire various rewards or change your reputation through the quest function. In addition, various items can be acquired through transactions with NPCs with shop functions. Choose carefully as the story of each chapter progresses through interactions with these NPCs. Types of items include equipment items, consumption items, and other items. Equipment items are classified into weapons (swords, axes, daggers), sub-weapons, hats, tops, bottoms, gloves, and shoes. Animations vary depending on the weapon category. Also, there are various advantages and disadvantages. There are equipment items that have set effects. If you meet the conditions of the set effect, you will get additional stats and reputation. Equipment items can be enhanced to adjust their stats and reputation. Consumption items are classified into recovery potions, temporary buff potions, permanent buff potions, reinforcement books, and gift boxes. Other items are all items that are not equipment items and consumption items. Important factors that affect gameplay include your level, stats, reputation, and quest progress. Reputation has been added in addition to levels and abilities, which are indispensable elements of RPGs. There are various races in this world, and there is a reputation (overall reputation) and a reputation for each race. Depending on this reputation, there are restrictions on numerous functions such as using items and performing quests. Regardless of reputation, the main story progresses, but the conditions for clearing the main story quest will change, so be careful. There are various conditions such as chained quests, opposing quests, required stats, and required reputation as conditions for performing quests. This is a game where quests are important. If you perform some quests, you may not be able to perform other quests, so you need to choose carefully. Monster dictionary function is supported. It doubles as a kind of challenge or monster information. In the Monster Dictionary function, you can unlock the monster and check the monster's information. The way to unlock the monster is to kill a certain amount of the monster. All game data is saved to the user's local storage every minute. This will be used later when loading the game. Various UIs are provided. It provides stat and equipment window, item window, quest window, reputation window, monster dictionary window, in-game notification window, quick slot window, log window, and option window. In the Ability and Equipment window, you can check the status and status of the equipment you are wearing in detail. In the item window, you can check all the items you own. You can check your reputation in the Reputation window. In the Monster Dictionary window, you can check the level of unlocking the monster dictionary and various information. You can check various log records in the in-game notification window. The quick slot window supports quick use of items. In the case of equipment items, item switching is possible, and in the case of consumption items, it is possible to use them. For other items, only simple quantity confirmation is possible. In the log window, you can check various log records. In the options window, you can set the resolution, sound settings, and exit the game.
row.short_description: What is most important to you? Money? Honor? Love? Or any other things? It's all good. Please enjoy this adventure according to your values.

row.name: Code Name: Operation Dawn
row.detailed_description: In 'Operation Dawn,' players step into the shoes of a determined mother who recently lost her son, brutally killed in a tragic event at his military base. In the wake of this devastating loss, her husband is kidnapped by a ruthless terrorist group. Driven by love and a thirst for justice, she joins a secret organization dedicated to taking down these terrorists and rescuing her husband. Set in a vast open world filled with dynamic NPCs and customizable vehicles, players will navigate through treacherous environments, gather intelligence, and engage in high-stakes missions as part of the covert Operation Dawn.
row.short_description: In 'Operation Dawn,' you play as a mother who recently lost her son. Now, with her husband kidnapped by terrorists, she joins a secret organization to rescue him. Navigate an open world with dynamic NPCs and cars, and embark on high-stakes missions in the covert Operation Dawn.

row.name: 神州豪侠
row.detailed_description: 《神州豪侠》是一款备受欢迎的卡牌游戏，其以古代武林为主题，让玩家身临其境地体验古代武侠的精彩与魅力。在游戏中，玩家可以扮演一名武侠，在不断的修炼和战斗中提升自己的实力，最终成为一名真正的武侠豪杰。除了传统的武学修炼和战斗系统，游戏中还有众多有趣的玩法，如悬赏任务、帮派战争等等，让玩家享受到更多的游戏乐趣。游戏画面精美，场景细致，音效逼真，让玩家仿佛置身于一个真实的武侠世界中。同时，游戏的剧情也非常精彩，让玩家感受到了古代武林的风云变幻和豪情壮志。 游戏中的画面设计也非常精美，让玩家可以身临其境地感受到游戏中的世界观。游戏角色的造型设计非常独特，而且每个角色都有着不同的属性和技能。玩家需要根据自己的喜好和策略，选择不同的武将和主角，打造出自己的最强阵容。在游戏中，玩家需要不断地升级武将和主角，提升自己的战斗力，并合理地搭配武将和主角的技能，才能取得胜利。 游戏中的个性化主角和武将站位搭配是游戏的一大亮点。不同的主角有着不同的天赋和技能，可以为玩家在游戏中提供更多的策略选择。而武将之间的搭配也是游戏中的重要要素之一，合理地搭配武将和主角的技能，可以让玩家在战斗中占据更大的优势。 总之，《神州豪侠》是一款非常有趣和具有挑战性的卡牌回合对战游戏。游戏画面精美，玩法创新，让玩家可以享受到极致的游戏体验。如果你是卡牌游戏爱好者，那么这款游戏绝对不容错过!

row.name: Rings of Harmony
row.detailed_description: Incarnez Elea, une jeune magicienne ayant pour but de sauver le monde de la destruction dans un environnement médiéval-fantastique. Dans ce jeu solo narratif, vous vous plongez dans l’histoire et combinez vos capacités physiques et mentales pour progresser dans l’avancée de votre quête. Le monde est régi par le grand principe d’Harmonie et celui-ci est en danger. L’Harmonie est composée de six principes : la nature, l’artéfact, la magie, la sorcellerie, la dualité et l’unité. Ces six principes ont été matérialisés et contenus dans des anneaux et un événement a perturbé leur équilibre, les endommageant. Il va falloir les réparer pour rétablir cet équilibre et empêcher la fin du monde. --- Play as Elea, a young magician whose goal is to save the world from destruction in a medieval-fantasy setting. In this single-player narrative game, you immerse yourself in the story and combine your physical and mental abilities to advance your quest. The world is governed by the great principle of Harmony, and it's in danger. Harmony is made up of six principles: nature, artifact, magic, sorcery, duality and unity. These six principles have been materialized and contained in rings, and an event has upset their balance, damaging them. They must now be repaired to restore balance and prevent the end of the world.
row.short_description: Rings Of Harmony est un jeu de puzzle médiéval-fantastique VR dans lequel vous interagissez avec votre environnement pour mener à bien votre quête. Attirez des objets, lancez-les et tracez des lignes pour sauver le monde de la destruction dans un environnement immersif.

row.name: I will make you scared of this Red Box.
row.detailed_description: The Red Cube wants to eat all of the pills in the hospital. The problem is that he has already had WAY too many! You need to collect all of the the pills in the facility so that he doesn't eat any more. Be careful though...The Cube REALLY likes his pills... Inspired by previous indie horror games, join the Red Cube and the rest of the hospital staff in a search for the pills in a first person shooter horror experience! Use the stun gun to stun the cube before he gets you and reload at the vending machines when needed. You also need to watch out for the hospital staff and make sure they don't get in your way. You will need to avoid the doctor, the nurse, and the facility house spider and not get caught by their antics which can slow you down. - Collect the 9 pills while avoiding the Red Cube. - Don't get lost in the maze of hospital rooms. - Use your stun gun to temporarily freeze the Red Cube (you will need it). - Reload the stun gun by standing next to 1 of 3 vending machines for 5 seconds. - Avoid the Doctor. - Avoid the Nurse. - Avoid the Spider. [Warning] This game does contain jump scares and spider scares, play at your own risk. This game is designed to be challenging (I can barely beat it myself).

However, when you, as a character following the Red Army on the Long March, simulate the route of the Red Army's Long March and conduct another 'Long March', it will not only allow you to quickly understand the general course of the Long March, but also the inevitable events and trigger events in the game. Your character deeply experienced the hardships of the Red Army on the Long March. How to play 1. The Long March course is automatically played, and you only need to make simple decisions and operations on inevitable events and trigger events to continue advancing the game. 2. The game is divided into two stages: before the round and during the round. The former will statically display the current Long March route and related content of the selected Red Army unit, while the latter will display these content dynamically. Script: The Long March scripts of 8 different Red Army units including the Central Red Army Roles: There are hidden bonuses for different genders and occupations

row.name: Up Against Aliens
row.detailed_description: Roadmap We are making the game free to play in hopes of more people trying it out and challenging peoples high scores in the mini games! About the Game Welcome to the mind-bending adventure of 'Up Against Aliens,' a captivating 3D platform puzzle game that will challenge your wit, reflexes, and courage. Prepare to embark on a journey through space, mystery, and intergalactic peril. Unveil the Extraterrestrial Enigma: As you wake up to the echoes of a thunderous explosion, you are thrust into a bewildering world where the rules of reality have been shattered. Your quest begins in your apartment, but the moment you step outside, you realize something unthinkable has occurred—your entire building is suspended in the cosmos among a chaotic sea of debris. An Unlikely Ally: Amidst the cosmic turmoil, you encounter a weathered and enigmatic old man who shares a chilling revelation—he believes he witnessed an entity spiriting away into the maelstrom of floating detritus. With urgency etched into every word, he urges you to hasten upwards, setting the stage for an odyssey that will test your every skill and intellect. Master Time-Bending Mechanics: Your journey will lead you to a discovery that changes the very fabric of your mission—a device that bends time for the swirling debris while leaving you unaffected. With this ingenious tool, you can manipulate the flow of time for the platforms you traverse, turning tumultuous terrain into calculated pathways. Harness this newfound power to leap from one platform to another with grace and precision. Conquer Puzzles and Challenges: As you navigate the treacherous expanse of space, you'll encounter moments of impasse that demand more than reflexes alone. Solve intricate puzzles that blend physics, logic, and creativity to forge a path forward. Traverse shifting landscapes, manipulate gravitational forces, and unlock hidden mechanisms, all while piecing together the puzzle of what has happened to your city. Battle Beyond the Stars: The climax of your journey looms as you finally confront the alien spaceship. Engage in an epic showdown that tests not only your mastery of time manipulation but also your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds. The fate of Earth itself, hinges on your ability to overcome this otherworldly menace. Dive into the immersive world of 'Up Against Aliens' and experience a fusion of heart-pounding action and brain-teasing puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Uncover the truth and become the unlikely hero in a story that spans the cosmos. The challenge awaits—do you have what it takes to triumph over the unknown?
row.short_description: Navigate cosmic debris using time-bending tech in this 3D platformer. Solve puzzles and thwart the alien threat across shifting landscapes. Will you be Earth's unexpected savior when you go Up Against Aliens?
